blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Brain-to-language decoding translates neural activity associated with language production, internal speech and perception into linguistic or expressive outputs. It offers a route to restoring communication after speech loss and a means of studying how the brain represents language. Advances in neural recording and representation learning have expanded the field from constrained recognition and acoustic reconstruction to text generation, streaming personalised speech and facial animation. This survey synthesises these developments across invasive and non-invasive measurements, drawing on a search without a lower year limit and source-led updates through September 2026. We connect Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks to the neural populations they engage, the representations available to decoders and the outputs those representations can support. We examine model development, public resources and the evolution of evaluation, and compare published performance and communication costs within their reported protocols. The synthesis identifies complementary routes to progress: phonetic, acoustic and semantic targets preserve different aspects of a message; shared representations support reuse across recording conditions and tasks; and online communication increasingly depends on calibration, feedback and user control alongside decoding accuracy. Shared benchmarks enable algorithmic comparisons, while longitudinal studies reveal the demands of sustained use. We discuss these developments and their remaining limitations, then outline a prospective five-level trajectory from commands and language to meaning, scenarios and bidirectional cognitive exchange.
blocks.zh: 脑对语言解码将语言制作,内部语音和感知相关的神经活动翻译为语言或表达性输出. 它提供了在语音失落后恢复通信的途径,以及研究大脑如何代表语言的手段. 神经录制和表现学习的进步,将领域从受限的识别和声学重建扩展到文本生成,流传个性化的语音和面部动画. 本次调查综合了这些动态,跨越入侵性和非入侵性测量,利用了没有下年限的搜索和2026年9月以源头为主导的更新. 我们把人工、内置和感知任务与它们参与的神经人群、解码器可用的表达方式以及这些表达方式能够支持的产出联系起来。 我们审查模型开发、公共资源和评价的演变情况,并比较其报告协议中公布的业绩和通信费用。 综合查明了进展的互补途径:语音、声学和语义目标保留了信息的不同方面;共享表达支持在记录条件和任务之间重复使用;在线通信越来越依赖于校准、反馈和用户控制以及解码准确性。 共同的基准可以进行算法比较,纵向研究则揭示了持续使用的需求。 我们讨论这些发展及其其余的局限性,然后概述从指令和语言到意义、情景和双向认知交流的五级轨道。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language allows people to share knowledge, express intentions and participate in social life. Brain-to-language decoding seeks to recover linguistic information directly from neural activity, creating a route to communication when the movements needed for speech are impaired. It also provides a computational approach to studying how sounds, words and meanings are represented during speaking, inner speech, listening and reading. These clinical and scientific aims draw on the same central opportunity: neural recordings contain information about language that can be learned and translated into an observable output.
blocks.zh: 语言使人们可以分享知识,表达意向并参与社会生活. 脑对语言解码寻求直接从神经活动中恢复语言信息,在语音所需运动受损时创建通路. 它还提供了一种计算方法,用于研究在演讲,内在演讲,倾听和阅读时如何代表声音,文字和意义. 这些临床和科学目标利用了同样的中心机会:神经录音包含可以学习和翻译成可观察输出的语言信息.

blocks.en: The field has developed through several connected advances. Reconstruction of speech features from auditory-cortex activity established a route from neural measurements to sound ( Pasley et al., 2012 ) . Phoneme-based recognition and articulatory modelling connected speech-production signals to words and synthesised sentences ( Herff et al., 2015 ; Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ) . Clinical neuroprostheses subsequently enabled sentence-level attempted-speech decoding, large-vocabulary text, personalised voice and facial animation ( Moses et al., 2021 ; Willett et al., 2023 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ) . Streaming synthesis and prolonged home use are extending this progress from producing an output towards participating in an exchange ( Littlejohn et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ; Card et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 该领域通过若干相关进展得到了发展。 从听觉-科特克斯活动重建语音特征确定了从神经测量到声音的路径(Pasley等人,2012年)。 基于Phoneme的识别和动脉建模将语音生成信号连接到单词和合成句子(Herff等人,2015年;Anumanchipalli等人,2019年). 临床神经假肢后来允许了句子一级试听解码,大字形文字,个性化语音和面部动画(Moses等人,2021年;Willett等人,2023年;Metzger等人,2023年). 合成和长期使用家用正在扩大这一进展,从生产产出扩大到参与交换(Littlejohn等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2025年;Card等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Non-invasive research opens complementary paths. EEG and MEG studies learn correspondences between neural activity and heard or read language, supported by shared corpora and pretrained speech and language representations ( Hollenstein et al., 2018 ; Défossez et al., 2023 ; d’Ascoli et al., 2025 ) . Haemodynamic recordings support semantic reconstruction over longer timescales ( Tang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 非侵入性研究开辟了互补道路. EEG和MEG研究学习神经活动与听觉或阅读语言之间的对应,辅以共享的corpora和预训的语音和语言表述(Hollenstein等人,2018年;Défossez等人,2023年;d ' Ascoli等人,2025年). 血动力学录音支持较长时间段的语义重建(Tang等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Across recording modalities, inner-speech studies investigate internally produced content, ranging from discriminating imagined items to cued large-vocabulary intracortical decoding ( Proix et al., 2022 ; Wandelt et al., 2024 ; Kunz et al., 2025 ) . Together, these directions reveal a field with several useful objectives: understanding language representations, recovering presented content and enabling a person to express a chosen message.
blocks.zh: 纵观录制方式,内语研究调查了内部制作的内容,从歧视性的想象物品到提示大省内编码(Proix等人,2022年;Wandelt等人,2024年;Kunz等人,2025年)。 这些指示一起揭示了一个领域,它有几个有用的目标:理解语言表述、恢复所呈现的内容和使一个人能够表达选定的信息。

blocks.en: An organising question connects this diversity: which aspects of language can different neural measurements recover, and how can those representations support expression? A phoneme sequence preserves the units needed to compose words; acoustic and articulatory representations provide structured routes to speech synthesis; a semantic representation permits changes in wording while retaining aspects of meaning. These choices interact with the participant’s task and the timescale and coverage of the recording. They explain why different methods can share a neural-network architecture yet learn different information and serve different purposes. The task–network–representation map in Figure 4 makes these connections explicit. The decoding routes in Figure 8 explain how the representations become outputs. Section 5 compares published methods and their results within specified benchmarks; Section 6 explains the evaluation standards and the questions those comparisons can answer.
blocks.zh: 一个组织问题将这种多样性联系在一起:语言的哪些方面可以恢复不同的神经测量,这些表达如何支持表达呢? 一个电话序列保留了词的编译所需的单位;声学和动词表达提供了语音合成的结构化路线;语义表达允许在保留意义方面的同时修改措辞. 这些选择与参与者的任务以及录制的时间和覆盖面相互影响。 他们解释了为什么不同的方法可以共享神经网络架构,却可以学习不同的信息,服务于不同的目的. 图4中的任务-网络-代表图明确了这些联系。 图8中的解码路径解释了说明如何成为产出. 第5节在规定的基准范围内比较已公布的方法及其结果; 第6节解释了评价标准和这些比较可以回答的问题。

blocks.en: Existing surveys offer substantial foundations for this synthesis. An early neural-speech review brought the recording modalities together around automatic speech recognition and the promise of silent communication ( Herff and Schultz, 2016 ) . Subsequent reviews expanded this foundation as datasets, deep learning and clinical systems developed. EEG speech-imagery reviews organise acquisition, preprocessing, feature extraction and classification methods ( Rahman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Su and Tian, 2025 ) . Cross-modal imagery reviews connect those pipelines to experimental instructions, calibration and online operation ( Tates et al., 2025 ; Almufareh et al., 2025 ) . EEG-to-text and linguistic-decoding reviews explain the growing role of generative models across perception and production ( Murad and Rahimi, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025d ) . Clinical reviews bring cortical mechanisms, recording interfaces and communication restoration together ( Silva et al., 2024a ; Stavisky, 2025 ; Belfrouh et al., 2026 ) . More recent frameworks distinguish linguistic target granularity from output pathways, or integrate the intracranial language-BCI pipeline from hardware to clinical deployment ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有的调查为这种综合提供了坚实的基础。 早期的神经-声学评论将录音模式围绕自动语音识别和默默通信的许诺(Herff and Schultz, 2016)进行. 随后的审查随着数据集,深度学习和临床系统的发展,扩大了这一基础. EEG语音图像评论组织获取,预处理,特征提取和分类方法(Rahman等人,2024年;张等人,2025年;Su and Tian,2025年). 跨模式图像审查将这些管道与实验指示、校准和在线操作联系起来(Tates等人,2025年;Almufareh等人,2025年)。 EEG到文本和语言解码审查解释了基因模型在认知和生产方面日益重要的作用(Murad和Rahimi,2025年;Wang等人,2025年d )。 临床评论将皮质机理,记录界面和通信恢复结合起来(Silva等人,2024a;Stavisky,2025;Belfrouh等人,2026)。 较近期的框架将语言目标颗粒性与输出路径区分开来,或者整合从硬件到临床部署的颅内语言-BCI管道(Zhang等人,2026b; He et al., 2026 ). 维基语录链接:名人名言 - 文学作品 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语 - 谚语

blocks.en: The present survey connects these perspectives across tasks, recording families and output forms. Listening and reading provide paired neural and language observations; overt speech also supplies time-aligned acoustic targets, while attempted and inner speech require alternative labels, alignment or transfer strategies. Comparing them reveals opportunities for shared representations and transfer, as well as the changes in supervision that each transition requires. In parallel, pretrained models increasingly connect neural encoders to text, speech and visual expression. A comprehensive account must therefore explain both how these methods work and how their outputs are evaluated and used. Section 2.2 develops the comparison with earlier reviews in detail.
blocks.zh: 本调查将这些观点与任务、家庭记录和产出表联系起来。 听和读提供了配对的神经和语言观测;公开的语音也提供时间对齐的声学目标,而尝试和内在的语音则需要替代的标签,对齐或传输策略. 对其进行比较可以发现分享陈述和转移的机会,以及每个过渡所需的监督变化。 同时,预先训练的模型越来越多地将神经编码器与文本,语音和视觉表达连接起来. 因此,全面说明必须说明这些方法是如何运作的,以及如何评价和使用这些方法的产出。 第2.2节详细发展了与以前审查的比较。

blocks.en: Our synthesis has three aims. First, it provides a common vocabulary for Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks and relates their neural signals to the information a decoder can learn. Second, it compares datasets, supervision and decoding mechanisms across candidate selection, text, speech and facial expression, identifying recurring design choices and comparing published results within matched evaluation settings. Third, it connects output quality, generalisation and computational demands to interaction, adaptation and sustained access. This combined view motivates research on transferable representations, self-generated expression and communication interfaces that preserve the user’s control over a message.
blocks.zh: 我们的综合有三个目标。 首先,它为Articuled,Inner和Perceived的任务提供了共同的词汇,并将他们的神经信号与解码器能够学习的信息联系起来. 其次,它比较了候选人选择、文本、语音和面部表情的数据集、监督和解码机制,确定了经常性的设计选择,并比较了相应评价环境中公布的结果。 第三,它将产出质量、一般化和计算需求与互动、适应和持续获取联系起来。 这种综合观点促使人们研究可转移的表达方式、自我生成的表达方式和通信界面,从而维护用户对信息的控制。

blocks.en: Section 2 defines the scope and review procedure. Sections 3 and 4 introduce the tasks and neural measurements; Section 5 explains the data and decoding methods. Sections 6 and 7 examine evaluation and practical use. Section 8 synthesises unresolved directions, and Section 9 develops a prospective five-level trajectory from commands and language towards meaning, scenarios and bidirectional cognitive exchange.
blocks.zh: 第2节规定了范围和审查程序。 第3节和第4节介绍了任务和神经测量;第5节解释了数据和解码方法。 第6和第7节审查评价和实际使用。 第8节综合了未解决的方向,第9节发展了从指令和语言到意义、情景和双向认知交流的五级轨道。

blocks.en: 2 Review Method and Scope
blocks.zh: 2 审查方法和范围

blocks.en: 2.1 Scope and synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.1 范围和综合

blocks.en: The empirical scope is neural recording used to recover language-related content during Articulated, Inner or Perceived tasks. Reading is included as Perceived–Visual language. Clinical attempted-speech studies are retained even when residual articulator movement is not documented; an attempted-speech instruction alone does not assign the condition to Inner speech. We distinguish content decoding from auxiliary state detection, language mapping, representation analysis and dataset reports; adjacent evidence is retained only where it informs acquisition or interpretation. Interfaces based solely on surface electromyography (EMG) or camera-based lip-reading, and spelling-by-selection BCIs, fall outside this neural language-decoding scope. Multimodal systems with neural and peripheral inputs retain explicit input labels.
blocks.zh: 经验范围是神经录制,用于在Articled, Inner或Perceived任务中恢复语言相关内容. 阅读以视觉语言进行。 临床尝试语法研究即使没有记录剩余动脉运动,也保留下来;仅一种尝试语法指令并不能将病情分配给内语. 我们区分内容解码与辅助状态检测,语言映射,表达分析和数据集报告;相邻证据只有在告知获取或解释时才保留. 完全基于表面电学(EMG)或基于相机的唇读法,以及逐项拼音的BCIs的接口,都不属于这个神经语言解码范围. 具有神经和外围输入的多式联运系统保留了明确的输入标签。

blocks.en: The unit of comparison is an experimental condition: the participant’s task, recording, supervision and output together with the tested content, controls and use setting. Multiple conditions within one paper can support different conclusions. This is a critical narrative synthesis with a documented search and selected structured extractions, rather than an exhaustive full-text review of every indexed record. Registry coverage, structured extraction and claim-level source checking are reported separately.
blocks.zh: 比较单位是一个实验性条件:参与者的任务,记录,监督和输出以及测试的内容,控制和使用设置. 一份文件中的多种条件可以支持不同的结论。 这是一种带有有文件记载的搜索和部分结构化提取的批判性叙事综合,而不是对每一个索引记录的详尽全文审查. 登记范围、结构化提取和索赔一级来源检查分别报告。

blocks.en: Each comparison asks what was demonstrated, which information enabled it and what would have to change for another task or use. Candidate identification, semantic reconstruction and exact transcription require different tests even when all produce text. Scores are therefore interpreted within their participant, task, supervision and evaluation conditions rather than pooled. Missing controls or operating details remain unknown; they establish neither the presence nor the absence of a capability.
blocks.zh: 每次比较都询问所显示的情况、哪些信息使得它成为可能,以及为另一项任务或用途需要改变什么。 考生身份识别,语义重建以及准确的抄写,即使在所有都产生文字时也需要不同的测试. 因此,分数在其参与者、任务、监督和评价条件中加以解释,而不是集合。 缺少控制或操作细节的情况仍然不明;它们既不证实存在,也不证明缺乏能力。

blocks.en: 2.2 Prior reviews and the synthesis developed here
blocks.zh: 2.2 先前的审评和在此编写的综述

blocks.en: Existing reviews organise the field around different decisions: how to decode a signal, how to define a linguistic target, or how to restore communication. We compare their organising questions, task and signal scope, treatment of outputs and evaluation, and relation to practical use. These perspectives are complementary: detailed coverage of a pipeline does not by itself specify whether its supervision is available in another task, just as a clinical outcome does not isolate the contribution of each decoder component. Table 1 compares the closest surveys. Appendix D records all 30 directly relevant reviews and 16 contextual sources, with abstract-level, targeted-section or title-only checking stated separately.
blocks.zh: 现有的评论围绕不同的决定组织字段:如何解码一个信号,如何定义一个语言目标,或者如何恢复通信. 我们比较了它们的组织问题、任务和信号范围、产出的处理和评价以及实际使用的关系。 这些观点是相辅相成的:对管道的详细覆盖本身并不具体指明其监督是否可用于另一项任务,正如临床结果并不孤立每个解码器部分的贡献一样。 表1比较了最近的调查。 附 录 D记录所有30项直接相关的审查和16项背景资料来源,并分别列出抽象的、有针对性的或只列出标题的检查。

blocks.en: Early synthesis connected EEG, MEG, haemodynamic and intracranial recordings through the goal of recognising speech from neural signals ( Herff and Schultz, 2016 ) . This established acquisition and linguistic target as joint design choices. Later reviews could build on a wider empirical base: speech imagery added internally generated targets, clinical work added continuous communication, and pretrained models added reusable acoustic and semantic representations. The comparison below follows these extensions, including earlier foundations where they explain a method or evaluation practice.
blocks.zh: 早期的合成将EEG,MEG,血液动力学和颅内录制通过识别神经信号的语音的目标连接起来(Herff和Schultz,2016年). 这确定了作为联合设计选择的获取和语言目标。 以后的审查可以建立在更广泛的经验基础上:语音图像增加了内部生成的目标,临床工作增加了连续的通信,预先训练的模型增加了可重复使用的声学和语义表达. 以下的比较是在这些扩展之后进行的,包括早先解释方法或评价做法的基础。

blocks.en: EEG-focused reviews provide detailed accounts of preprocessing, features, models and datasets ( Rahman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Su and Tian, 2025 ; Estrella-Ibarra et al., 2026 ) . A recent PRISMA review extends deep-learning speech classification and decoding to EEG and intracranial EEG studies from 2018–2025 ( Sbaih et al., 2026 ) . These methodological maps identify the tools available for a target. Their applicability also depends on actual articulation versus internal simulation, supplied versus self-generated content, and matched versus transferred supervision. Architecture specifies the computation; task conditions specify the information that computation can use.
blocks.zh: EEG重点审查详细介绍了预处理、特征、模型和数据集(Rahman等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年;Su和Tian,2025年;Estrella-Ibarra等人,2026年)。 最近的一项PRISMA审查将深入学习的语音分类和编解码扩展至EEG和2018–2025年内部EEG研究(Sbaih等人,2026年). 这些方法图确定了可供目标使用的工具。 其适用性还取决于实际表达与内部模拟,提供与自我生成的内容,以及匹配与转移的监督。 架构指定了计算;任务条件指定了计算可以使用的信息.

blocks.en: Cross-modal speech-imagery reviews connect task instructions and processing routes with information-transfer rates, online use and calibration ( Tates et al., 2025 ; Almufareh et al., 2025 ) . A task-oriented review further separates semantic or intent targets, phonemes or syllables, words and sentences from output-space constraints and pathways ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . This separation is essential: linguistic granularity, vocabulary size and output form do not specify what the participant did. Articulated, Inner and Perceived conditions provide that behavioural distinction. A reading task and an inner-speech task can consequently share a text target while testing different capacities for voluntary expression.
blocks.zh: 跨模式的语音图像审查将任务说明和处理路线与信息传输率、在线使用和校准联系起来(Tates等人,2025年;Almufareh等人,2025年)。 以任务为导向的审查进一步将语义或意向目标,电话或音节,单词和句子与输出空间限制和路径区分开来(Zhang等人,2026b.). 这种分离至关重要:语言颗粒性,词汇大小和输出形式没有具体说明参与者做了什么. 明确、内在和感知的条件提供了这种行为区别。 阅读任务和内语任务因此可以在测试不同能力自愿表达的同时共享文本目标.

blocks.en: The EEG-to-text review follows acquisition, signal processing and text-generation pipelines ( Murad and Rahimi, 2025 ) , while the linguistic-decoding review spans perception and production and considers deep models and language-model assistance ( Wang et al., 2025d ) . Generative and foundation-model reviews further connect neural representations, pretraining, alignment and synthesis ( Mai et al., 2025 ; Kuruppu et al., 2026 ; Sümer-Arpak et al., 2026 ) . Their convergence raises an attribution question: what target information is available during training and testing, and which controls isolate the contribution of neural input from language, prompt, candidate-set or peripheral information? Fluency, exact wording and semantic fidelity require distinct evidence; none alone establishes recovery of an unconstrained intended message.
blocks.zh: EEG到文本审查遵循获取,信号处理和文本生成管道(Murad和Rahimi,2025年),而语言解码审查则跨越感知和制作,考虑深层模型和语言模型协助(Wang等人,2025d). 基因和基础模型审查进一步连接神经表达、预训、对齐和合成(Mai等人,2025年;Kuruppu等人,2026年;Sümer-Arpak等人,2026年)。 它们的趋同性提出了一个归属问题:在培训和测试期间有哪些目标信息,哪些控制将神经输入的贡献与语言、即时、候选人设置或外围信息隔离开来? 流利、准确的措辞和语义忠诚要求有明确的证据;没有哪一种证据能够证明收回不受约束的意向信息。

blocks.en: Speech-neuroprosthesis reviews relate cortical mechanisms and recording interfaces to text, voice and communication restoration ( Silva et al., 2024a ; Stavisky, 2025 ; Jhilal et al., 2025 ) . A paralysis-focused systematic review appraises acquisition and AI methods across studies available through 18 September 2025 ( Belfrouh et al., 2026 ) . Reviews of outcomes, recalibration and user control explain why decoder accuracy captures only part of that clinical objective ( Dohle et al., 2025 ; Swanson et al., 2026 ; van Stuijvenberg et al., 2024a ) . Accuracy and stability are properties to evaluate; correction, adaptation and assistance are mechanisms through which users obtain them. Keeping these distinct makes it possible to ask whether an apparent performance gain reduces the burden of communication.
blocks.zh: Speech-neurosthesis评论将皮质机制和录音接口与文本、语音和通信恢复联系起来(Silva等人,2024a;Stavisky,2025;Jhilal等人,2025)。 2025年9月18日前提供的各种研究中以瘫痪为重点的系统审查评估获取和AI方法(Belfrouh等人,2026年)。 对结果、重新校正和用户控制的审查解释了为什么解码器准确性只捕捉到该临床目标的一部分(Dohle等人,2025年;Swanson等人,2026年;van Stuijvenberg等人,2024a年)。 准确性和稳定性是评估的属性;纠正、适应和援助是用户通过这些评估获得评估的机制。 保持这些区别使人们有可能问,明显的绩效收益是否减轻了通信的负担。

blocks.en: The intracranial-language BCI review provides a close account spanning mechanisms, recording choices, experimental design, decoding, evaluation and clinical pathways ( He et al., 2026 ) . The present synthesis brings this integrated perspective into dialogue with non-invasive language decoding, speech imagery and generative modelling. Tasks explain how linguistic activity is elicited; signals explain what can be measured; methods explain how representations are learned and expressed. Evaluation and practical use then connect these capabilities to reliable communication. The resulting comparison highlights reusable representations, complementary output routes and the interaction mechanisms needed to turn technical advances into usable expression.
blocks.zh: 临床内语BCI审查提供了涵盖各种机制的密切叙述,记录选择、实验设计、解码、评价和临床路径(He等人,2026年)。 本综述将这一综合视角引入与非侵入性语言解码,语音图像和基因建模的对话. 任务解释如何引发语言活动;信号解释可以衡量什么;方法解释如何学习和表达表达表达. 然后将这些能力与可靠的通信联系起来。 由此产生的比较突出了可重复使用的表示、互补产出路线以及将技术进步转化为可用表达所需的互动机制。

blocks.en: Table 1: How the present synthesis builds on the closest review perspectives. The third column identifies an additional comparison developed here, not a claim that the preceding review never discusses it. Dates are publication dates unless an evidence window is explicitly stated. The full inventory and checking depth are retained in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 表1:本综合报告如何利用最近的审查观点。 第三栏列出了此处拟订的另一项比较,而不是前次审查从未讨论过的说法。 日期是公布日期,除非明确说明证据窗口。 附录D保留了完整的清单和检查深度。

blocks.en: The search has no lower publication-year limit. The database retrieval used a first-publication cut-off of 15 September 2026; subsequent source-led additions and the registry were updated through 21 September 2026. Earlier foundational studies and reviews are included when they explain a relevant mechanism, recording choice or evaluation practice. The current registry spans 2008–2026; this range describes its retrieved contents rather than an eligibility restriction. The scope spans Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks and invasive and non-invasive recordings. Of 920 canonical registry entries, 246 have selected structured extractions. Registry size describes retrieval breadth, not the number of full-text studies included in a systematic synthesis.
blocks.zh: 搜索没有较低的出版年限。 数据库检索使用2026年9月15日的首次发布截断;随后由来源牵头的添加和登记册更新至2026年9月21日. 早期的基础研究和审查在解释相关机制、记录选择或评价做法时也包括在内。 目前的登记册涵盖2008至2026年;这一范围描述了检索的内容,而不是资格限制。 范围涵盖人工、内幕和感知任务以及侵入性和非侵入性录音。 在920个犬科登记条目中,有246个选择了结构化提取。 登记册大小说明检索宽度,而不是系统综合中包括的全文研究的数目。

blocks.en: 2.3 Search and study selection
blocks.zh: 2.3 搜索和学习选择

blocks.en: Our search reporting is informed by PRISMA-S ( Rethlefsen et al., 2021 ) and the PRISMA 2020 distinction between records, reports and studies ( Page et al., 2021 ) , while making no claim of preregistration or dual independent full-text screening. Twelve Europe PMC query groups and four OpenAlex query groups crossed signal synonyms with speech, phoneme, vowel, word and language terms and with decode, recognise, classify, synthesise, reconstruct and neuroprosthesis terms; separate queries targeted unspoken , attempted , watched and functional ultrasound . All queries were paginated to exhaustion with no start-year restriction and a first-publication cut-off of 15 September 2026. Forward citation tracking was run from 16 seed reviews and key papers; backward tracking used the reference lists of existing surveys and of the fUSI primary literature, with DOIs completed through Crossref. A recall check confirmed that all 44 studies of a prior in-house survey were retrieved.
blocks.zh: 我们的搜索报告来自PRISMA-S(Rethlefsen等人,2021年)和PRISMA 2020对记录、报告和研究的区分(Page等人,2021年),同时没有提出预先登记或双重独立全文筛选的要求。 十二个欧洲PMC查询组和四个OpenAlex查询组用语音、电话、元音、单词和语言术语以及解码、识别、分类、合成、重建和神经假体术语跨越了信号同义词;分别查询针对未发言、尝试、观察和功能超声波。 所有查询均在无起始年限和2026年9月15日首次公布停刊的情况下用尽。 从16份种子评论和关键文件开始进行前置引用跟踪;后置跟踪使用了现有调查和FUSI主要文献的参考清单,通过Crossref完成DOIs. 一次召回检查证实,以前一次内部调查的所有44项研究都已收回。

blocks.en: Database queries retrieved 28,515 records including cross-query duplicates; the initial query hit counts sum to 28,489, with pagination-time updates accounting for the difference in the retrieval log. Citation tracking and DOI/title matching produced a combined set of 20,335 records. Rule-assisted screening retained 774 entries. Author tracing added three records (777 in total), and a reading-route supplement added 36 (813 stable IDs). Both supplements retained the original first-publication cut-off. Linking 18 duplicate reports and publication versions yielded the original 795 canonical entries. The source-led supplement subsequently added 125 eligible report/resource entries, bringing the updated registry to 920 entries. The original search, supplements and version links are documented in Appendix C ; archived aliases preserve their notes. Canonical entries need not represent independent participant cohorts.
blocks.zh: 数据库查询检索了28,515项记录,包括交叉清空重复;初始查询点击数为28,489项,其中pagination-time更新计算了检索日志的差异. 引用跟踪和DOI/标题匹配共产生了20,335个记录的组合. 规则协助筛选保留了774个条目。 作者追踪增加了3个记录(共计777个),一个读道补充增加了36个(813个稳定的ID). 两份补编都保留了最初的首次出版停刊。 将18份重复报告和出版版本链接起来,产生了795条犬科的原始条目。 来源牵头的补编随后增加了125个合格报告/资源条目,使更新后的登记册有920个条目。 原始搜索、补充和版本链接载于附录C;存档别名保留其笔记。 Canonical条目不必代表独立的参与者组群.

blocks.en: A separate search on 18 September 2026 targeted reviews available from 2024 onwards, combining review terms with language tasks, speech neuroprostheses and recording modalities. Three fully paginated Europe PMC queries returned 3,970 hits and 3,942 unique records; fifteen Crossref queries, limited to their top 75 results, yielded 921 unique DOIs. Publisher and repository searches and backward tracking supplemented discovery. Screening titles, abstracts and targeted sections produced a 73-entry inventory: 30 directly relevant reviews, 37 adjacent reviews, two chapters, two perspectives and two candidates. The comparison cites the 30 direct reviews and 16 contextual sources ( Appendix D ). These review-only records do not increase the primary-study counts. Exact queries, source links, publication status and checking depth are retained in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 2026年9月18日进行单独搜索,从2024年起提供定向审查,将审查术语与语言任务,语音神经假肢和录音方式相结合. 3个完全Pagized Europe PMC查询返回了3,970个点击率和3,942个独有的记录;15个Crossref查询(仅限于其前75个结果)产生了921个独有的DOIs. 出版商和仓库搜索和后向跟踪补充了发现。 筛选题目、摘要和定向部分编有73个条目:30个直接相关的审查、37个相邻的审查、两个章节、两个观点和两个候选人。 比较引用了30项直接审查和16项背景资料来源(附录D)。 这些只审查记录不会增加初等学习的计数。 准确的查询,源链接,出版状况和检查深度保留在补编中.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Literature retrieval, the updated registry and manuscript citation coverage. (a) The original retrieval and supplements produced 813 retained IDs and 795 canonical entries after publication-version consolidation. (b) Source-led additions bring the registry to 920 report/resource entries, including 246 with selected structured fields. (c) The active manuscript cites 448 distinct references: 317 in the main text and 131 only in appendices; 354 are linked to registry entries and 94 provide contextual reviews, foundations or adjacent evidence. The footer counts citations in the 8 Methods comparison figures separately from the communication-cost result rows. References, reports, resources, experimental conditions and participants are different counting units. Publication versions are linked; companion data releases and articles can describe the same acquisition.
blocks.zh: 图 1:文学检索,更新的登记和手稿引用报道. (a) 原始检索和补编在出版版合并后,制作了813个保留身份证和795个条条。 (b) 源头带动的添加使登记册达到920份报告/资源条目,包括246个有选定结构化领域的条目。 (c) 现行手稿引用了448个不同的参考文献:主文317个,附录131个;354个与登记册条目有关,94个提供了背景审查、基础或相邻证据。 页脚计算8方法比较数字中与通信成本结果行的引用。 参考文献,报告,资源,实验条件和参与者是不同的计数单位. 出版物版本是链接的;配套数据发布和文章可以描述同样的获取.

blocks.en: On 19–21 September 2026, source-led searches examined all 47 subsections and subsubsections from Tasks through Limitations, together with the five prospective Beyond targets. Three research agents covered tasks/signals, methods, and evaluation/use; each recorded topic-specific discovery and focused follow-up queries, source locations and reading depth. Backward and forward source-led searches sought foundational work, independent approaches and recent developments and updated the synthesis through 21 September 2026. Overlapping reports and publication versions were reconciled before integration. The first thematic pass added 48 cited sources; subsequent dataset, method and evaluation searches extended this set. Sources include neural-language reports and resources as well as methodological foundations and contextual BCI research. A source-led update on 20 September added targeted searches for neural language representations, generative MEG-to-text, shared decoding benchmarks and reported communication costs. Eligible reports and citable resources have been backfilled into the registry, with source locations and coding provenance preserved. Reviews, generic metrics and contextual user studies remain references rather than additions to the primary report/resource census. A unified citation ledger links each active reference to its registry identity where applicable ( Figure 1 ). Quantitative comparison tables retain the original paper, test condition, metric and source location; their figures reproduce reported results without new decoder experiments. Targeted citation tracking supplements the database search but is not dual independent human screening.
blocks.zh: 2026年9月19日至21日,由来源牵头的搜索检查了通过限制完成任务的所有47个小节和小节,以及五个预期的Beyond目标。 3名研究人员负责任务/信号、方法和评价/使用;他们各自记录了特定专题的发现和重点跟踪查询、来源地点和阅读深度。 前后源领导的搜索寻求基础工作、独立办法和最新动态,并更新综合到2026年9月21日。 在整合之前对重叠报告和出版版本进行了核对。 第一个专题通行证增加了48个引用来源;随后的数据集,方法和评价搜索扩展了这个数据集. 资料来源包括神经语言报告和资源以及方法基础和背景的BCI研究。 9月20日,由信息来源牵头的更新增加了针对神经语言表达、基因化的MEG到文字、共享的解码基准和报告通信成本的定向搜索。 合格报告和可消费资源已回填入登记册,保留了来源地点和编码来源。 审查、通用衡量尺度和用户背景研究仍然是参考文献,而不是对初级报告/资源普查的补充。 一个统一的引用分类账在适用的情况下将每个主动引用与其登记处身份联系起来(图1)。 定量比较表保留了原始纸张,测试条件,度量和源位;其数字转载了所报告的结果,但没有进行新的解码实验. 定向引用跟踪是对数据库搜索的补充,但不是双重独立的人类筛选.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evidence extraction and source verification
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 证据提取和来源核查

blocks.en: The 246 selected entries contain task, recording, output or resource fields used in the synthesis. Their recorded provenance comprises 10 full-text checks, 65 abstract checks, 39 inherited extractions with metadata rechecked, and 132 targeted source-field checks. Targeted checks cover both newly added sources and previously indexed reports examined in greater detail. These categories describe the recorded depth of source use; checking selected fields does not amount to a whole-paper risk-of-bias appraisal. The remaining 674 entries retain bibliographic and available label information. Selection was neither random nor a prespecified risk-of-bias stratum.
blocks.zh: 246个选定的条目包含合成中使用的任务,记录,输出或资源字段. 其记录的来源包括10次全文检查、65次抽象检查、39次元数据重新检查的继承提取以及132次定向源域检查。 目标明确的检查既包括新增加的来源,也包括过去更详细地审查的索引报告。 这些类别描述了记录的源使用深度;检查选定的字段并不等于是全纸的偏见风险评估。 其余674个条目保留了书目和现有的标签信息。 选择既不是随机的,也不是预先确定的风险。

blocks.en: Abstract-derived descriptions are treated as author-reported claims. The source-check table in Table 25 separately states source locations and supporting evidence for selected conclusions; checking one claim does not verify every result in its paper or its complete methodological description. Cohort links are retained where known, with missing links treated as unknown rather than as proof of independent participants. The completed database retrieval used Europe PMC and OpenAlex, complemented by publisher, preprint and conference sources and source-led citation tracking. Native-platform access attempts on 20 September did not produce exportable Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore or ACM DL search results; the access outcomes are recorded with the queries. These platforms are therefore not counted as completed searches. Non-English coverage and citation tracking are incomplete. The documented search supports a broad critical synthesis, without establishing exhaustive retrieval.
blocks.zh: 摘要衍生的说明作为作者报告的索赔处理。 表25中的来源核对表分别列出了来源地点和选定结论的佐证证据;核对一项索赔没有核实其文件中的每一项结果或其完整的方法说明。 串联链接在已知的地方保留,缺失环节被视为未知而非独立参与者的证明. 已完成的数据库检索使用欧洲PMC和OpenAlex,辅之以出版商、预印本和会议来源以及来源引导的引用跟踪。 9月20日的原生平台访问尝试没有产生可导出Scopus,Web of Science,IEEE Xplore或ACM DL搜索结果;访问结果与查询一起记录. 因此,这些平台不计为已完成的搜索. 非英语报道和引用跟踪不完整. 所记录的搜索支持广泛的批判性综合,而不建立详尽的检索。

blocks.en: 2.5 Corpus coverage
blocks.zh: 2.5 公司保险

blocks.en:
The registry updated through 21 September 2026 contains 920 canonical report/resource entries and 18 archived publication aliases, which are excluded from corpus totals. The update adds 125 entries to the original 795-entry collection. Of the current entries, 246 have selected structured fields: 10 from the earlier full-text checks, 65 from abstract checks, 39 from inherited extractions with metadata rechecked and 132 from subsequent targeted source checks. The remaining 674 entries retain bibliographic and available label information. These provenance labels describe source checking, not a risk-of-bias rating or a ranking of decoder performance. The registry preserves original task labels for traceability; these are not assignments to the three operational groups in this survey. A total of 747 entries carry at least one of the eight grouped signal labels. The multi-label signal counts are EEG 503, MEG 67, ECoG 65, intracortical/spikes 31, sEEG 26, fMRI 51, fUSI 19 and fNIRS/HD-DOT 24. The registry spans 2008–2026, with no lower-year eligibility limit: 409 entries precede 2024 and 511 date from 2024–2026. A paper and a separately citable data deposit can describe the same acquisition; neither report counts nor resource counts imply independent cohorts. These are counts within a selectively assembled index with incomplete labels, not prevalence estimates of the field.
 The distributions in Figure 2 combine publication-year coverage, signal labels, output scopes and source-checking provenance. Labels are multi-valued: a report can use several signals or study more than one output. Unassigned fields therefore remain distinct from negative findings. The companion registry preserves the original task labels and links later source-field checks to the reports or resources they describe.
blocks.zh:
截止2026年9月21日更新的登记册载有920份犬科报告/资源条目和18份存档出版物别名,这些别名被排除在实体总数之外。 更新版在原795条目集中增加了125个条目. 在目前的条目中,有246项选择了结构化字段:10项来自早先的全文检查,65项来自抽象检查,39项来自元数据重新检查的继承提取,132项来自随后的目标来源检查。 其余674个条目保留了书目和现有的标签信息。 这些出处标签描述的是源头检查,而不是比分风险评级或解码器性能排名. 登记册保留原有的任务标签,以便追踪;这些标签不是本次调查中分配给三个业务组的。 共有747个条目至少携带了8个分组信号标签中的一个. 多标签信号计数为EEG 503,MEG 67,ECoG 65,内部/spikes 31,SEEG 26,fMRI 51,fUSI 19和fNIRS/HD-DOT 24. 登记册涵盖2008至2026年,没有下年资格限制:2024年之前有409个条目,2024至2026年起有511个条目。 纸质和单独的可计量数据存单可以描述相同的购置;报告计数或资源计数都意味着独立组别。 这些都是有选择地编组的指数中的计数,标签不完整,而不是实地的流行率估计数。
图2中的发行量结合了出版年覆盖量,信号标签,输出范围以及源头检查来源. 标签是多值的:报告可以使用多个信号或者研究多个输出. 因此,未分配的领域仍然不同于负面调查结果。 伴行登记册保存原始任务标签,并将后来的源域检查与它们描述的报告或资源链接起来。

blocks.en: The accompanying workbook and study exports contain the search queries, screening decisions, study descriptions and linked publication versions. The exports also identify where each study is discussed in the manuscript. The artifact index links the current workbook, citation ledger, source-value tables and search records. The reference list gives the cited works, and Appendix C summarises the search and targeted supplements.
blocks.zh: 随附的工作手册和研究出口包含查询、筛选决定、研究说明和链接的出版物版本。 出口还指明了手稿中讨论每项研究的地方。 文物索引将当前工作手册、引用分类账、源值表和搜索记录链接起来。 参考列表给出了引用的作品,附录C概括了搜索和定向补充.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Publication years, signal families and output coverage in the updated registry. (a) Annual counts of canonical report/resource entries, with structured fields highlighted. (b) Output and study-scope labels by year among the extracted entries. (c) Signal-family counts across the registry; ECoG includes micro-ECoG, fNIRS includes HD-DOT, and intracortical includes spike recordings. (d) Source-checking provenance by signal: full-text, abstract, inherited extraction, targeted source-field checks and bibliographic metadata. (e) Signal–output and signal–study-scope pairs among the extracted entries. The registry is updated through 21 September 2026; the asterisk marks a partial year. Heatmaps use separate count scales and blank cells denote zero assigned pairs. Labels overlap, and companion articles or data deposits may share acquisitions. These distributions describe the indexed collection, including adjacent evidence, rather than independent cohorts or field-wide success rates.
blocks.zh: 图2:更新登记册中的出版年份、信号家庭和产出覆盖率。 (a) 每年清点犬科报告/资源条目,突出结构化领域。 (b) 提取的条目按年份列出输出和研究范围标签。 (c) 整个登记册的信号-家庭计数;ECoG包括微型-ECoG,FNIRS包括HD-DOT,内部包括悬赏录音。 (d) 通过信号检查来源:全文、摘要、继承的提取、定向源域检查和书目元数据。 (e) 抽取的条目中的信号-输出和信号-研究镜对。 登记册更新至2026年9月21日;星号为部分年份。 海atmaps使用单独的计数尺度,空白单元格表示零分配对数. 标签重叠,随附文章或数据存储可能共享收购. 这些分布描述的是索引汇编,包括相邻证据,而不是独立组群或全外地的成功率。

blocks.en: 3 Tasks
blocks.zh: 3 项任务

blocks.en: 3.1 Intended users and communication needs
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 预定用户和通信需求

blocks.en: Brain-to-language tasks investigate how people produce, internally formulate and perceive language. In communication restoration, the goal is to convey a person’s chosen message through an alternative to audible speech. In perception research, the presented speech or text supplies a known target for studying neural representations and training decoders ( Moses et al., 2021 ; Willett et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Hollenstein et al., 2018 ) . These aims create different experimental opportunities: production connects decoding to voluntary expression, whereas controlled presentation makes language content and timing available for systematic comparison.
blocks.zh: 脑对语言任务调查人们如何生产,内部形成和感知语言. 在恢复通信方面,目标是通过非声波演讲方式传达一个人选定的信息。 在感知研究中,介绍的演讲或文字为研究神经表达论和培训解码器提供了已知的目标(摩西等人,2021年;威利特等人,2023年;唐等人,2023年;霍伦斯坦等人,2018年). 这些目标创造了不同的实验机会:生产将解码与自愿表达联系起来,而受控的呈现则使语言内容和时间可供系统比较.

blocks.en: Prospective users help determine which tasks matter. Interviews with people with locked-in syndrome identified communication, computer access and environmental control as desired applications, alongside preferences for active control; surveys of people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis examined setup, training and interface requirements ( Branco et al., 2021 ; Huggins et al., 2011 ) . These findings make initiation, message choice and manageable operating effort central design considerations. Requirements vary across populations and available movements, so an experimental vocabulary should be chosen in relation to a communication goal.
blocks.zh: 未来用户帮助确定哪些任务很重要. 与锁定综合症患者的访谈确认,通信、计算机接入和环境控制是理想的应用,同时对主动控制有偏好;对肌萎缩性横向硬化患者的调查审查了设置、培训和接口要求(Branco等人,2021年;Huggins等人,2011年)。 这些调查结果将启动、信息选择和可管理的业务努力作为设计考虑的中心。 要求因人群和可用的移动而异,因此应该结合通信目标选择一个实验词汇.

blocks.en: Articulated, Inner and Perceived conditions distinguish actual articulation, internal speech production or simulation, and perception of externally presented language. The distinction matters because the same target word can be heard, read, imagined or attempted, with different sources of supervision and feedback. These are operational definitions for conditions, not classifications of diseases, devices or model architectures. A participant or study may contribute several conditions. The groups establish what changes in a task comparison; they do not assume that the underlying neural representations are disjoint. Clinical attempts without established residual movement remain in scope under the explicit descriptor attempted speech ; they are not automatically assigned to Articulated or Inner.
blocks.zh: 直译,内含和透视条件区分实际表达,内部语音制作或模拟,以及外界呈现语言的感知. 这种区分很重要,因为同一个目标词可以被听到,读,想象或尝试,有不同的监督和反馈来源. 这些是对病情的操作定义,而不是对疾病、装置或模型结构的分类。 参与者或研究可提供若干条件。 这些小组确定任务比较中有哪些变化;他们并不认为基本神经表达是脱节的。 未经确定剩余移动的临床尝试仍属于明确描述的言语企图的范围;这些尝试并非自动分配给Articuled或Inner。

blocks.en: Table 2: Three task groups and nine subtypes distinguish executed articulation, internal simulation and externally presented language. Limited requires residual articulation; Mixed requires evidence of both imagery strategies.
blocks.zh: 表2:三个任务组和九个子类型区分已执行的表达式,内部模拟和外部呈现的语言. (b) 混合需要两种图像战略的证据。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Task conditions distinguish producing language, simulating speech and perceiving a linguistic input. Overt and Mouthed involve executed articulation; Inner involves instructed internal simulation; listening and reading provide external language. The lower panel compares the three groups by execution and content source. Clinical attempts without confirmed residual articulation remain explicitly qualified. Instructions alone do not establish absence of muscle activity; a written cue before imagery does not make that later interval a Reading task.
blocks.zh: 图3:任务条件区分产生语言,模拟语音和感知语言输入. Outt和Moothed涉及已执行的表达;内部涉及指示的内部模拟;倾听和阅读提供外部语言。 下层面板通过执行和内容来源来比较这三组. 未经确认的剩余配方的临床尝试仍具有明确的资格。 单凭指令并不能确定没有肌肉活动;在图像出现之前的书面提示不会使以后的间隔成为阅读任务.

blocks.en: 3.2 Articulated: Overt, Mouthed and Limited
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 说明:公开、口腔和有限

blocks.en: This group requires actual speech-articulator movement. Overt denotes audible speech with executed articulation; Mouthed denotes executed articulation without audible speech; Limited denotes attempted speech with documented residual articulation under motor impairment. Limited describes residual execution, not vocabulary size or decoding accuracy. For impaired attempts with residual articulation, Limited describes the motor condition and voicing is specified separately. Attempted speech is a source task description, not an automatic synonym for Limited. Attempts without observable articulation, or with insufficient behavioural reporting, remain explicitly qualified boundary cases outside confirmed Articulated membership. Absence of observable movement does not turn a motor attempt into Inner speech ( Kunz et al., 2025 ; Jude et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 这个组需要实际的语音解析器运动. 直截了当地表示用已执行的拼音发音; 口音表示用未执行的拼音发音发音发音发音; 有限地表示在运动障碍下用有记录的剩余拼音发音发音发音的企图发音发音。 有限描述了剩余执行,而不是词汇大小或解码精度. 对于残损的尝试,Limited描述了运动状态,发票另行说明。 尝试语音是一个源任务描述,而不是Limited的自动同义词. 没有可观察到的表述或行为报告不足的尝试,仍然是在经证实的假身份之外明确限定的边界案件。 缺乏可见的运动不会将运动尝试转化为内语(Kunz等人,2025年;Jude等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Overt production can supply a participant’s acoustic target for learning and alignment; Mouthed retains execution while removing audible speech. Limited can retain movement without intelligible production, as in clinical attempted-speech decoding ( Willett et al., 2023 ) . Transfer across these conditions must therefore account for differences in target availability and sensory feedback, alongside residual execution. Audible whispering is recorded as Overt with absent voicing: acoustic audibility and vocal-fold voicing are separate descriptors. Evidence from long-standing anarthria motivates studying retained articulation, but participant comparisons also differ in neural coverage, training and disease history ( Jude et al., 2026 ) . Those comparisons cannot isolate the effect of movement by themselves. The clinical reports in Table 10 retain the source term attempted when residual movement is not established for that condition.
blocks.zh: 公开制作可以提供参与者的声学目标,用于学习和校正; 口音保留执行,同时去除可听的语音. 有限责任公司可以保持移动,而不进行不易懂的生产,例如在临床尝试的语音解码(Willett等人,2023年)。 因此,在进行剩余执行的同时,跨越这些条件的转移必须考虑到目标可用性和感知反馈方面的差异。 可听的耳语被记录为Overt和缺席的语音:声调可听和声倍的语音是单独的描述词. 长期以来的Anarthria的证据促使人们研究保留表述,但参与者的比较在神经覆盖、培训和疾病史方面也有所不同(Jude等人,2026年)。 这些比较不能孤立流动的影响。 表10中的临床报告保留了未确定残留迁移情况时的源词。

blocks.en: Direct comparisons help explain the relationship between these modes. Intracranial recordings during overt, mouthed and imagined speech reveal shared but non-equivalent activity and cross-mode speech-activity decoding ( Soroush et al., 2023 ) . Overt production also reveals coordinated population representations of the articulators ( Bouchard et al., 2013 ) . Shared production structure provides a basis for transfer, while mode-specific timing and sensory feedback explain why transfer is a learning problem in its own right.
blocks.zh: 直接比较有助于解释这些模式之间的关系. 公开、口述和想象的演讲期间的内幕录音揭示了共同但非等同的活动和跨模式的演讲-活动解码(Soroush等人,2023年)。 公开制作还揭示了动画师协调一致的人口代表性(Bouchard等人,2013年)。 共享生产结构为转移提供了基础,而模式特定的时间和感知反馈则解释了转移本身为何是一个学习问题.

blocks.en: 3.3 Inner: Articulatory, Auditory and Mixed
blocks.zh: 3.3 内部:艺术、审计和混合

blocks.en: This group comprises internally generated or simulated speech without an attempt to execute speech-articulator movements. Articulatory emphasises the imagined movement or feeling of speaking; Auditory emphasises imagined speech sounds, including one’s own or another person’s voice; Mixed requires an explicit combination of both strategies. Speech-BCI studies use inner, covert and imagined as overlapping names ( Martin et al., 2016 ; Bhadra et al., 2025 ; Kunz et al., 2025 ) . Covert conditions involving actual mouthing belong under Articulated. Mixed denotes a reported combination, not an unspecified strategy. Instructions define the task, while electromyography (EMG) or motion monitoring separately assesses compliance and peripheral contributions.
blocks.zh: 这个组由内部生成的或模拟的语音组成,没有试图执行语音编解运动. 语言学强调想象中的动作或说话的感觉; 语言学强调想象中的语音,包括自己或他人的声音; 混合需要两种战略的明确结合。 Speech-BCI研究使用内在,隐蔽和想象为重叠名称(Martin等人,2016年;Bhadra等人,2025年;Kunz等人,2025年)。 涉及实际口腔的隐蔽条件属于经说明的。 混合表示报告的组合,而不是未说明的战略。 指令定义了任务,而电传记学(EMG)或运动监测则分别评估合规性和外围贡献.

blocks.en: The articulatory–auditory distinction has an experimental basis. MEG studies separately instructed participants to imagine pronouncing a syllable and to imagine hearing a voice; subsequent fMRI work examined motor-simulation and memory-retrieval routes to perceptual reactivation ( Tian and Poeppel, 2010 ; Tian et al., 2016 ) . These routes can lead to related auditory experiences through different internal strategies.
blocks.zh: 动脉 - 审计区分有实验基础. MEG的研究分别指示参与者想象一个音节的发音,并想象听到一个声音;随后fMRI的工作考察了运动-模拟和记忆-检索到知觉恢复的路线(Tian and Poepel, 2010;Tian等人,2016). 这些路线可以通过不同的内部策略导致相关的听觉体验.

blocks.en: Inner speech offers a way to express content without executing articulation. Real-time intracortical decoding of cued inner sentences enabled self-paced production in severely dysarthric participants, who reported less physical effort; shared but distinguishable attempted- and inner-speech representations supported cross-task learning ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) . This result links an internal linguistic process to an observable communication channel. Extending the channel to independently chosen messages adds a further challenge: the intended content is no longer supplied by the experimental prompt, so both reference collection and decoder training must accommodate it.
blocks.zh: 内部演讲提供了一种表达内容而不执行表达的方式. 实时对提示式内语句进行内部解码,使得严重乏味的参与者能够自行节奏生产,他们报告说体力较低;共享但可区分的尝试式和内语表述支持跨任务学习(Kunz等人,2025年)。 这一结果将内部语言过程与可观察到的交流渠道联系起来。 将频道扩展至独立选择的信息又增加了一个挑战:预期内容不再由实验性提示提供,因此参考文献的收集与解码培训都必须适应.

blocks.en: Articulatory and auditory imagery describe how an inner utterance is generated. Inner experience also varies in condensation, dialogality, intentionality and prosody, so rehearsing an expanded prompted sentence samples only part of this broader capacity ( Grandchamp et al., 2019 ; Dahò and Monzani, 2025 ; Alexander and Stark, 2024 ; Kreiner and Eviatar, 2024 ) . Speech-imagery reviews document heterogeneous elicitation and recording protocols ( Tates et al., 2025 ; Almufareh et al., 2025 ) . Retaining the instruction, content source and behavioural monitoring alongside the subtype connects these cognitive dimensions to reproducible decoding tasks.
blocks.zh: 演算和听觉图像描述了内在的表达方式。 内部经验在凝聚性,对话性,有意性和亲和性上也各不相同,因此重排一个扩大的促动句子样本,只是这一更广泛容量的一部分(Grandchamp等人,2019年;Dahò and Monzani,2025年;Alexander and Stark,2024年;Kreiner and Eviatar,2024年). 语音图像学审查文件不同诱导和记录协议(Tates等人,2025年;Almufareh等人,2025年)。 保留指令,内容源和行为监测与子类型一起,将这些认知维度连接到可复制的解码任务上.

blocks.en: 3.4 Perceived: Auditory, Visual and Audiovisual
blocks.zh: 3.4 观点:审计、视觉和视听

blocks.en: Perceived concerns externally presented language. Auditory denotes heard speech; Visual includes written-language Reading and visible-articulation Lip-reading; Audiovisual combines auditory and visual language input. Reading and Lip-reading are task descriptors within Visual, not additional top-level groups. ZuCo reading EEG therefore belongs to Perceived–Visual ( Hollenstein et al., 2018 ; Hollenstein et al., 2020 ) . Reading may engage inner speech, but the presence of printed language alone does not establish an instructed Inner condition. Conversely, a written cue followed by an instructed speech attempt or imagery interval does not make that later interval a reading-decoding task.
blocks.zh: 外界提出的关切。 校对:Soup 阅读和唇读是Visual内部的任务描述符,而不是额外的顶级组. ZuCo读EEG因此属于Perceived-Visual(Hollenstein等人,2018年;Hollenstein等人,2020年). 阅读可能涉及内语,但单凭印刷语言的存在并不能确定指示的内语条件. 反之,在指示的语音尝试或图像间隔之后的书面提示不会使以后的间隔成为读解码任务.

blocks.en: Imagining a voice belongs to Inner–Auditory. Visible objects or silent scenes without a linguistic target remain outside Perceived–Visual; movie-based matching is language decoding only when the evaluated target is language. Audiovisual speech representation, for example, includes the interaction of heard phonemes and visible articulation ( Li et al., 2026c ) . These distinctions preserve the difference between input modality and output meaning.
blocks.zh: 想象一个声音属于内-审计. 没有语言目标的可见物体或无声场景仍然在Perceived–Visual之外;基于电影的匹配是语言解码,只有在被评价的目标为语言时才进行. 例如,视听语音表述包括听觉电话和可见表达的相互作用(Li等人,2026c.)。 这些区分保留了输入模式和输出含义之间的区别.

blocks.en: Perceived tasks also reveal transformations across sensory inputs. During silent lipreading, MEG responses carry information about unheard acoustic features beyond that explained by visible lip trajectories, while fMRI and intracranial recordings distinguish lipread word identities in auditory cortex ( Bröhl et al., 2022 ; Karthik et al., 2024 ) . Visual therefore names the presented input, not a restriction to visual brain regions. Feature tracking and word discrimination illuminate this shared representation at different levels.
blocks.zh: 感知的任务也揭示了各种感官输入的转变. 在无声唇读音过程中,MEG的回复中包含了一些信息,说明除了由可见的唇轨所解释的外,没有听到的声学特征,而fMRI和颅内录制则在听觉皮层中区分了唇读字特征(Bröhl等人,2022年;Karthik等人,2024年)。 因此,可视化将所呈现的输入命名,而不是限制视觉脑区域. 特征跟踪和文字歧视揭示了在各级的这种共同代表性。

blocks.en: Presented language provides a known target and timing, making Perceived tasks useful for studying neural representations and learning decoder components. The value can extend beyond stimulus reconstruction: an fMRI decoder trained during listening was also evaluated during imagined storytelling, with semantic agreement assessed against separately recorded accounts ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . That result motivates cross-task learning while locating the achievement at the tested semantic target and protocol. Shared information between tasks is a resource for transfer; the fidelity and user control required for a communication interface still need to be established in its intended task.
blocks.zh: 呈现的语言提供了已知的目标和时间,使得感知任务对研究神经表达和学习解码器组件有用. 价值可以超越刺激重建:在想象故事讲述期间,还评估了在倾听过程中培训的fMRI解码器,根据单独记录的账户评估语义协议(Tang等人,2023年)。 这一结果激励了跨任务学习,同时将成就定位在经过测试的语义目标和协议上. 任务之间的共享信息是一种传输资源;通信接口所需的忠诚性和用户控制仍需在其预定任务中确定。

blocks.en: 3.5 Task instructions, cues and behavioural verification
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家 任务指示、提示和行为核查

blocks.en: Content may be externally specified or self-generated; internal speech may be instructed or spontaneously occurring; items may be produced once or repeatedly. These dimensions can combine and are not additional subtypes. Cue modality, preparation intervals, residual sound and movement supply additional context; peripheral monitoring tests compliance with the instruction. A pre-articulatory window preceding an overt utterance is not automatically Inner or clinical attempted speech ( Dash et al., 2020 ; Dash et al., 2024 ) . Figure 3 shows the task ingredients implied by the definitions, not measured neural strengths.
blocks.zh: 内容可以由外部指定或自行产生;内部讲话可以指示或自发发生;物品可以一次或多次制作. 这些维度可以结合,而不是额外的子类型. Cue模式、准备间隔、剩余声音和移动供应等附加上下文;外围监测测试遵守指令的情况。 公开言论之前的预演窗口并非自动内幕或临床尝试演讲(Dash等人,2020年;Dash等人,2024年). 图3显示了定义所隐含的任务成分,而非测量的神经强度.

blocks.en: Auxiliary recordings help characterise how a participant performs the task. A preregistered experiment found that facial EMG distinguished phonetic classes during overt speech but did not establish comparable group-level discrimination during instructed inner speech; increased activity relative to rest was not itself specific to speech content ( Nalborczyk et al., 2020 ) . The useful analysis therefore relates peripheral activity to the instruction and linguistic target. Exact cue sequences, imagery instructions and control channels allow later studies to reproduce that comparison.
blocks.zh: 辅助录音有助于描述参与者如何完成任务。 一项预先注册的实验发现,面部EMG在公开演讲中区分了语音课,但在指示内语中并没有确立类似的群体层面歧视;相对于休息的增量活动本身并非专门针对语言内容(Nalborczyk等人,2020年). 因此,有益的分析将外围活动与教学和语言目标联系起来。 精确的提示序列、图像指示和控制通道允许以后的研究复制这种比较。

blocks.en: Task transfer can change the neural activity being decoded, the source of the message, or both. Each change requires its own test. To distinguish a cue-dependent result from decoding of a later attempt or imagery interval, useful tests vary the cue–target mapping and evaluate the later interval separately. Temporal separation should reflect the signal’s physiological response and any carry-over from the cue; separating epochs alone does not establish independence ( Sections 4 and 6 ). A claim of self-generated expression additionally requires user-chosen content that is unavailable to the decoder, together with a means of checking whether the output conveys the intended message. Such tests target the dependency being removed, rather than treating a change of task name as evidence of transfer.
blocks.zh: 任务传输可以改变被解码的神经活动,消息的来源,或者两者兼而有之. 每个变化都需要自己的考验. 为了区分一个基于线索的结果与后期尝试或图像间隔的解码,有用的测试会改变线索-目标映射并分别评价后期间隔. 时间上的分离应反映信号的生理反应和任何从提示中结转过来的情况;单独分离的时代不能确立独立性(第4和6节)。 声称自己生成的表达方式,还需要解码器无法获取的用户选择的内容,以及检查输出是否传达了预期信息的手段. 这种测试的目标是消除依赖,而不是将任务名称的改变作为转移的证据。

blocks.en: 4 Signals
blocks.zh: 4个信号

blocks.en: Neural recording provides complementary views of language processing. Electrical and magnetic measurements resolve rapid population dynamics; haemodynamic measurements capture spatially structured vascular responses over longer intervals. Within each family, placement and coverage determine which linguistic processes are most accessible. Choosing a signal therefore connects a scientific target—such as articulatory movement, speech sounds or contextual meaning—to a feasible recording configuration and timescale.
blocks.zh: 神经录制提供了语言处理的补充观点. 电磁测量能解决快速的人口动态;血动力测量能通过较长的间隔捕捉空间结构的血管反应. 在每个家庭中,安置和覆盖决定了哪些语言过程最容易使用。 因此,选择一个信号将科学目标——如动画运动、语音或上下文含义——与可行的记录配置和时间尺度联系起来。

blocks.en: Table 3: Temporal and spatial scales in representative neural-recording configurations. Values describe the cited studies, rather than universal family limits. Sampling intervals, feature windows and vascular response dynamics describe different stages; contact pitch and voxel size specify sampling geometry, rather than independently measured functional localisation.
blocks.zh: 表3:代表性神经记录配置中的时空尺度. 价值描述的是所引用的研究,而不是家庭的普遍限制。 采样间隔,特征窗口和血管反应动力学描述不同阶段;接触投子和阴道大小指定采样几何,而不是独立测量的功能定位.

blocks.en: 4.1 Neural representations of language
blocks.zh: 4.1 语言的神经表达

blocks.en: Language tasks recruit overlapping systems while placing different demands on them: producing a word requires a plan for its form and articulation, hearing it requires interpreting an acoustic event, and reading it requires identifying a visual form. Across these tasks, words acquire meaning through their relationships to surrounding words and the broader situation. The useful unit for neural decoding is therefore a task-dependent representation in a sampled population, rather than a fixed correspondence between one brain region and one linguistic function. Figure 4 connects representative observations to the output interfaces developed from them.
blocks.zh: 语言任务招聘重叠的系统,同时对它们提出不同的要求:一个单词的产生需要计划其形式和表达,听觉需要解释一个音响事件,阅读需要识别一个视觉形式. 在这些任务中,文字通过与周围文字的关系和更广泛的情况而获得意义。 因此,神经解码的有用单位是在抽样人群中依赖于任务的代表,而不是一个脑区和一个语言功能之间的固定对应. 图4将代表性观测与它们开发的输出界面联系起来.

blocks.en: Speech production combines the construction of an utterance with coordination of the vocal tract. Cortical-surface recordings over ventral sensorimotor cortex reveal overlapping representations of the lips, tongue, jaw and larynx; their population activity changes as these articulators combine into speech sounds ( Bouchard et al., 2013 ) . This organization provides a basis for predicting articulatory or acoustic trajectories from neural activity. Planning also carries structure before a movement or sound occurs. Acute single-neuron recordings in the language-dominant posterior middle frontal gyrus distinguish the phonetic composition, order and syllabification of upcoming words ( Khanna et al., 2024 ) . More extensive frontotemporal recordings resolve grammatical relationships, phrase structure and contextual semantic information before word utterance ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . These studies distinguish the information needed to construct a word sequence from the information needed to execute its articulation, while showing that both involve distributed, mixed population codes. Accordingly, recording placement influences whether a decoder has direct access to phonetic planning, articulatory dynamics or higher-level sentence organization.
blocks.zh: 语音制作结合了语音的构建与声道的协调. 口腔感官皮层上的表面记录揭示了唇、舌、下巴和喉部的重叠表现;随着这些动脉结合到语音中,其人口活动发生了变化(Bouchard等人,2013年)。 这个组织为预测神经活动的动脉或声学轨迹提供了基础. 在运动或声音发生之前,规划还带有结构。 语言占优势的后期中锋陀螺的急性单中子录音区分了即将出现的单词的语音组成,顺序和音节(Khanna等人,2024年). 更为广泛的前传录音能解决语法关系,短语结构和语义信息在单词表达前(Cai等人,2026年). 这些研究将构建一个词序所需的信息与实施其表达所需的信息区分开来,同时表明两者都涉及分布式混合人口代码. 因此,记录放置会影响解码器是否直接接触语音规划,动脉动态或更高层次的句子组织.

blocks.en: During listening, superior temporal gyrus responses distinguish acoustic–phonetic features through sensitivity to spectrotemporal cues in continuous speech ( Mesgarani et al., 2014 ) . Such responses motivate acoustic reconstruction and speech-feature alignment, because the predicted target preserves aspects of the sound that elicited the activity. Comprehension additionally represents what a word means in context. Voxelwise models of narrative-listening fMRI reveal semantic selectivity across bilateral temporal, parietal and prefrontal territories ( Huth et al., 2016 ) . At a different scale, single neurons in left posterior middle frontal cortex respond to word meanings in ways that change with the sentence context, rather than simply following phonetic form ( Jamali et al., 2024 ) . Thus, contextual semantic information is accessible both in local spiking and in distributed haemodynamic measurements; it is not a property exclusive to one recording family. Conversely, a shared recording region need not imply identical task codes: the posterior frontal neurons selective for heard phonetic content were largely distinct from those selective during speech planning in a within-study task comparison ( Khanna et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在聆听过程中,超强的时态陀螺反应通过连续语音对光谱时空提示的敏感性来区分声学-声学特征(Mesgarani等人,2014年)。 这种反应激励了声学重建和语音特征的调整,因为预测的目标保留了引起活动的声音的各个方面。 理解还代表了一个词在上下文中的含义。 Voxelwise模式的叙事-listing fMRI 揭示了跨双边时间、边疆和前边领地的语义选择性(Huth等人,2016年)。 在不同的尺度上,左后卫中锋皮层的单神经元以随句语上下文变化的方式响应词义,而不是简单地遵循语音形式(Jamali等人,2024年). 因此,在局部溢出和分布的血动力测量中都可以获取语义信息;它并非一个录制家庭独有的财产。 反之,共享录制区域不一定意味着相同的任务代码:在学习内任务比较中,对听力听觉内容选择的后前神经元与语言规划中选择的神经元基本不同(Khanna等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Reading begins with a visual input whose orthographic structure must be connected to lexical and sentence information. Intracranial recordings in left midfusiform cortex distinguish an early representation organized by orthographic similarity from later word-specific activity. Electrical stimulation at the tested sites, and resection in one participant, impaired visual word or letter perception, providing evidence for a causal contribution to these reading operations ( Hirshorn et al., 2016 ) . Sentence understanding extends beyond recognition of individual forms: high-gamma responses across frontal and temporal sites build up as meaningful sentences unfold, with different response profiles for word lists, nonword lists and syntactically structured nonwords ( Fedorenko et al., 2016 ) . The contrasts link this build-up to the construction of sentence meaning. Recent natural-reading MEG with eye tracking further identifies parafoveal orthographic similarity in left ventral occipitotemporal cortex and semantic similarity in left inferior frontal cortex before the target word is fixated ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . These source-localised associations show why a fixation-aligned neural segment can contain information about neighbouring words and context as well as the currently fixated word. A reading decoder consequently samples a mixture of visual recognition, linguistic integration and, depending on the reader’s strategy, internal verbal activity ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 读取从视觉输入开始,其正字结构必须与词汇和句子信息相连. 左中风皮层的内摄录区分了由正体相似性组织起来的早期表现和后来的单词特定活动. 测试地点的电刺激,以及一名参与者的重新剖析,使视觉文字或字母感知受损,为这些读取操作提供了因果关系的证据(Hirshorn等人,2016年)。 句子理解超越了对个体形式的识别:随着有意义的句子的展开,跨前期和时空站点的高伽玛响应逐渐积累起来,对单词列表,非单词列表和综合结构的非单词有不同的响应描述(Fedorenko等人,2016年). 对比点将这种积累与句子意义构建联系起来. 最近用眼睛跟踪的自然读取MEG在目标词固定之前,进一步识别左外腔骨髓皮质和语义相似性(Wang等人,2025年b). 这些来源本地化的关联表明,为什么固定的神经元段可以包含相邻词和上下文以及目前固定词的信息. 因此,阅读解码器对视觉识别、语言融合以及视读者策略而定的内在语言活动(Kunz等人,2025年)进行抽样。

blocks.en: Internally saying a word, imagining its sound and attempting its articulation provide related routes to linguistic content. Their overlap creates opportunities for transfer, while their differences determine which supervision remains appropriate. Microelectrode recordings from supramarginal gyrus support classification of internally and overtly produced words and pseudowords in two participants; shared representations with word reading and vocalized speech were demonstrated in one participant ( Wandelt et al., 2024 ) . Motor-cortex recordings in four participants subsequently showed correlated word-pattern geometry across attempted, inner and perceived speech. Inner speech was more weakly modulated, and a population dimension associated with motor intention helped distinguish inner from attempted speech ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) . This combination is useful for an interface: content information can be shared while the intended mode of communication remains distinguishable. It also explains why an absence of visible movement does not by itself identify the neural task. Transfer between listening, attempted and inner speech depends on the particular population, instructions and representation, rather than on a shared word label alone.
blocks.zh: 在内部说一个词,想象它的声音并试图表达它,提供了语言内容的相关途径。 它们的重叠为转移创造了机会,而它们的差别则决定了哪些监督仍然是适当的。 来自超边际陀螺的微电子录音支持在两个参与者中进行内部和公开生成的词和假词的分类;在一名参与者中演示了与字读和声化演讲的共同表述(Wandelt等人,2024年)。 4名与会者的机车记录显示,在尝试的、内在的和感知的演讲中,文字几何是相互关联的。 内语的调性较弱,与运动意图有关的人口层面有助于区分内语和企图的言论(Kunz等人,2025年)。 这种组合对于一个界面是有用的:内容信息可以共享,而预期的通信方式仍然可以区分. 这也解释了为什么缺乏可见运动本身并不能识别神经任务. 聆听、尝试和内在言论之间的转移取决于特定人群、指示和表现,而不是仅仅依靠一个共同的词标签。

blocks.en: Cross-task reuse also extends to longer linguistic context. Models fitted to fMRI responses during matched reading and listening narratives reveal similar cortical organization of language-context timescales across temporal, parietal and prefrontal regions ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . This supports a common substrate for integration beyond the modality-specific input, without requiring identical fine-scale dynamics. Measurement scale still matters: the linguistic selectivity of individual neurons can differ from that of field potentials at the same recording sites ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . Broad coverage and local precision therefore answer complementary questions about accessible information.
blocks.zh: 跨任务重复使用还延伸到较长的语言背景. 配对阅读和聆听叙事时与fMRI反应相适应的模型揭示了跨时空、空地和前边缘地区语言-文字时间尺度的类似皮层组织(Chen等人,2024a)。 这支持在模式特定输入之外采用共同的整合基底,而不需要相同的细尺度动态. 测量尺度仍然重要:单个神经元的语言选择性可能不同于同一录制地点的场潜力(Cai等人,2026年). 因此,覆盖面很广,地方精度也比较精确,从而回答了关于无障碍信息的补充问题。

blocks.en: The decoding target selects which of these properties the interface preserves. Acoustic representations can support reconstruction of heard speech ( Pasley et al., 2012 ) ; phoneme sequences can connect attempted speech to text ( Willett et al., 2023 ) ; contextual representations can constrain a generated description of perceived or imagined language ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . A single speech-cortex recording can also feed text, speech synthesis and audio-linked facial animation through different prediction targets ( Metzger et al., 2023 ) . These are many-to-many relationships between neural information and output forms. Representation studies explain why a target is plausible; held-out and online decoding establish how effectively a particular system can recover it.
blocks.zh: 解码目标选择接口保存的这些属性中的哪一个. 声波表达可以支持重构听力语音(Pasley等人,2012年);电话序列可以将尝试的语音与文本连接起来(Willett等人,2023年);背景表达可以约束对感知或想象语言的生成描述(Tang等人,2023年). 单声道-cortex录音也可以通过不同的预测目标(Metzger et al., 2023)提供文本,语音合成和音频链接的面部动画. 这些是神经信息与输出形式之间的多种关系. 代表性研究解释了为什么目标是可信的;搁置和在线解码确定了特定系统如何能够有效地恢复目标。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Neural representations across language tasks and their decoding targets. (a) Lateral and ventral fsaverage5 surfaces provide anatomical orientation ( Fischl et al., 1999 ) ; coloured neighbourhoods are schematic, not electrode coordinates or functional boundaries. E represents bilateral distributed territories. Filled cells show representative observations; blank cells indicate no example drawn here. Overt and attempted speech remain distinct tasks despite sharing a column. The corresponding measurements and primary studies are given in Table 4 . (b) Arrows identify selected decoding interfaces for word selection, text, voice and audio-linked facial output ( Wandelt et al., 2024 ; Willett et al., 2023 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Landau et al., 2026 ) . They are model connections, not anatomical tracts or one-region–one-function assignments.
blocks.zh: 图4:跨语言任务的神经表达及其解码目标. (a) 横向和通风平均5表面提供解剖方向(Fischl等人,1999年);彩色街区是示意图,而不是电极坐标或功能边界。 E代表双边分布的领土。 填充的单元格显示具有代表性的观察;空白单元格表示此处没有绘制示例. 公开和企图发表言论仍然是不同的任务,尽管共用一栏。 相应的测量和初级研究见表4。 (b) 箭头识别选定用于文字选择、文字、语音和音频链接面部输出的解码接口(Wandelt等人,2024年;Willett等人,2023年;Metzger等人,2023年;Tang等人,2023年;Landau等人,2026年)。 它们是模型连接,而不是解剖道或一个区域-一个功能任务。

blocks.en: Table 4: Representative measurements and evidence for the region–task map in Figure 4 . Labels identify groups of observations rather than exclusive anatomical functions.
blocks.zh: 表4:区域的代表性测量和证据-图4中的任务地图。 标签确定观测群而非排他解剖功能.

blocks.en: 4.2 Electrophysiological signals
blocks.zh: 4.2 大理物理信号

blocks.en: Electroencephalography (EEG) measures scalp potentials arising from the combined electrical activity of neuronal populations; around-ear placement is one recording configuration. Magnetoencephalography (MEG), including conventional systems and optically pumped magnetometers (OPMs), measures magnetic fields associated with neural activity. Invasive recordings include cortical-surface electrocorticography (ECoG) and its high-density or micro-ECoG configurations, stereoelectroencephalography (sEEG) depth macro-contacts, intracortical arrays and acute Neuropixels probes. Intracranial EEG (iEEG) encompasses ECoG and sEEG. Extracellular field potentials reflect pooled local activity, whereas spikes and threshold crossings provide features associated with neuronal firing. Intracortical decoders use these alongside spike-band power and local field potentials. These families differ in spatial coverage and signal access; a common model architecture does not make their neural inputs equivalent ( Herff and Schultz, 2016 ; Duraivel et al., 2023 ; Khanna et al., 2024 ; Willett et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 电脑分析(EEG)测量神经群合并电活动产生的头皮潜力;周围放置是一种记录配置。 磁共振(MEG),包括常规系统和光泵磁强计,测量与神经活动有关的磁场. 侵入性录音包括皮层表面电脉冲(ECOG)及其高密度或微电脉冲(ECOG)配置,立体电子脑光学(SEEG)深度宏观接触,内核阵列和急性神经元探测器. 内部的EEG(iEEG)包括ECoG和SEEG. 细胞外野外潜力反映了局部活动的集合,而突起和阈值交叉则提供了神经内燃的特征。 内部解码器在使用这些设备的同时,还使用悬索带电源和当地的场面潜力。 这些家族在空间覆盖和信号获取方面不尽相同;共同的模型架构并不能使其神经输入值等同(Herff and Schultz, 2016; Duraivel等人, 2023; Khanna等人, 2024; Willett等人, 2023).

blocks.en: These measurements offer different forms of information access. Scalp and ear EEG can track features of attended external speech, and source-localised MEG can characterise auditory and visual speech information over time ( Geirnaert et al., 2025a ; Bröhl et al., 2022 ) . Cortical-surface recordings resolve local population activity with articulatory and acoustic-phonetic organisation ( Bouchard et al., 2013 ; Mesgarani et al., 2014 ) . Intracortical arrays add features derived from neuronal spiking and local fields, which have supported large-vocabulary speech decoding ( Willett et al., 2023 ) . Thus, the feature representation and recording location explain a decoder’s input more precisely than the device name alone.
blocks.zh: 这些测量提供了不同形式的信息获取. Scalp和ear EEG可以跟踪所参加外部演讲的特征,源位化的MEG可以在一段时间内对听觉和视觉语音信息进行定性(Geirnaert等人,2025a); Bröhl等人,2022年). 皮肤表面记录通过动脉和声学组织解决当地居民活动(Bouchard等人,2013年;Mesgarani等人,2014年)。 内部阵列增加了从神经振荡和局部领域衍生出来的功能,这些功能支持了大省语音解码(Willett等人,2023年). 因此,特性表示和记录位置比设备名称更准确地解释了解码器的输入。

blocks.en: Beyond content reconstruction, distributed sEEG recordings support speech-state detection and identification of intent-related contacts ( Verwoert et al., 2025 ; Prakash et al., 2025 ) . These targets help identify when and where language-related activity can be read out.
blocks.zh: 除了内容重建外,还分发了SEEG录音,支持语音状态检测和识别与意图有关的联系人(Verwoert等人,2025年;Prakash等人,2025年)。 这些目标有助于确定何时何地可以读出与语言有关的活动。

blocks.en: 4.3 Haemodynamic signals
blocks.zh: 4.3 血动力信号

blocks.en: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), high-density diffuse optical tomography (HD-DOT) and functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) measure vascular responses associated with neural processing. BOLD fMRI uses magnetic-resonance contrast sensitive to blood oxygenation; fNIRS estimates haemoglobin changes optically, with dense sampling and reconstruction in HD-DOT; fUSI uses Doppler measurements sensitive to microvascular blood-volume changes. Simultaneous electrophysiological and fMRI experiments in nonhuman primates provided an empirical basis for interpreting this relationship ( Logothetis et al., 2001 ) . Optical reconstruction and Doppler acquisition provide different views of vascular activity ( Schroeder et al., 2023 ; Soloukey et al., 2020 ) . The response integrates activity over time, making temporal alignment and target duration important parts of a language-decoding model.
blocks.zh: 功能磁共振成像(fMRI),功能近红外光谱学(fNIRS),高密度散射光学成像(HD-DOT)和功能超声成像(fUSI)测量与神经处理相关的血管反应. BOLD fMRI使用对血液氧化敏感的磁共振对比;FNIRS估计血红蛋白在光学上变化,HD-DOT中具有密集的采样与重建;fUSI使用对微血管血量变化敏感的多普勒测量. 非人类灵长类动物同时进行的电生理学和fMRI实验为解释这种关系提供了经验依据(Logothetis等人,2001年)。 光学重建与多普勒获取提供了血管活性的不同观点(Schroeder等人,2023年;Soloukey等人,2020年). 该响应融合了随时间演变的活动,使时间调整和目标持续时间成为语言解码模型的重要部分.

blocks.en: Language applications illustrate the range of targets available through this response. fNIRS has supported concept discrimination from responses to paired pictures and spoken labels, while fMRI decoders reconstruct the gist of extended language and high-density fNIRS systems investigate cue-conditioned sentence generation ( Cao et al., 2021 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ) . HD-DOT combines dense optical sampling with reconstruction to map tasks such as silent reading, silent verb generation and overt production, and to retrieve stimulus segments ( Schroeder et al., 2023 ; Tripathy et al., 2025 ) . These approaches exploit information integrated over longer intervals. Faster sampling can improve the measurement, but the vascular response must still be included when interpreting output latency.
blocks.zh: 语言应用说明通过这个响应可以实现的目标范围. fNIRS支持对配对图片和口语标签的反应概念歧视,fMRI解码器则重建扩展语言和高密度fNIRS系统的特征,调查有提示条件的句子生成(Cao等人,2021年;Tang等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2024年b). HD-DOT将密集的光学采样与重建相结合,以映射静读,静默动词生成和公开生产等任务,并回收刺激片段(Schroeder等人,2023年;Trithery等人,2025年). 这些办法利用了较长间隔的信息。 更快的采样可以改进测量,但在解释输出延迟性时仍必须包含血管反应.

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Functional ultrasound: mapping and decoding boundaries
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 功能超声波:绘图和解码边界

blocks.en: An ultrasound array sends acoustic pulses into tissue and records returning echoes. Rapid image sequences allow tissue motion to be suppressed and echoes from moving blood cells to be retained; power-Doppler processing then yields a measurement sensitive to local blood volume. Neural activity is related to this vascular signal through neurovascular coupling, so image acquisition speed and the underlying physiological response are different timescales ( Soloukey et al., 2020 ; Rabut et al., 2024 ) . Figure 5 follows this measurement from pulse transmission to task-linked readout.
blocks.zh: 超声波阵列将声波脉冲送入组织,并记录回声. 快速的图像序列使得组织运动被抑制,从移动的血细胞中回声被保留;动力-多普勒处理之后产生对局部血量敏感的测量. 神经活性通过神经血管耦合与这种血管信号有关,所以图像获取速度和基础生理反应是不同的时间尺度(Soloukey等人,2020年;Rabut等人,2024年). 图5遵循了从脉冲传输到任务相关读取的这一计量.

blocks.en: Functional ultrasound imaging offers sub-millimetre vascular measurements in selected configurations. Its potential for language interfaces depends on joining three advances that currently address different problems: localising language-related activity, predicting content from single trials and maintaining recording access ( Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: 功能性超声成像在选定的配置中提供亚毫米血管测量. 它对于语言界面的潜力取决于加入目前解决不同问题的三项进步:语言相关活动本地化,从单一试验中预测内容,以及维持记录访问(表15).

blocks.en: Figure 5: How functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) relates neural activity to a vascular measurement. (a) An array transmits pulses and receives echoes, including those scattered by moving blood cells. (b) Tissue-clutter suppression and power-Doppler processing yield a blood-volume-sensitive image sequence. (c) Task-linked vascular changes support response mapping or a trained decoder. Neurovascular coupling provides the physiological link; rapid acquisition does not remove the vascular response delay. Intra-operative language mapping and window-based visuomotor decoding have been reported ( Soloukey et al., 2020 ; Rabut et al., 2024 ) . The cited intact-skull study instead measured breath-hold vascular reactivity ( Vienneau et al., 2026 ) . All anatomy, vessel images and traces are schematic. The figure depicts imaging, not ultrasound stimulation or direct spike measurement.
blocks.zh: 图5:功能性超声成像(fUSI)如何将神经活性与血管测量联系起来. (a) 阵列传递脉冲并接收回声,包括流动血细胞所散布的回声。 (b) 组织阻塞和动力-多普勒处理产生血量敏感图像序列。 (c) 与任务挂钩的血管变化支持反应映射或训练有素的解码器。 神经血管耦合提供了生理联系;快速获取并不能消除血管反应延迟. 已报告了内操作语言映射和基于窗口的粘土摩托解码(Soloukey等人,2020年;Rabut等人,2024年)。 引用的完好无缺的骨骼研究则测量了呼吸-血血管的活性(Vienneau等人,2026年)。 所有解剖,器皿图像和痕迹都是图案. 该图描绘的是成像,而不是超声波刺激或直接的悬崖测量.

blocks.en: Intra-operative fUSI establishes that task-related haemodynamics can be measured in awake patients ( Imbault et al., 2017 ) . Language evidence includes aloud and source-labelled covert repetition in a ten-patient series with 18 language measurements, with both responses shown for one patient ( Soloukey et al., 2020 ) , and overlap with fMRI and electrical stimulation mapping (ESM) ( Soloukey et al., 2023 ) . Agreement between maps supports localisation of a task response. It leaves open whether that response distinguishes the words or sentences within the task.
blocks.zh: 术内fUSI规定,与任务相关的血动力学可以在清醒患者中测量(Imbault等人,2017年). 语言证据包括一个有18种语言测量的十大患者系列中高声和源头标记的隐性重复,对一名患者的回答(Soloukey等人,2020年)和与fMRI和电刺激映射的重叠(Soloukey等人,2023年)。 地图之间的协议支持任务响应的本地化. 这一答复是否区分了任务中的文字或句子,这一点没有定论。

blocks.en: Human single-trial finger and effector decoding across sessions demonstrates usable motor information through acoustically transparent cranial windows ( Rabut et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Natural-behaviour imaging over more than 20 months and miniaturised four-dimensional systems address access and recording practicality ( Soloukey et al., 2025 ; Verhoef et al., 2025 ) . Neither establishes language-content recovery: imagined lip licking in the former study is non-speech motor imagery, outside Inner. Non-human primate evidence progresses from propagation of task-related activity to movement-intention decoding and closed-loop ultrasonic brain–machine interfaces ( Dizeux et al., 2019 ; Norman et al., 2021 ; Griggs et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 人类单审手指和效果器跨会话解码通过声学透明的颅窗显示有用的运动信息(Rabut等人,2024年;Lin等人,2026年)。 20多个月的自然行为成像和小型四维系统涉及访问和记录实用性(Soloukey等人,2025年;Verhoef等人,2025年)。 也没有确定语言内容的恢复:前研究中想象的唇舔是非声波电动机图像,内在外. 非人类灵长类证据从传播与任务有关的活动发展到移动意图解码和闭路超音速脑机接口(Dizeux等人,2019年;Norman等人,2021年;Griggs等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Intact-skull human fUSI measured breath-hold vascular reactivity without contrast agents in 13 participants ( Vienneau et al., 2026 ) ; ex-vivo human-skull acoustic transparency is additional feasibility evidence ( Wang et al., 2025e ) . These findings show that a cranial window is not universally required, but the motor-decoding results obtained through windows cannot simply be assigned to transcranial acquisition. Auditory-response work in ferret, crow and marmoset, and click responses in comatose patients, similarly establishes sensitivity to stimulation rather than language identity ( Bimbard et al., 2018 ; Landemard et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Takahashi et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2025d ) . Cross-species comparisons and mouse temporal-resolution measurements help explain the signal while retaining their species and modality boundaries ( Landemard et al., 2021 ; Bian et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Intact-skull人类fUSI在13名参与者中测量了呼吸-hold血管反应,没有对比剂(Vienneau等人,2026年);前活体人体-skull声学透明度是额外的可行性证据(Wang等人,2025e). 这些调查结果表明,颅骨窗口并非普遍需要,但不能简单地将通过窗口获得的电动机解码结果指定为转动获取. 雪貂、乌鸦和马莫塞特的审计反应工作,以及昏迷病人的点击反应,同样确立了刺激而不是语言特征的敏感性(Bimbard等人,2018年;Landemard等人,2025年;Liao等人,2025年;Takahashi等人,2021年;Chen等人,2025年d). 跨物种比较和鼠标时间分辨率测量有助于解释信号,同时保留其物种和模式边界(Landemard等人,2021年;Bian等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Together, human studies link language-related vascular mapping, single-trial motor decoding and repeated recording access ( Soloukey et al., 2020 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Soloukey et al., 2025 ) . They motivate testing linguistic distinctions under a specified access route, with the target duration matched to the vascular response.
blocks.zh: 人类研究共同将语言相关血管图谱,单审运动解码和重复录制访问联系起来(Soloukey等人,2020年;Lin等人,2026年;Soloukey等人,2025年). 它们促使在指定的通道下测试语言区别,目标持续时间与血管反应相匹配.

blocks.en: 4.4 Sensors, placement and recording configurations
blocks.zh: 4.4 传感器、放置和记录配置

blocks.en: Denser sampling can recover distinctions lost when nearby signals are pooled: 128- and 256-contact intra-operative μ \mu ECoG improved decoding of non-words built from nine phonemes in four participants ( Duraivel et al., 2023 ) . Across patients, the challenge changes because the sampled populations differ; shared latent dynamics improve decoding with μ \mu ECoG and sparse sEEG ( Spalding et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2025 ) . Temporal modelling is another design choice: recurrent and Transformer models outperformed linear regression for sEEG speech reconstruction, with no significant difference detected between the two deep-learning methods in that study ( Wu et al., 2024c ) . These examples support improving spatial sampling, representational alignment and temporal modelling for different reasons; none shows that model choice compensates for missing coverage. Acute Neuropixels findings resolve articulatory planning, phonemes and sequences at single-neuron scale ( Khanna et al., 2024 ) , but do not establish the same information access in a chronic communication system.
blocks.zh: Denser采样可以恢复附近信号集合时丢失的区别:128-和256-操作内接触μ\mu ECoG改进了从四个参与者的9个电话机中构建的非单词的解码(Duraivel等人,2023年). 在患者中,挑战发生变化,因为抽样人群不同;共享的潜在动态改善了μ\mu ECoG和稀疏SEEG的解码(Spalding等人,2026年;Singh等人,2025年)。 Temporal建模是另一种设计选择:用于SEEG语音重建的经常性模型和变形器模型的性能超过线性回归,该研究中发现的两种深层学习方法之间没有显著区别(Wu等人,2024c). 这些例子支持改进空间采样、代表性调整和时间建模,原因不同;没有任何实例表明,模型选择可以弥补覆盖缺失。 急性神经元的发现解决了单中微子尺度的动脉规划,电话和序列(Khanna等人,2024年),但在慢性通信系统中没有建立相同的信息访问.

blocks.en: Placement determines which tissue and neural populations are observed. Scalp, cortical-surface, depth and intracortical configurations therefore differ in coverage as well as access requirements ( Table 3 ). Source localisation and cross-participant latent alignment can reduce mismatch between recordings, but cannot create direct measurements of populations that were not sampled. The clinical configurations in Table 10 illustrate why implant choice and participant condition must be considered together.
blocks.zh: 放置决定了观测到哪些组织和神经种群. 因此,鳞片、皮层表面、深度和内部布局的覆盖范围和准入要求各不相同(表3)。 源位化和跨参与者潜在对齐可减少录音之间的不匹配,但不能对未取样的人口进行直接测量。 表10中的临床配置说明了为何必须一并考虑植入选择和参与者状况。

blocks.en: Simultaneous recording allows configurations to be compared under the same behavioural conditions. Scalp, around-ear and in-ear EEG recorded during one auditory-attention task showed that recording configuration and reference choice affect decoding ( Geirnaert et al., 2025a ) . Complementary intraoperative work demonstrated speech decoding with a dense cortical-surface microelectrode interface ( Lehner et al., 2026 ) . The first comparison informs sensor placement and referencing; the second establishes feasibility for an acute cortical recording route.
blocks.zh: 同时录制可以使配置在相同行为条件下进行比较. 在一个听觉观察任务中记录的Scalp、周围和内耳的EEG显示,记录的配置和参考选择影响解码(Geirnaert等人,2025a) 。 。 。 辅助性内部操作工作演示了用密集的皮层表面微电极接口进行语音解码(Lehner等人,2026年)。 第一次比较为传感器的放置和参考提供了信息;第二次比较确定了急性皮质记录路线的可行性。

blocks.en: Signal selection couples a linguistic target to an access and supervision requirement.
