Reviews of imagined-speech reconstruction and EEG–fNIRS acquisition explain the range of non-invasive options ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Motaqi et al., 2026 ) ; implantable-speech reviews relate cortical access to patient selection and training ( Jhilal et al., 2025 ) . Hybrid sensing adds another design choice: peripheral information may improve communication even when it contributes no neural evidence. Broader silent-speech sensing reviews include these peripheral routes ( Tang et al., 2026 ) . Channel-specific comparisons are needed to determine what combining them with neural recording actually adds.
blocks.zh: 信号选择夫妇是语言目标,需要进入和监督。 对想象中的语音重建和EEG-fNIRS获取的审查解释了非侵入性选择的范围(Tang等人,2024年;Motaqi等人,2026年);植入性语音审查涉及皮质患者选择和培训(Jhilal等人,2025年)。 混合感知增加了另一种设计选择:外围信息即使没有提供神经证据,也可能改善通信. 较宽的无声-声波感知学评论包括这些外围路线(Tang等人,2026年). 需要针对具体通道进行比较,以确定它们与神经录制的结合实际增加的是什么.

blocks.en: Three questions narrow a recording choice before model selection: does the configuration sample the relevant population, does its temporal support match the target, and can that access be sustained in the intended setting? A phoneme-timed speech output and a semantic account of a long passage require different temporal information. Greater spatial coverage can aid representation learning while introducing setup and access costs; denser sampling of one region cannot substitute for sampling the relevant process. The conditional trade-offs in Table 5 therefore concern configurations and objectives, not a global ordering of signal families.
blocks.zh: 三个问题缩小了模型选择前的录制选择:配置是否对相关人群进行抽样,其时间支持是否与目标相符,访问能否在预定的环境下持续? 电话计时的语音输出和长通道的语义描述需要不同的时间信息. 扩大空间覆盖面可以帮助进行代表性学习,同时引入设置和准入成本;对一个区域进行更密集的取样不能取代对相关过程的取样。 因此,表5中的有条件权衡涉及的是配置和目标,而不是信号家庭的全球订单。

blocks.en: Table 5: Acquisition choices change the learning and use problem. The trade-offs synthesise the cited configurations; they are not controlled estimates of modality superiority.
blocks.zh: 表5 购置选择改变学习和使用问题。 权衡结合了所引用的配置;它们不是模式优越性的可控估计.

blocks.en: 4.5 Signal quality and acquisition constraints
blocks.zh: 4.5 信号质量和获取限制

blocks.en: Confounds depend on both task and acquisition. Articulated conditions introduce movement, muscle activity and possible acoustic contamination; Reading adds gaze and fixation timing. Inner instructions reduce intended movement but do not measure compliance. Auxiliary EOG, EMG or motion channels can test these explanations, while deliberate EEG–EMG fusion uses peripheral activity as part of the communication signal ( Nieto et al., 2022 ; Hollenstein et al., 2018 ; Inoue et al., 2026 ) . The same channel can thus serve as a control or a useful input, depending on the claim. Neural specificity requires separating these roles.
blocks.zh: 困惑取决于任务和获得。 人工条件包括运动、肌肉活动和可能的声波污染; 阅读增加了视线和固定时间。 内部指令减少预期的移动,但不衡量遵守情况。 辅助EOG,EMG或运动通道可以测试这些解释,而有意的EEG-EMG聚变则将外围活动作为通信信号的一部分(Nieto等人,2022年;Hollenstein等人,2018年;Inoue等人,2026年). 因此,根据索赔要求,同一渠道可以作为控制或有用的投入。 神经特异性要求将这些角色分开.

blocks.en: Acquisition controls are most informative when they follow the physical measurement. Multicentre analyses and recording-chain experiments show that sound-related vibration can introduce speech-correlated components into invasive signals during production or sound perception ( Roussel et al., 2020 ; Bush et al., 2022 ) . Synchronous sound and movement measurements, frequency-specific analyses and hardware controls help separate these components from physiology. Optical measurements require a different separation: short-separation channels can estimate superficial physiological activity, and controlled comparisons show how optode density, noise regression and image reconstruction affect decoding ( Fischer et al., 2026 ) . These adjacent methodological results guide signal preparation without serving as language-performance estimates.
blocks.zh: 购买控制在跟踪物理测量时,信息最为丰富。 多中心分析和记录链实验显示,声音相关振动可以在生产或声音感知过程中将语音相关组件引入入侵信号(Roussel等人,2020年;Bush等人,2022年). 同步声学和运动测量,频率特定分析和硬件控制有助于将这些元件与生理学区分开来. 光学测量需要不同的分离:短分离通道可以估计表面的生理活性,有控制的比较可以显示Otode密度,噪声回归和图像重建如何影响解码(Fischer等人,2026年). 这些相邻的方法结果指导了信号编制,而不是作为语文性能的估计数。

blocks.en: A model must accommodate both the information in the recording and the timescale on which it arrives. Electrophysiological decoders in the reviewed systems use time-varying features for phoneme, acoustic or sequence targets, whereas haemodynamic decoding must account for the delayed vascular response when aligning language and measurements ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ; Tang et al., 2023 ) . Recording coverage and access also shape the available supervision: clinical production systems, naturalistic listening corpora and reading datasets provide different paired observations. A useful decoder must therefore match its target representation and training supervision to the information and timing of the chosen recording.
blocks.zh: 模型必须既包含录音中的信息,也包含其到达的时间尺度. 被审查系统中的电磁分解器对电话、声学或序列目标使用时间变化特性,而血动力分解器在调整语言和测量时必须计入血管反应延迟(Willett等人,2023年;Anumanchipalli等人,2019年;Tang等人,2023年)。 记录覆盖范围和访问权也决定了现有的监督:临床生产系统,自然主义的聆听蝎子和读取数据集提供不同的配对观测. 因此,一个有用的编解码器必须使其目标表述和培训监督与所选录音的信息和时间相匹配。

blocks.en: The supplementary mechanism map ( Figure 23 ) distinguishes physiological response and access constraints that the sampling configurations in Table 3 alone cannot express.
blocks.zh: 补充机制图(图23)区分了仅表3中的采样配置无法表达的生理反应和准入限制.

blocks.en: 5 Methods
blocks.zh: 5 方法

blocks.en: Decoding methods distribute the reconstruction problem between neural measurements, paired training data and a model of plausible outputs. Their central design choice is which information the neural representation must preserve: distinctions among candidates, a linguistic sequence, a voice trajectory or a semantic relationship. Supervision determines which of these mappings can be learned, and the model prior supplies structure that the recordings do not fully specify. Shared benchmarks now support comparisons across successive methods in clinical text decoding, non-invasive retrieval and generation, speech synthesis and neural pretraining. These comparisons reveal which design choices improve a common task, while differences in test inputs and training resources explain why the same method can perform differently across settings.
blocks.zh: 解码方法在神经测量、配对培训数据以及可能输出的模型之间分配重建问题。 其中心设计选择是神经表达必须保存哪些信息:候选人的区别、语言序列、语音轨迹或语义关系。 监督决定了这些绘图中哪些可以学习,以及录音未充分说明的型号前供给结构. 共享的基准现在支持临床文本解码、非侵入性检索和生成、语音合成和神经前训练等连续方法的比较。 这些比较揭示了哪些设计选择改进了共同的任务,而测试投入和培训资源的差异则解释了为什么同一方法在不同环境之间可以发挥不同的作用。

blocks.en: 5.1 Data and supervision
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据和监督

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Experimental protocols and datasets
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 实验协议和数据集

blocks.en: Datasets supply both the examples from which a decoder learns and the experimental contrasts through which its behaviour can be understood ( Table 6 ). Multi-session recordings support study of day-to-day variation; matched overt conditions supply acoustic or linguistic supervision; peripheral EOG/EMG channels help characterise task execution ( Nieto et al., 2022 ) . Recording vocalised, mouthed and internal production of the same items adds a direct basis for cross-task learning ( Ma et al., 2026b ; He et al., 2025b ) . These contrasts depend on the elicited behaviour: silent articulation includes attempted articulatory movement, whereas imagined speech need not. SS-EEG, for example, instructs articulation attempts without sound ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 数据集既提供解码器从中学习的实例,也提供能够理解其行为的实验对比(表6)。 对日常变化的多场录音支持研究;匹配的公开条件提供声学或语言监督;外围的EOG/EMG频道帮助确定任务执行的特性(Nieto等人,2022年)。 录音、口腔和内部制作相同物品,为交叉任务学习提供了直接依据(Ma等人,2026b; 他等人,2025年b). 这些对比取决于诱导的行为:沉默的表达包括尝试的动脉运动,而想象中的言语则不需要. 例如,SS-EEG指示无声音的表达尝试(周等人,2025a.).

blocks.en: Table 6: Selected datasets provide complementary task contrasts and forms of supervision. Counts refer to the cited releases; the two Moreira experiments and two ZuCo releases are listed separately. Task conditions, auxiliary measurements and annotations determine which comparisons each resource supports. The complete inventory appears in .
blocks.zh: 表6:选定数据集提供了补充性的任务对比和监督形式。 计数参考引用的释放;两个莫雷拉实验和两个ZuCo释放分别列出. 任务条件,辅助测量和说明决定了每个资源支持的比较对象. 完整的清单载于.

与会者之间共享的材料和同时使用的模式不是添加剂。 资源清单全文载于......。

blocks.en: Perceived tasks provide stimulus transcripts, acoustic timing or visible text. Listening corpora and repeated reading datasets support reusable benchmarks, whereas clinical production data may require participant-specific collection. ZuCo combines EEG with eye tracking; LibriBrain pairs one participant’s MEG with 52.32 hours of listening stimuli ( Hollenstein et al., 2018 ; Hollenstein et al., 2020 ; Özdogan et al., 2025 ) . Across signal families, task-related recording totals and paired-material coverage span several orders of magnitude ( Figure 6 ). Repeated presentations and additional participants increase the available neural observations without necessarily introducing new linguistic material. Material coverage therefore complements recording hours and participant counts when assessing the resources available for learning. The inventory in provides the task designs, recording scopes and access conditions.
blocks.zh: 感知任务提供刺激记录,声学时间或可见文本. 聆听公司数据和重复读取数据集支持可重复使用的基准,而临床生产数据可能需要针对参与者进行收集。 ZuCo将EEG与眼睛跟踪相结合;LibriBrain将一名参与者的MEG配对为52.32小时的监听刺激(Hollenstein等人,2018年;Hollenstein等人,2020年;Özdogan等人,2025年). 在整个信号区中,与任务有关的记录总数和配对材料覆盖范围涉及几个数量级(图6)。 重复的演讲和更多的参与者增加现有的神经观察,而不一定引入新的语言材料. 因此,材料覆盖范围是对记录时间的补充,参与者在评估可供学习的资源时会算数。 清单提供了任务设计、记录范围和准入条件。

blocks.en: Recording depth and participant breadth support different kinds of learning. LibriBrain100 extends listening-MEG data along both dimensions, enabling prolonged within-person training and comparison across listeners ( Mantegna et al., 2026b ) . Protocol diversity adds another resource: post-imagery overt responses can help check task compliance, while repeated reading and recall sessions allow stability to be studied with familiar content ( Aguilera-Rodríguez et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026f ) . These resources support complementary research questions. Long recordings from one person support fitting a detailed personal mapping; many participants support testing shared representations; repeated sessions expose recording drift; distinct stories or sentences support tests of new content. Repetitions improve estimation of a response but add less linguistic diversity than new material. For transfer, the availability of matched tasks and languages can consequently matter as much as total hours.
blocks.zh: 记录深度和参与者宽度支持不同类型的学习. LibriBrain100沿着两个维度扩展了听-MEG数据,从而可以进行长期的人际培训和听众之间的比较(Mantegna等人,2026b)。 协议多样性增加了另一种资源:图像后公开回复可以帮助检查任务是否合规,而反复的阅读和召回会允许用熟悉的内容研究稳定性(Aguilera-Rodríguez等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年f月)。 这些资源支持补充性研究问题。 一人的长篇录音支持配上详细的个人绘图;许多与会者支持测试共享表述;重复的讲座暴露了记录漂移;不同的故事或句子支持测试新内容。 重复改进了对反应的估计,但增加的语言多样性比新材料少。 因此,为了移交工作,提供匹配的任务和语言与总时数一样重要。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Target labels and temporal alignment
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 目标标签和时间调整

blocks.en: Overt audio provides acoustic and phonetic targets, although alignment remains an explicit processing step. Mouthed and Inner conditions do not provide the same simultaneous audible reference; reviewed systems use prompted content, paired Overt recordings or transferred models ( Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ; Angrick et al., 2021 ; Lee et al., 2023 ) . In Reading, fixation markers can define word-aligned inputs, while marker-free methods pose a different segmentation problem ( Duan et al., 2023 ) . An expected prompt identifies the requested content; it does not prove that every trial followed it.
blocks.zh: 公开的音频提供音响和语音目标,尽管对齐仍然是明确的处理步骤. 口腔和内脏条件不能提供同样的同时声优的参考;被审查的系统使用提示内容,配对Overt录音或传输模型(Anumanchipalli等人,2019年;Angrick等人,2021年;Lee等人,2023年)。 在读取中,定点标记可以定义文字对齐输入,而无标记方法则构成不同的分解问题(Duan等人,2023年). 预期会迅速确定所要求的内容;它不能证明每次审判都遵循。

blocks.en: Alignment can be learned during model fitting. Iterative alignment discovery uses dynamic time warping within neural voice-activity training to accommodate uncertain response onset and duration ( Rabbani et al., 2024 ) . This offers a constructive way to learn from imperfectly timed labels. Because the alignment is part of training, it need not supply a reference waveform for the test utterance; reference-dependent test alignment has a different information requirement.
blocks.zh: 在安装模型时可以学习对齐。 迭代对齐发现在神经语音活性训练中采用动态时间摆动,以适应不确定的反应发作和持续时间(Rabbani等人,2024年). 这为从不完善的定时标签中学习提供了建设性的方法。 由于校对是训练的一部分,它不需要为测试语句提供参考波形;依赖参考的测试校正有不同的信息要求.

blocks.en: Training supervision must be distinguished from information required during testing. Overt-reference temporal alignment in silent-reading reconstruction ( Martin et al., 2014 ) and DTW reference alignment in EEG synthesis ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) constrain conclusions about autonomous operation. Haemodynamic models must additionally account for the relation between stimulus time and measured response ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . The reported test protocol should state which boundaries, alignments and transcripts are supplied to the decoder.
blocks.zh: 培训监督必须与测试期间需要的信息区分开来。 在静读重建(Martin等人,2014年)和EEG合成(Xiong等人,2025年)中的 DTW 参考比对限制了自主操作的结论. 血液动力学模型必须进一步说明刺激时间与计量反应之间的关系(Tang等人,2023年)。 所报告的测试协议应说明向解码器提供了哪些界限、对齐和记录。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Training supervision and test information occupy different paths. (a) Training recordings and reference information fit an alignment and decoder; learned parameters are then reused. (b) A new recording produces a sequence, while the held-out reference enters only the scoring step. Iterative alignment discovery illustrates training-time alignment learning ( Rabbani et al., 2024 ) . Reference-dependent alignment during testing, as in silent-reading reconstruction with an Overt reference, supplies additional information ( Martin et al., 2014 ) . The illustrated test path excludes that input. Traces, weights and utterances are schematic; protocols must state any test-time references or boundaries.
blocks.zh: 图 7: 培训监督和测试信息走不同的道路。 (a) 培训录音和参考信息符合校对和解码标准;然后重新使用学到的参数。 (b) 新的录音产生一个序列,而被搁置的参考只输入评分步骤。 纵向调整的发现说明培训时间调整学习(Rabbani等人,2024年)。 在测试期间,如在无声读取重建中,与Opt参考书一样,依赖参考书目进行校正,提供更多信息(Martin等人,2014年)。 说明的测试路径排除了这种输入。 轨迹、权重和言论是示意图;协议必须说明任何试验时间参考或界限。

blocks.en: 5.1.3 Preprocessing and artifact handling
blocks.zh: 5.1.3 预处理和文物处理

blocks.en: Filtering, referencing, epoching and artifact handling define the input available to a model, rather than being interchangeable implementation details. EEG reviews describe heterogeneous feature and preprocessing pipelines ( Panachakel and Ramakrishnan, 2021 ; Lopez-Bernal et al., 2022 ) ; the selected invasive and MEG systems likewise use different neural features and temporal windows ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Défossez et al., 2023 ) . The appropriate pipeline follows the signal physiology, the target timescale and the information permitted during inference.
blocks.zh: 过滤、参考、挖掘和文物处理界定了可供模型使用的投入,而不是可互换的实施细节。 EEG评论描述了各种特征和预处理管道(Panachakel和Ramakrishnan,2021年;Lopez-Bernal等人,2022年);选定的入侵系统和MEG系统同样使用不同的神经特征和时间窗口(Willett等人,2023年;Défossez等人,2023年)。 适当的管道遵循信号生理学、目标时间尺度和推断期间允许的信息。

blocks.en: Preprocessing determines which regularities reach the learner. A multiverse analysis of EEG event-related-potential experiments showed that artifact correction could lower classification accuracy, consistent with models exploiting structured non-neural variation ( Kessler et al., 2025 ) . This explains why signal cleaning and prediction performance should be assessed together: the best pipeline for a neural interpretation may differ from the one that most easily separates the recorded conditions. Speech-specific recording-chain controls address acoustic contamination through a separate physical mechanism ( Roussel et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 预处理决定学习者的规律性 。 对EEG事件相关潜在实验进行的多面分析显示,文物校正可以降低分类准确性,与利用结构化非神经变异的模型相一致(Kessler等人,2025年)。 这解释了为什么应该同时评估信号清洁和预测性能:神经解释的最佳管道可能不同于最容易将记录的条件分开的管道。 语音专用记录链控制通过单独的物理机制处理声学污染(Roussel等人,2020年)。

blocks.en: A reproducible comparison specifies filter causality and temporal support, referencing or channel selection, rejection criteria, auxiliary channels and normalization. Learned transforms and feature selection should be fitted within the training partition. Artifact removal should be accompanied by residual-confound controls, rather than treated as proof of neural origin. A pipeline using future samples or reference-dependent alignment may remain useful offline, but its latency and information access differ from a causal communication system.
blocks.zh: 可复制的比较规定了过滤因果关系和时间支持、参考或频道选择、拒绝标准、辅助渠道和正常化。 应在培训分区内安排学习的转变和特色选择。 人工除去应伴有残存的控制,而不是作为神经源的证据。 使用未来样品或依赖参考的调整的管道仍然有用,但其时间和信息获取方式不同于因果通信系统。

blocks.en: 5.1.4 Data partitioning and leakage prevention
blocks.zh: 5.1.4 国家 数据分割和防止渗漏

blocks.en: Data partitioning specifies the kind of reuse a model is expected to support. Within-person fitting, transfer across sessions and prediction for a new user are distinct learning settings. Cross-validation and hyperparameter selection can be organised around the corresponding independent unit, keeping validation separate from the final test ( Varoquaux et al., 2017 ) . This makes a performance estimate answer a useful deployment or scientific question.
blocks.zh: 数据分区指定了模型预期支持的再利用类型。 个人内部的适应、跨会话的转移和对新用户的预测是不同的学习环境。 交叉验证和超参数选择可以围绕相应的独立单位组织,将验证与最终测试分开(Varoquaux等人,2017年). 这使得绩效估计可以回答一个有用的部署或科学问题.

blocks.en: Partitions should be defined before overlapping windows, repeated items or learned preprocessing can link training and test observations. The split unit follows the claim: trial-held-out tests assess new observations, stimulus-held-out tests assess new material, and session- or participant-held-out tests assess transfer to those conditions. The examined reading split audit identifies sentence overlap across nominal participant partitions ( Yin et al., 2025 ) . The MEG attribution audit additionally shows why fixed-duration windows and stimulus-identity separation matter when input structure can reveal the candidate ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Each split removes a different source of familiarity, so the split unit is part of the generalisation claim ( Section 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在重叠窗口、重复项目或学到的预处理能够将培训和测试观测联系起来之前,应当确定分区。 拆分单位遵循索赔要求:试控测试评估新的观测结果,刺激测试评估新的材料,会话测试或参与者测试评估转移到这些条件下的情况. 经审查的 " 分开审计 " 查明了名义参与者分区之间的句子重叠(Yin等人,2025年)。 MEG归属审计还进一步显示,当输入结构能够揭示候选人时,为何固定期限窗口和刺激识别分离问题(Zhang等人,2026c ). 每个拆分消除了不同的熟悉来源,因此拆分单位是泛化索赔的一部分(第6节).

blocks.en: Preprocessing, supervision and architecture interact: a model can exploit differences introduced by the pipeline before it learns a linguistic distinction. EEG and end-to-end reviews accordingly connect features, task design and neural assumptions with model choice ( Rahman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Divya Keerthana et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Estrella-Ibarra et al., 2026 ) . Extending this perspective from imagery classification to language generation requires identifying what each output route asks the neural representation to preserve ( Qiu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 预处理,监理和架构相互作用:一个模型在学习语言区分之前可以利用管道引入的差异. EEG和端对端审查因此将特征、任务设计和神经假设与模型选择联系起来(Rahman等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年;Jin等人,2025年;Divya Keerthana等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年;Estrella-Ibarra等人,2026年). 将这一视角从图像分类扩大到语言生成,需要确定每个输出路线要求神经表达保存的内容(邱等人,2025年;余等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Output types and decoding objectives
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 产出类型和编码目标

blocks.en: Four presentation forms organise the content outputs: candidate selection, text sequences, audible speech and facial animation. Classification and retrieval select from explicit alternatives. Text may aim at verbatim transcription or a semantic paraphrase; open vocabulary is a property of the decoding task, not a separate output medium. Spectrograms, phoneme posteriors and semantic embeddings can be intermediate targets. Facial animation is a visual expression channel, distinct from reconstructing arbitrary images. A system can combine several forms ( Metzger et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 四个演示文稿组织内容输出:候选人选择,文本序列,可听的语音和面部动画. 从明确的备选办法中选择分类和检索。 文本可能以逐字记录或语义解释为目的;开放词汇是解码任务的一个属性,而不是单独的输出介质. 光谱、电话和语义嵌入可以是中间目标。 面部动画是视觉表达通道,有别于重建任意图像. 一个系统可以结合几种形式(Metzger等人,2023年).

blocks.en: Output, validation and use remain separate axes. Strongly controlled classification may establish neural information more convincingly than poorly controlled generation. Conversely, a generated waveform remains an acoustic output even when intelligibility is limited. State detection supports interaction; language mapping, representation studies and dataset reports describe study scope.
blocks.zh: 输出,验证和使用仍然是独立的轴. 严格控制的分类可能比控制不力的生成更能令人信服地建立神经信息. 反之,即使知觉有限,产生的波形仍然是一种声学输出. 国家检测支持交互;语言映射,表示研究和数据集报告描述研究范围.

blocks.en: Table 7: Content-output forms and associated evaluation questions. Auxiliary control and study scope are recorded separately.
blocks.zh: 表7:内容产出表和相关评价问题。 辅助控制和研究范围另行记录.

blocks.en: 5.3 Neural features and learned representations
blocks.zh: 5.3 神经特征和学到的表述

blocks.en: Figure 8: Three intermediate-representation routes connect neural features to communication outputs. (a) Linguistic-unit scores support sequence decoding and word or character fidelity ( Willett et al., 2023 ) . (b) Articulatory or acoustic features support speech synthesis and optional audio-linked facial output ( Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ) . (c) Semantic alignment supports matching supplied candidates or generating text that can differ in wording while preserving meaning ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . Solid arrows indicate inference; dashed arrows mark training supervision, not test-time reference inputs. Patterns, trajectories, scores and messages are illustrations, not reported results. The evaluation terms identify distinct output qualities; routes can be combined.
blocks.zh: 图8:三个中间代表路线将神经特征与通信输出连接起来. (a) 语言单位的分数支持序列解码和词或字符忠诚度(Willett等人,2023年)。 (b) 艺术或声学特征支持语音合成和可选音频链接面部输出(Anumanchipalli等人,2019年;Metzger等人,2023年)。 (c) 语义校正支持匹配所提供候选人或生成在保留意义的同时措辞可能不同的案文(Tang等人,2023年)。 固体箭头表示推论;破折箭头标记训练监督,而不是试验时间参考输入. 图案,轨迹,分数和信息都是插图,没有报告结果. 评价术语确定了不同的产出质量;路线可以合并。

blocks.en: Three routes describe recurring intermediate representations across content decoders ( Figure 8 ). The text route maps neural features to phoneme or character posteriors and lets a language model resolve them into words ( Herff et al., 2015 ; Willett et al., 2023 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ). The voice route predicts an articulatory or acoustic intermediate and renders audio with a vocoder, increasingly in streaming form ( Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ; Littlejohn et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ) . The meaning route predicts semantic embeddings to rank supplied candidates or guide a language model that generates gist ( Tang et al., 2023 ; d’Ascoli et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ) . These are interfaces between measurements and output constraints, not successive stages of technical maturity. A method can share an architecture with another route while solving a different reconstruction problem ( Table 8 ).
blocks.zh: 三条路线描述跨内容解码器反复出现的中间表示(图8 ). 文字路线将神经特征映射给电话或字符后传,让一个语言模型把它们解决成文字(Herff等人,2015年;Willett等人,2023年;Metzger等人,2023年)。 语音路由预测一个动脉或声学中间体,并用vocoder制作音频,越来越以流体形式出现(Anumanchipalli等人,2019年;Littlejohn等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2025年)。 意义路由预言语义嵌入为所提供候选人排位,或引导语言模型生成gist(Tang等人,2023年;d ' Ascoli等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2024年b). 这些是测量和输出限制之间的接口,而不是技术成熟的连续阶段. 一种方法可以在解决不同的重建问题时与另一个路由共享一个架构(表8 ).

blocks.en: Intermediate targets also connect model design to physiology. Population recordings reveal articulator organisation and coordinated articulatory trajectories, while phoneme classifiers expose distinctions that can be composed into words ( Bouchard et al., 2013 ; Chartier et al., 2018 ; Mugler et al., 2014 ) . These findings motivate production-related targets for learning. When an articulatory trajectory is inferred from audio, it remains model-derived supervision rather than a direct measurement of the participant’s movement.
blocks.zh: 中间目标还将模型设计与生理学联系起来. 人口录音揭示了动画组织和协调动画轨迹,而电话分类器则揭示了可以用文字构成的区别(Bouchard等人,2013年;Chartier等人,2018年;Mugler等人,2014年)。 这些调查结果激励了与生产有关的学习目标。 当从音频中推断动脉轨迹时,它仍然是模型产生的监督,而不是对参与者运动的直接测量。

blocks.en: Pretrained models supply useful structure at these interfaces. Speech representations such as wav2vec 2.0 provide alignment targets for MEG/EEG, whereas sequence decoders supply linguistic structure for Perceived–Auditory text generation ( Défossez et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2024a ) . This can reduce what must be learned from scarce paired neural data. It also makes two outcomes separable: a better completed output and a more informative neural representation. Shared latent spaces align neural populations across patients, whereas long recordings within one participant provide repeated observations for learning temporal structure ( Spalding et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Özdogan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024c ) . These approaches address different sources of data scarcity: variation in the neural populations sampled and limited coverage of linguistic experience.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的模型在这些接口提供有用的结构. wav2vec 2.0等语音表达提供了MEG/EEG的对齐目标,而序列解码器为Perceived-Auditory文本生成提供了语言结构(Défossez等人,2023年;Wang等人,2026年a;Yang等人,2026年b;Yang等人,2024年a). 这可以减少从稀缺的配对神经数据中必须学到的东西. 这也使得两种结果可以分离:更好的完成产出和更加翔实的神经表现. 共有的潜在空间使患者的神经群一致,而一名参与者的长录音为学习时间结构提供了反复的观察(Spalding等人,2026年;Singh等人,2025年;Özdogan等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2024年c) 。 这些办法涉及数据稀缺的不同来源:抽样的神经病群的变化和语言经验的覆盖面有限。

blocks.en: Table 8: Intermediate representations distribute the learning problem differently. The same neural architecture can serve several routes; the useful comparison is what structure it learns, which supervision it needs and how the output is constructed. Clinical attempted remains a source-task description.
blocks.zh: 表8:中级代表对学习问题分布不同。 同样的神经架构可以服务于几个途径;有用的比较是它学到什么结构,它需要什么样的监督,以及输出是如何构造的. 临床尝试仍然是源任务描述.

blocks.en: The task-dependent representations in Figure 4 provide the physiological basis for these computational interfaces. Local motor recordings can supply fast articulatory or phonemic structure; auditory recordings can align with the presented speech; distributed and slower responses can constrain meaning over longer context. The decoding objective selects which part of that information must survive the mapping to an output.
blocks.zh: 图4中的任务依赖表示为这些计算界面提供了生理基础. 本地的马达录音可以提供快速的动脉或语音结构;听觉录音可以与所呈现的语音一致;分布和较慢的响应可以限制意义超过更长的上下文. 解码目标选择信息中哪些部分必须在映射到输出后存活。

blocks.en: A phoneme or character interface makes lexical errors inspectable and allows a language model to combine neural evidence into new sequences. It also requires a linguistic target and an account of how the prior changes the decoded message ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ) . An acoustic or articulatory interface instead preserves a route to voice characteristics and temporally evolving expression; paired audio and a vocoder supply information that is harder to obtain during silent production ( Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ) . Semantic alignment can relax exact wording and exploit longer-context representations, but an output can preserve gist while losing a negation, name or intended action ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . Route selection therefore fixes both the information that must be learned and the errors that matter to the user.
blocks.zh: 电话或字符接口使得词汇错误可以检查,并允许语言模型将神经证据结合到新的序列中. 它还要求有一个语言目标,并说明先前如何改变解码消息(Willett等人,2023年;Metzger等人,2023年)。 声学或动脉接口相反保留了语音特性和时间演化表达的路由;配对音频和vocoder供应信息,在无声制作过程中难以获得(Anumanchipalli等人,2019年;Wairagkar等人,2025年). 语义一致可以放松确切的措辞,利用较长的文字表述,但产出可以保留重点,同时失去否定、名称或预期行动(Tang等人,2023年)。 因此,路由选择既可以修正必须学习的信息,也可以修正对用户重要的错误。

blocks.en: Retrieval makes the alternative set explicit and can be useful when only a small number of decisions is needed; its success is conditional on that set. Generation permits combinations beyond a supplied candidate list, but shifts part of the prediction problem into a learned prior. Moving from retrieval accuracy to generated text is consequently a change of task, not just a stronger score on the same task. A useful comparison holds the intended content and test information fixed, then asks whether the extra output freedom preserves the user’s distinctions.
blocks.zh: 检索使替代的整套决定明确,在只需要少数决定时可以有用;其成功取决于这套决定。 代代相传使得组合超出了所提供候选人名单的范围,但将部分预测问题转变为事先学到的。 因此,从检索的准确性转向生成的文本是任务的变化,而不仅仅是在同一任务上的更强分。 一个有用的比较可以固定预定内容和测试信息,然后问额外的输出自由是否保留了用户的区别.

blocks.en: 5.4 Classification and retrieval
blocks.zh: 5.4 分类和检索

blocks.en: Classification is useful when a small set of alternatives matches the intended decision. It also tests whether a representation contains a particular distinction: selected ECoG electrodes separate internally articulated vowels, and low- and cross-frequency ECoG features carry Inner item or attribute information ( Ikeda et al., 2014 ; Proix et al., 2022 ) . The strength of that evidence is condition- and participant-specific. Eight-class cued Inner decoding from supramarginal single neurons reached online accuracies of 79% and 23% in two participants ( Wandelt et al., 2024 ) ; pairwise ECoG inner-word decoding averaged 58% against 50% chance across five participants, despite a best value of 88% ( Martin et al., 2016 ) . A population code demonstrated in one configuration therefore does not establish uniformly usable control.
blocks.zh: 如果一套替代品与预定决定相吻合,分类就是有益的。 它还测试一种表示法是否包含特定的区别:所选的ECoG电极分离了内部表达的元音,低频和跨频的ECoG特性携带内项或属性信息(Ikeda等人,2014年;Proix等人,2022年). 这些证据的优点是有条件的,也是参与者特有的。 超边际单神经元的8级内饰解码在两个参与者中达到79%和23%的在线速率(Wandelt等人,2024年);对等的ECoG内词解码在五个参与者中平均为58%和50%,尽管最高值为88%(Martin等人,2016年)。 因此,在一个组合中展示的人口代码不能建立统一的可用控制。

blocks.en: Spatial structure offers another architectural choice for classification. BrainStack combines seven regional convolutional experts with a global convolution–Transformer expert, using learned routing and global-to-local distillation to coordinate their predictions ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . This makes regional specialisation and cross-region integration explicit within one model. Its EEG word-decoding task selects among predefined classes, so the relevant contribution concerns how those alternatives are discriminated.
blocks.zh: 空间结构为分类提供了另一种建筑选择. BrainStack将七位区域革命专家与一位全球革命专家 — — Transformer 专家,利用学到的路由和全球到地方的蒸馏来协调他们的预测(Zhao等人,2026年). 这使得区域专业化和跨区域一体化在一种模式中具有明确性。 它的EEG词解码任务在预定义的类别中选择,因此相关贡献涉及这些替代品如何受到歧视.

blocks.en: Reading versus Inner, preparation versus execution, and neural-only versus fused inputs test different explanations of a score. A five-word EEG/MEG comparison decoded silent reading more successfully than its mostly near-chance Inner conditions ( Csaky et al., 2025 ) . MEG preparation-window results, including 93% for five phrases and 67.2% for self-paced yes/no compared with 90.4% during overt production, remain tied to forthcoming speech ( Dash et al., 2020 ; Dash et al., 2024 ) . Repeated-word EEG windows must additionally separate content from cues and overlapping observations ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . For EEG–fNIRS, group means of 34.3% and 77.3% in different four-class studies are not a controlled improvement; the latter study’s within-protocol finding of no fusion benefit over EEG alone answers a narrower, more useful acquisition question ( Cooney et al., 2022 ; Hons et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 阅读与 内在,准备与执行, 和神经唯心与引信输入测试 对一个分数的不同解释。 5个字的EEG/MEG比较解码无声读数比其大部分接近的内在条件(Csaky等人,2025年)更成功. MEG的制备-窗口结果,包括5个短语的93%和自定的 " 是/否 " 的67.2%,与公开生产期间的90.4%相比,仍然与即将发表的演讲有关(Dash等人,2020年;Dash等人,2024年)。 重复字的 EEG 窗口必须另外将内容与提示和重叠的观测区分开来(Jiang等人,2026年). EEG-fNIRS认为,在不同的四类研究中,34.3%和77.3%的组别并不是一个可控的改进;而后一项研究中仅对EEG没有聚变效益的校内结论就回答了一个更狭窄、更有用的获取问题(Coney等人,2022年;Hons等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Non-invasive classification can likewise probe a specific target without establishing sequence reconstruction. A 7-T fMRI study classified pairs of spoken phonemes at 53% against 33% chance in 15 participants ( Vitória et al., 2024 ) , while an OPM-MEG/EEG comparison examined time-resolved decoding of six Mandarin vowels in ten participants ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Their value lies in testing access to these distinctions and their timing; sentence generation requires additional evidence about how distinctions compose.
blocks.zh: 非侵入性分类同样可以探测特定目标而不建立序列重建. 一项7-T fMRI的研究以53%的机率对15名参与者的33%的机率进行了分类(Vitória等人,2024年),而OPM-MEG/EEG的比较则对10名参与者的6个普通话元音的解码时间解码(Xu等人,2026年)进行了检查. 其价值在于测试这些区别的获取及其时间;句子生成需要更多关于区别如何构成的证据.

blocks.en: Contrastive speech alignment can identify a multi-second segment without resolving its individual words. Across four datasets and 175 participants, MEG/EEG alignment retrieved the correct 3-second segment among more than 1,000 candidates with top-1 accuracy of 41% in the best MEG setting ( Défossez et al., 2023 ) . Word-level retrieval in a larger pooled corpus of 723 participants, nine datasets, three languages and five million words reached top-10 of 37% among 250 candidates against 4% chance, including words absent from training ( d’Ascoli et al., 2025 ) . MEG, silent reading and test-time averaging were generally easier under that protocol. Hierarchical alignment to spectrograms, wav2vec2 and GPT-2 further tests representations at several linguistic or acoustic levels, with reported top-1 of 35.6% for MEG and 20.0% for EEG on SMN4Lang and SparrKULee ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . These studies broaden representation learning, but their candidate units and observation budgets remain part of the result: neither a larger candidate pool nor a higher top- k k score alone establishes finer content recovery. HD-DOT movie-segment retrieval provides an adjacent example ( Tripathy et al., 2025 ) ; without a speech-specific target, movie identification is not Perceived–Audiovisual speech decoding.
blocks.zh: 矛盾的语音对齐可以识别一个多秒段而不解决其单个单词. 在四个数据集和175名参与者中,MEG/EEG对齐在1 000多名候选人中检索到正确的3秒部分,在最佳MEG设置中,最高-1精度达到41%(Défossez等人,2023年)。 由723名参与者、9个数据集、3种语言和500万字组成的大集合中的文字检索在250名候选人中达到37%的顶级-10%,而机会为4%,包括未参加培训的文字(d ' Ascoli等人,2025年)。 MEG、默读和测试时间平均一般比较容易。 与谱系、wav2vec2和GPT-2的分级对齐,在几个语言或声学层面进行进一步的测试,在SMN4Lang和SparrKULee上,MEG和EEG的分级比例分别为35.6%和20.0%(Wang等人,2026a年)。 这些研究拓宽了代表性学习,但其候选单位和观察预算仍然是结果的一部分:无论是较大的候选人才库还是较高的最高-k k分都无法建立更精细的内容恢复。 HD-DOT电影片段检索提供了一个相邻的例子(Tridathy等人,2025年);没有针对特定言论的目标,电影识别不是Perceived–Audiovisions语音解码.

blocks.en: Long-context pretraining extends the retrieval route by reconstructing masked neural tokens from extended surrounding context, before the encoder is adapted to predict contextual word embeddings. MEG-XL uses this strategy for nearest-neighbour word selection with supplied word onsets and fixed candidate vocabularies ( Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026 ) . Its contribution is improved data efficiency and contextual representation learning within retrieval. This illustrates how a broader temporal context can improve a neural encoder without changing the output task into sentence generation. The shared LibriBrain comparison in Figure 9 shows the resulting data-efficiency difference: MEG-XL reaches 57.3% top-10 balanced accuracy with 13% of the training data and 63.0% at the full budget, where BrainOmni also reaches 63.0%. These results favour long-context pretraining at the smaller budget while showing that the ordering can change as more paired data become available.
blocks.zh: Long-context pretraining通过从扩展的周边上下文重建蒙面神经符,在编码器被调整以预测上下文词嵌入之前,扩展检索路径. MEG-XL使用这个策略来选择最近的邻里字,并附带提供词发和固定候选人词汇(Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026). 其贡献在于提高数据效率和在检索过程中进行背景表述学习。 这说明一个更广泛的时间背景如何可以改进神经编码器而不将输出任务改变为句子生成. 图9中的LibriBrain共享比较显示了由此产生的数据效率差异:MEG-XL达到57.3%的上-10均衡精度,培训数据占13%,在全额预算中为63.0%,BrainOmni也达到63.0%. 这些结果有利于在较小的预算上进行长文预训,同时表明,随着可获得更多的对齐数据,订单可能会改变。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Listening-MEG word retrieval under two training-data budgets. Pairs connect the 13% and full-data conditions in MEG-XL’s 50-word LibriBrain benchmark ( Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026 ) ; squares and circles denote these conditions, respectively. Method references are BioCodec ( Avramidis et al., 2025 ) , EEGPT ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , BIOT ( Yang et al., 2023a ) , BBL ( Jayalath et al., 2025b ) , BrainOmni ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , LaBraM ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) and MEG-XL ( Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026 ) . Word onsets are supplied; pretraining resources and context lengths differ. Top-10 chance is 20%. Exact values are printed beside each pair; three-seed SEMs appear in Table 18 .
blocks.zh: 图9:在两个培训数据预算下检索听-MEG字数。 平面连接了MEG-XL的50个字LibriBrain基准(Jayalath和Parker Jones,2026)中的13%和全数据条件;方块和圆圈分别表示这些条件. 方法参考文献有BioCodec(Avramidis等人,2025年),EEGPT(Wang等人,2024年b),BIOT(Yang等人,2023年a),BBL(Jayalath等人,2025年b),BrainOmni(Xiao等人,2025年b),LaBraM。 (Jiang等人,2024年)和MEG-XL(Jayalath and Parker Jones,2026年). 提供词源;培训前资源和语境长度不同。 10大机会为20%. 准确的数值按每对打印;三种子的SEM出现在表18。

blocks.en: A leakage-audited benchmark of cross-subject auditory-evoked EEG vowel perception in 16 participants found a best balanced accuracy of 21.5% against 20% chance, with no implementation significant after correction ( Li and Tao, 2026 ) . For MEG-to-audio retrieval, a source-attribution audit showed that signal-blind noise reaches Rank@1 66.3% under variable-length decoding and collapses to chance once fixed-duration windows and stimulus-identity splits are enforced, after which a smaller but real stimulus-locked signal remains ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh: 在16位参与者中,一个跨主体听觉-EEG元音感知的渗漏审计基准发现最佳平衡精度为21.5%,而概率为20%,校正后没有显著实施(Li and Tao, 2026). 对于MEG到Audio的检索,一项来源分配审计显示,信号盲噪在可变长度解码下达到Rank@166.3%,一旦执行固定期限窗口和刺激识别分拆,就会崩溃成偶然,之后仍会有一个较小但真实的刺激锁定信号(Zhang等人,2026c).

blocks.en: Visual language separates tracking a representation from identifying content. Cortical tracking of inferred acoustic features during unfamiliar silent lip-reading supports a link between visual input and acoustic representations ( Bourguignon et al., 2020 ) . Word-identity decoding in MEG ( Keitel et al., 2020 ) and syllable or consonant decoding in auditory cortex, using fMRI in 64 participants and iEEG in 14 ( Karthik et al., 2024 ) , additionally test discrimination among linguistic alternatives. Their convergence motivates asking which representation carries the content; different target sets and recording conditions preclude a common accuracy comparison. These lip-reading tests also remain distinct from decoding written language.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言将跟踪一个表示和识别内容区分开来. 在不熟悉的无声读唇过程中,对推断的声学特征进行皮质跟踪,支持视觉输入和声学表现之间的联系(Bourguignon等人,2020年)。 MEG中的单词识别解码(Keitel等人,2020年)和听觉皮层中的音节或相容解码,64名参与者使用fMRI,14名参与者使用iEEG(Karthik等人,2024年),另外测试了语言替代品之间的区别. 它们的趋同性促使人们询问哪些表述带有内容;不同的指标集和记录条件排除了共同的准确性比较。 这些读唇测试也仍然有别于对书面语言的解码.

blocks.en: Table 9: Inner research develops content discrimination, cross-condition output generation and reusable protocols. Rows are grouped by contribution; task instructions, participant counts and chance levels define the tested condition. Study N can exceed condition N. Quantities are author-reported under heterogeneous protocols and are not a common ranking.
blocks.zh: 表9 内部研究发展内容歧视,交叉条件输出生成和可重复使用的协议. 行按贡献分类;任务指示,参与者计数和机会水平确定测试条件. 研究N可以超过条件N. 量根据不同协议报告作者,不是常见的排名.

blocks.en: 5.5 Text decoding
blocks.zh: 5.5 文本解码

blocks.en: Text decoding composes neural evidence into linguistic sequences. One family predicts phonemes or characters and uses a language model to assemble them into words; another learns an encoder–decoder mapping from recordings to a text sequence. Early chronic phoneme discrimination and a 50-word clinical ECoG system established useful building blocks and a sentence-level application, respectively ( Brumberg et al., 2011 ; Moses et al., 2021 ). Larger-vocabulary systems combine these building blocks with richer sequence models. The distinction between an explicit linguistic intermediate and an end-to-end text objective helps explain their supervision and generalisation behaviour.
blocks.zh: 文字解码将神经证据编成语言序列. 一个家族预测电话或字符,并使用语言模型将它们组装成单词;另一个家族学习从录音到文本序列的编码器-解码器映射. 早期慢性电话歧视和50字临床ECoG系统分别建立了有用的构件和句子级应用(Brumberg等人,2011年;Moses等人,2021年). 较大的蒸汽系统将这些构件与更丰富的序列模型结合起来. 明确的语言中间体和端到端文本目标的区别有助于解释它们的监督和概括行为.

blocks.en: ECoG phone representations combined with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) back-end and language model enabled continuous phrase-to-text decoding in seven participants ( Herff et al., 2015 ) . Encoder–decoder learning subsequently treated neural-to-text mapping as a sequence-translation problem, reaching a best WER of 3% in a four-participant study with repeated sentences ( Makin et al., 2020 ) . Self-supervised pretraining on separate unlabelled overt ECoG recordings further improved decoding in a repeated 30–50-sentence setting ( Yuan and Makin, 2024 ) . These developments improve representation and sequence learning under a controlled inventory; held-out repetitions, unseen sentences and new participants remain distinct generalisation tests.
blocks.zh: ECoG手机表达方式与自动语音识别(ASR)后端和语言模型相结合,使得7名参与者能够连续进行短语对文本的解码(Herff等人,2015年). Encoder–decoder学习后来将神经对文本映射作为一个序列翻译问题处理,在四参与研究中以重复句子达到3%的最佳WER(Makin等人,2020年). 自我监督的关于单独无标签的公开ECoG录音的预训,在反复的30-50判决情况下进一步改善了解码(袁和马金,2024年). 这些事态发展改进了受控库存下的代表性和顺序学习;连续重复、未见的句子和新的参与者仍然是独特的概括测试。

blocks.en: A representation that separates articulatory units must also preserve distinctions that change lexical identity in the target language. Mandarin illustrates the resulting choice of targets: sEEG in two speakers classified seven places of articulation at 86.5% from superior temporal gyrus and four lexical tones at 58.3% from thalamus ( Wu et al., 2024a ) . These local classifications identify potentially useful features, whereas a five-participant iEEG study tested sentence recovery, decoding ten Mandarin sentences composed of 40 characters at 21% WER with 93% tone classification ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) . Acoustic-inspired sentence decoders further connect speech features with logosyllabic text ( Feng et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) . The design implication is to test both the relevant linguistic distinction and composed text: tone accuracy cannot substitute for word accuracy, and a closed sentence inventory does not establish new-sentence composition.
blocks.zh: 区分动画单位的表示还必须保留改变目标语言中词汇特征的区分. 普通话说明了由此产生的目标选择:在两个演讲者中,SEEG将7个发音地点分类为:86.5%来自优时陀螺仪,4个语法音调为:58.3%来自丘脑(Wu等人,2024a)。 这些本地分类找出了潜在的有用特征,而由五人参与的iEEG研究测试了句子恢复,解码了由40个字符组成的10个普通话句子,以21%的WER为单位,音调分类为93%(Zhang等人,2024a). 。 。 。 声学启发的句子解码器进一步将语音特征与标志符号文字连接起来(冯等人,2025年;刘等人,2023年). 设计含义是检验相关的语言区分和组成文字:音调精度不能取代词的精度,封闭的句子清点不能确定新句子组成.

blocks.en: Clinical text systems connect sequence decoding to communication without normal audible production. Phoneme-based models have expanded from constrained lexicons to large vocabularies, while rapid calibration makes participant-specific fitting more practical ( Table 10 ). Multi-user intracortical models address a complementary objective: reusing a decoder across people by learning user-specific projections and calibrating it for held-out users ( Fogg et al., 2026 ) . This shift from fitting each model in isolation to sharing linguistic structure is a concrete route towards reducing initial training requirements.
blocks.zh: 临床文本系统将序列解码与通信连接,而无需正常的声波生产. 基于电话的模型已经从受限制的词汇扩展为大词汇,而快速校准则使具体参与者的适合性更加实用(表10)。 多用户内部规范模式涉及一个互补目标:通过学习用户特定预测,在人群中重新使用解码器,并对被搁置用户进行校准(Fogg等人,2026年)。 这种从孤立地安装每个模型到共享语言结构的转变,是减少初始培训需求的具体途径。

blocks.en: Table 10: Clinical speech interfaces expand from compositional text to audible, expressive and sustained communication. Rows are grouped by contribution, retaining the source term attempted where residual articulation is unconfirmed. N is study- or condition-specific. T15 recurs across Card and Wairagkar reports, and BRAVO3 across Metzger and Littlejohn; rows cannot be summed as independent cohorts. Vocabulary, WER and word accuracy refer to the stated tasks.
blocks.zh: 表10:临床语音界面从构成文本扩展为可听,可表达和持续通信. 将各行按贡献分类,保留未证实剩余表述的源词。 N是特定学习或条件。 T15在卡德和Wairagkar报告之间反复出现,而BRAVO3则在Metzger和Littlejohn之间出现;行不能被归纳为独立的群. 词汇,WER和词的准确性是指所声明的任务.

blocks.en: Brain-to-Text ’24 comparisons on a common private test set separate algorithmic gains from differences in participant recordings ( Figure 10 ). The retrospective attributes the strongest gains to complementary decoder predictions and language-model rescoring, alongside improved training and phonemic objectives ( Willett et al., 2024 ) . A later time-masked Transformer ensemble reports 5.68% WER, and BIT lowers the cascaded ensemble result to 5.10% after cross-task and cross-species encoder pretraining ( Feghhi et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ) . BIT’s end-to-end ensemble reaches 10.22%, compared with 24.69% for the earlier end-to-end system in its comparison. A stronger pretrained encoder therefore helps both frameworks, but the cascaded language-decoding stage remains advantageous on this benchmark. LightBeam subsequently compares the language-decoding stage with the neural encoder held fixed, improving WER across its paired GRU and Transformer settings while changing the language resources ( Feghhi et al., 2026 ) . Together, these comparisons locate progress at the interface between neural evidence and sequence inference, rather than attributing every gain to a larger neural encoder.
blocks.zh: 在普通的私人测试中进行24个脑对图文的比较,从参与者录音的差异中得出了单独的算法收益(图10)。 这一回顾将最大的成果归因于互补的解码器预测和语言模式的重新评分,以及改进的培训和语音目标(Willett等人,2024年)。 后期的变形器综艺报告为5.68%WER,BIT将跨任务和跨物种编码器预演后的级联综艺结果降低至5.10%(Feghhi等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年d). BIT的端对端组合达到10.22%,相比之下,早期的端对端系统则达到24.69%. 因此,一个经过强化的事先培训的编码器有助于两个框架,但级联语言解码阶段在这一基准上仍然有利。 LightBeam随后将语言解码阶段与被固定的神经编码器进行比较,在其配对的GRU和变形器设置上改进了WER,同时改变了语言资源(Feghhi等人,2026年). 这些比较加在一起,将进展定位在神经证据和序列推论的界面上,而不是将每个增益归结为更大的神经编码器.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Attempted-speech comparisons separate complete systems from paired language decoders. (a) Brain-to-Text ’24 private-test WER: the RNN baseline follows BIT’s comparison ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) ; Linderman, LISA and TeamCyber follow Willett et al. (2024) ; DCoND-LIFT ( Li et al., 2025b ) , the time-masked Transformer ( Feghhi et al., 2025 ) and BIT ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) use their strongest reported cascaded ensembles. These systems share 1,200 test sentences but differ in training and language resources. (b) LightBeam ( Feghhi et al., 2026 ) holds a Transformer encoder fixed within each pair: squares use a weighted finite-state transducer (WFST) to combine lexical and language-model constraints; circles use LightBeam. Language resources change from 5-gram/OPT to 4-gram/Llama, with benchmark-text adaptation; public and private partitions remain separate. Values are means across ten encoder seeds.
blocks.zh: 图10:尝试的语句比较将完整系统与配对语言解码器分离. (a) Brain-Text ' 24的私人测试WER:RNN基线遵循BIT的比较(Zhang等人,2026d);Linderman,LISA和TeamCyber遵循Willett等人(2024);DCoND-LIFT(Li等人,2025b);定时变压器(Feghi等人,2025年)和BIT(Zhang等人,2026d)使用它们所报告的最强级联赛。 这些系统共有1,200个测试句,但在培训和语言资源方面有所不同。 (b) LightBeam(Feghi等人,2026年)持有固定在每对内部的变形器编码器: 方块使用加权有限态转录器(WFST)将词汇和语言模型约束结合起来; 圆圈使用LightBeam. 语言资源从5克/OPT改为4克/Llama,并调整了基准文本;公共和私人分区仍然分开。 价值是指跨越十种编码种子.

blocks.en: Perceived–Auditory MEG provides a complementary test of whether these interfaces can work with non-invasive recordings. Phoneme-level sentence reconstruction from ten hours per participant reported phoneme error of 62.2% and sentence CER of 65.8% ( Vélez et al., 2026 ) ; a joint text-and-acoustic model proposes coupling two output targets ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . These approaches make the intermediate linguistic or acoustic constraint explicit. Generative sequence models additionally learn how to complete linguistic content, making held-out text and matched input controls central to the comparison.
blocks.zh: Perceived–Auditory MEG为这些接口能否与非侵入性录音配合提供了补充测试. 电话一级句子的重建,从每个参与者10小时起,报告电话误差为62.2%,句子CER误差为65.8%(Vélez等人,2026年);联合文本和声学模型建议将两个产出目标(Jin等人,2026年)结合起来。 这些方法使中间语言或声学限制变得明确。 基因序列模型额外学习了如何完成语言内容,使搁置文本和匹配的输入控制成为比较的核心.

blocks.en: Generative MEG models connect a neural encoder to a language or speech generator through three main interfaces: continuous neural features, discrete neural tokens, or predicted linguistic representations. The last route can operate on individual words or whole sentences. These choices determine how much timing information the decoder needs and whether its output is primarily constrained by lexical evidence or sentence meaning ( Figure 11 ).
blocks.zh: 基因MEG模型通过三个主要接口将神经编码器与语言或语音生成器连接起来:连续神经特征,离散神经符号,或预测语言表达. 最后的路线可以在单个单词或整个句子上运行. 这些选择决定解码器需要多少时间信息,其输出是否主要受到语法证据或句子含义的限制(图11).

blocks.en: Direct sequence models adapt an existing generator to neural input. NeuSpeech uses a Whisper-style decoder and reports BLEU-1 of 60.30 on Gwilliams without test-time teacher forcing ( Yang et al., 2024b ) . This sentence–recording-pair split permits familiar stimulus sentences across partitions; holding out an entire story asks the model to recover new linguistic content. Under story holdout, MAD aligns neural and speech features and reports BLEU-1 of 6.86 and CER of 89.82% ( Yang et al., 2024c ) . NeuGPT instead compresses the recording into discrete neural tokens and incorporates these tokens into a Qwen2 language model. Its MEG-MASC comparison reports BLEU-1 of 12.92 and ROUGE-1F of 13.06, compared with 5.49 and 8.43 for NeuSpeech in the same table ( Yang et al., 2024a ) . NeuGPT’s CER is 99.8%, showing that the gain in overlapping words does not translate into correspondingly accurate character sequences. The choice of neural interface and the held-out linguistic content therefore matter alongside the generator’s capacity.
blocks.zh: 直接序列模型将一个现有的生成器适应神经输入. NeuSpeech使用一种Whiper风格的解码器,并在Gwilliams上报告60.30的BLEU-1,无需测试时间教师强迫(Yang等人,2024b). 这个句子 - 记录- pair 拆分允许熟悉的刺激句子横跨分区; 持有一个完整的故事要求模型恢复新的语言内容. 在故事坚持度下,MAD将神经和语音特征与6.86的BLEU-1和89.82%的CER(Yang等人,2024c.)相协调。 NeuGPT转而将录音压缩成离散神经符号,并将这些符号融入到Qune2语言模型中. 其MEG-MASC比较报告BLEU-1为12.92,ROUGE-1F为13.06,而同一表中NeuSpeech为5.49和8.43(Yang等人,2024a)。 NeuGPT的CER为99.8%,表明重叠词的增益不会转化为相应的准确字符序列. 因此,选择神经界面和搁置的语言内容与生成器的能力一样重要。

blocks.en: A word-level interface makes the lexical constraints on generation explicit. The Oxford system predicts contextual word embeddings from onset-aligned MEG, converts their vocabulary similarities into word probabilities, and rescores candidate sequences with a language model ( Jayalath et al., 2025a ) . Its comparison extends the NeuGPT benchmark on the same held-out-story split, placing NeuSpeech, MAD, NeuGPT and word-based generation together ( Figure 11 a). The rounded BLEU-1 scores rise from 5 and 7 for NeuSpeech and MAD to 13 for NeuGPT and 18 for Oxford beam-and-fill decoding; CER falls from NeuGPT’s 100% to 71%. Earlier baseline scores are quoted, whereas Oxford evaluates its own models with supplied word onsets and out-of-vocabulary positions. Pooling additional LibriBrain and Armeni training data retains BLEU-1 of 18 but changes CER to 72%, so more training data does not improve every measure. On LibriBrain, a separate comparison replaces supplied out-of-vocabulary positions with a learned detector: BLEU-1 rises from 19 for greedy decoding to 22 after beam rescoring and 24 after in-filling, while CER falls from 77% to 76% and 69%. Together, these results show how composing uncertain lexical predictions can improve text reconstruction, while making the timing and vocabulary information supporting that improvement explicit.
blocks.zh: 一个单词级界面使得对生成的词典限制变得明确. 牛津系统预测背景词嵌入自发端-对齐的MEG,将其词汇相似性转换为词概率,并将候选序列与语言模型重计(Jayalath等人,2025a). 其比较将NeuGPT基准扩展至相同的持有的外层分割,将NeuSpeech,MAD,NeuGPT和基于词的生成放在一起(图11 a). 四舍五入的BLEU-1分数从NeuSpeech和MAD的5分和7分升至NeuGPT的13分和牛津束和填充解码的18分;CER从NeuGPT的100%降至71%. 引用了较早的基线分数,而牛津则用所供应的词发和省外位置来评价自己的模型。 集合额外的LibriBrain和Armeni培训数据保留了18个BLEU-1,但将CER修改为72%,因此更多的培训数据并不能改善每一项计量. 在LibriBrain上,一个单独的比较用一个有学问的探测器取代了所提供的外省位置:BLEU-1由于贪婪的解码从19个上升到22个,在梁重评后又上升到24个,而CER则从77%下降到76%和69%. 这些结果共同表明,编译不确定的词汇预测如何能改善文本的重建,同时使支持这种改进的时间和词汇信息明确。

blocks.en: A sentence-level interface changes the target from individual words to their combined meaning. Brain2Semantics2Text maps MEG through a temporal encoder and attention pooling into a sentence-embedding space, then inverts the predicted vector into text ( Landau et al., 2026 ) . This later Oxford study compares three methods on the same 172 held-out LibriBrain sentences from one participant ( Figure 11 b). Brain2Semantics2Text and BrainECHO retain sentence boundaries but remove word-level alignment, reaching BERTScores of 0.830 and 0.828, respectively; their matched noise controls score 0.819 and 0.825. A word-aligned implementation of d’Ascoli’s method reaches 0.820, versus 0.794 with noise. WER orders the methods differently: 192.5%, 101.8% and 87.1%, respectively. The semantic route’s longer reconstructions contribute to its higher WER. These descriptive scores suggest a trade-off between sentence-level similarity and control of exact wording and length; the word-aligned route benefits from a more explicit lexical constraint. Both semantic quality and the improvement over matched input controls are needed to understand this trade-off.
blocks.zh: 一个句子级接口将目标从单个单词变为其综合含义. 脑2 语义2 文本通过一个时间编码器映射MEG,并将注意力集中到一个句子嵌入空间中,然后将预测的矢量反转为文本(Landau等人,2026年). 后来的牛津研究比较了一名参与者对同样的172个LibriBrain句子的三种方法(图11b)。 Brain2Semantics2Text和BrainECHO保留句子边界,但去除词级对齐,分别达到0.830和0.828的BERTScore;它们的对应噪声控制得分为0.819和0.825. 对d ' Ascoli方法的文字协调执行达到0.820,而有噪音的为0.794。 WERR的指令方法不同:分别为192.5%,101.8%和87.1%. 语义路线较长的重建有助于其更高的WER. 这些描述性分数表明,句子一级相似性与控制确切措辞和长度之间是取舍的;字面一致的路由得益于更明确的词典限制。 要了解这种权衡,就需要提高语义质量,改进相应的输入控制。

blocks.en: Figure 11: MEG-to-text methods share benchmark lineages but use different linguistic interfaces. (a) NeuSpeech ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , MAD ( Yang et al., 2024c ) , NeuGPT ( Yang et al., 2024a ) and Oxford ( Jayalath et al., 2025a ) follow Oxford’s held-out-story comparison. Earlier scores are quoted by that paper; Oxford’s pooled beam-and-fill configuration adds LibriBrain/Armeni training data and uses supplied word onsets and out-of-vocabulary positions. (b) Brain2Semantics2Text ( Landau et al., 2026 ) , BrainECHO ( Li et al., 2025a ) and d’Ascoli’s word-aligned method ( d’Ascoli et al., 2025 ) follow the later LibriBrain comparison ( Landau et al., 2026 ) . All receive sentence boundaries; the last also receives word timing. Metrics are displayed on a 0–100 scale, with WER allowed above 100. Each row uses one configuration. Matched noise results and SDs are in Table 19 .
blocks.zh: 图11:MEG对文本方法共享基准线条,但使用不同的语言界面. (a) NeuSpeech(Yang等人,2024年b),MAD (Yang等人,2024c),NeuGPT(Yang等人,2024a)和牛津(Jayalath等人,2025a)遵循牛津的搁置式场外比较. 早期的分数被论文引用;牛津的集合光束和填充配置增加了LibriBrain/Armeni的训练数据,并使用了所供应的词发和省外位置。 (b) Brain2Semantics2Text(Landau等人,2026年),BrainECHO (Li等人,2025年a)和d ' Ascoli的词对齐法(d ' Ascoli等人,2025年)沿用后来的LibriBrain比较法(Landau等人,2026年). 都得到句子边界;最后一个也得到字段计时. 度量衡以0–100尺度显示,WER允许高于100. 每行使用一个配置. 相匹配的噪音结果和自毁数据载于表19。

blocks.en: BrainECHO inserts a vector-quantised spectrogram reconstruction between the neural encoder and Whisper, comparing this route with EEG-to-Text, NeuSpeech and MAD under shared evaluations ( Li et al., 2025a ) . On Brennan EEG with held-out participants, the four implementations yield BLEU-1 scores of 8.82, 85.31, 80.34 and 89.78; the corresponding WERs are 233.99%, 16.97%, 42.14% and 11.72% ( Figure 12 ). On shuffled Gwilliams MEG recording pairs, BrainECHO reaches BLEU-1 of 73.35 and WER of 31.44%, compared with 50.49 and 71.17% for the authors’ NeuSpeech implementation. The acoustic intermediate thus improves both lexical overlap and edit accuracy in these comparisons. The story-held-out Oxford benchmark asks a different generalisation question: participant or recording-pair holdout can retain familiar stimulus text, whereas story holdout removes that source of linguistic familiarity. Its lower absolute scores cannot isolate the effect of this split because the models, implementations and supplied timing information also differ.
blocks.zh: BrainECHO在神经编码器和Whisper之间插入一个矢量分光谱重建,在共享评价(Li等人,2025a)下将这条路径与EEG到Text,NeuSpeech和MAD相比较. 关于被搁置的Brennan EEG, 四个执行方案得分为8.82、85.31、80.34和89.78;相应的WER为233.99%、16.97%、42.14%和11.72%(图12)。 BrainECHO在洗牌的Gwilliams MEG录制配对上达到73.35的BLEU-1和31.44%的WER,而作者的NeuSpeech执行率为50.49%和71.17%。 因此,声学中间体在这些比较中既改进了词汇重叠,又改进了编辑的准确性. 以故事为主的牛津基准提出了一个不同的概括性问题:参与者或录音-pair holdout可以保留熟悉的刺激文字,而故事的坚持则消除了语言熟悉的来源。 其较低的绝对分数不能孤立这种分数的影响,因为模型,执行和提供的时间信息也不同.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Listening benchmarks compare lexical overlap and edit errors within each recording split. BrainECHO’s published comparison ( Li et al., 2025a ) evaluates EEG-to-Text ( Wang and Ji, 2022 ) , NeuSpeech ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , MAD ( Yang et al., 2024c ) and BrainECHO ( Li et al., 2025a ) . (a) Brennan EEG uses participant holdout; (b) Gwilliams MEG uses shuffled recording-pair splits. Values are the comparison authors’ implementations, including their NeuSpeech rerun. Familiar stimulus texts can occur across participants or recordings, unlike the story holdout in Figure 11 a. Each row reports a single configuration, on the source’s 0–100 scale.
blocks.zh: 图 12:聆听基准比较每个录制拆分中的词汇重叠和编辑错误. BrainECHO的出版比较(Li等人,2025年a)评价了EEG对文本(Wang and Ji,2022年),NeuSpeech(Yang等人,2024年b),MAD. (Yang等人,2024c)和BrainECHO (Li等人,2025年a).(a) Brennan EEG使用参与者搁置;(b) Gwilliams MEG使用冲洗式录音-pair分机。 价值是作者的比较执行,包括NeuSpeech的重新运行。 更熟悉的刺激文本可以在参与者之间或录音中出现,不同于图11 a中的故事搁置. 每行报告一个单一的配置,以 0–100 比例表示。

blocks.en: 5.5.1 Perceived–Visual: Reading EEG-to-text
blocks.zh: 5.5.1 透视:从电子电子计算机到文本

blocks.en: Reading-based decoding targets text that the participant sees, rather than speech that they hear or intend to produce. Visual stimulation, eye movements and language processing can all contribute to the recordings. Much EEG-to-text research relies on ZuCo, which combines EEG and eye tracking during English reading: 12 participants and 1,107 sentences in ZuCo 1.0 ( Hollenstein et al., 2018 ) , and 18 participants and 739 sentences in ZuCo 2.0 ( Hollenstein et al., 2020 ) . Fixation-based segmentation supplies word-aligned features in some pipelines; other methods process continuous segments without fixation markers. Reuse of these corpora across algorithm papers does not provide new participant cohorts.
blocks.zh: 基于阅读的解码目标为参与者看到的文本,而不是他们听到或打算制作的言论. 视觉刺激、眼动和语言处理都有助于录音。 大部分EEG到文本的研究依赖于ZuCo,该研究结合了EEG和英语读音时的眼线跟踪:ZuCo 1.0中有12名参与者和1,107句(Hollenstein等人,2018年),ZuCo 2.0中有18名参与者和739句(Hollenstein等人,2020年). 基于固定的区段提供一些管道中的文字对齐特征;其他方法处理连续区段而无固定标记. 重复使用这些跨算法论文不能提供新的参与者群。

blocks.en: Methods address three recurring mismatches between EEG and a pretrained text generator ( Table 11 ). First, neural recordings and linguistic tokens have different structure: contrastive learning, discrete encoders, masked autoencoding, cross-modal codebooks and byte-pair alignment seek a more usable interface ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Duan et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024c ; Tao et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024a ) . Second, recordings vary across people and datasets; participant-dependent representations and EEG pretraining address this learning problem, while shared fMRI/EEG architectures and Chinese reading data broaden the settings examined ( Amrani et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Xi et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2025a ) . Third, the language generator completes information missing from the neural representation. BART-based decoding and GPT-4 refinement illustrate that dependence on a text prior ( Wang and Ji, 2022 ; Amrani et al., 2026 ) . Each intervention changes a different part of the information chain: improved text overlap alone cannot show which mismatch has been resolved.
blocks.zh: 方法解决EEG与一个预训文本生成器之间三次反复出现的不匹配(表11). 首先,神经录音和语言符号的结构不同:对比性学习、离散编码器、蒙面自动编码、跨模式编码本和字节-pair对齐寻求更有用的接口(冯等人,2023年;杜安等人,2023年;王等人,2024年c;陶等人,2025年;周等人,2024年a). 其次,录音因人和数据集而异;依赖参与者的表示和EEG预训解决了这一学习问题,而共享fMRI/EEG架构和中文读取数据则拓宽了所检查的设置(Amrani等人,2026年;Liu等人,2024年;Xi等人,2023年;Lu等人,2025年a年). 第三,语言生成器完成神经表达中缺失的信息. 基于BART的解码和GPT-4的改进说明,依赖前文(Wang and Ji, 2022 ; Amrani等人, 2026 ). 每次干预都会改变信息链的不同部分:仅靠改进后的文本重叠无法显示哪些不匹配问题已经得到解决.

blocks.en: Repeated use of ZuCo makes several method families directly traceable through published comparisons ( Figure 13 a). In the 10,710-training-sample comparison reported by CET-MAE, BLEU-4 rises from 6.80 for EEG-to-Text to 8.22 for DeWave and 8.99 for E2T-PTR ( Wang et al., 2024c ) . Broader representation learning and decoder adaptation extend this lineage: the reported multi-view EEG2Text result is 14.10, and BELT-2 with a T5 decoder reports 17.95 ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024a ) . The earlier teacher-forced results are shown separately in Figure 13 a; SEE and BELT-2 retain their original reporting conditions in Table 11 . Their differing training pools, test-prefix policies and output processing determine the strength of cross-paper comparisons. For example, C-SCL removes consecutive repeated generated words before scoring, whereas the original EEG-to-Text pipeline retains them ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024c ) .
blocks.zh: 多次使用ZuCo使得几种方法家族通过公布的比较可以直接追踪(图13a). 在CET-MAE报告的10,710种培训-样本比较中,BLEU-4从EEG对图文的6.80升至DeWave的8.22,以及E2T-PTR的8.99(Wang等人,2024c)。 更广泛的表达式学习和解码器适应扩展了这一语系:报告的多视图EEG2Text结果为14.10,BELT-2为T5解码器报告17.95(Liu等人,2024;Zhou等人,2024a). 图13a分别列出了较早的师资成果;SEE和BELT-2保留了表11中的原始报告条件。 它们不同的培训库、测试前缀政策和产出处理决定了交叉纸张比较的力度。 例如,C-SCL在评分前删除连续重复生成的单词,而原来的EEG-to-Text输油管保留这些单词(Feng等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年c ).

blocks.en: Supplying correct previous tokens during testing changes autonomous generation into prediction conditional on a correct prefix. A ZuCo evaluation compared BART-, Pegasus- and T5-based pipelines with real and noise inputs, both with and without test-time teacher forcing ( Jo et al., 2026 ) . Comparable EEG/noise performance in the tested configurations shows why text overlap alone cannot establish a neural contribution. Separately, sentence overlap in inspected cross-participant splits leaves linguistic familiarity available even when the participant changes ( Yin et al., 2025 ) . These are distinct shortcuts: removing correct prefixes does not remove repeated content, and holding out participants does not necessarily hold out text.
blocks.zh: 在测试中提供正确的前代词会以正确的前缀为条件将自动生成改变为预测. 一项ZuCo评价将基于BART、Pegasus和T5的管道与真实的和噪音的输入进行比较,无论有无试验时间教师强迫(Jo等人,2026年)。 在测试的配置中可比较的EEG/噪声性能表明,单是文本重叠不能确定神经作用的原因. 另外,在被检查的跨参加方分裂中,句子重叠,即使参加方发生变化,语法也变得熟悉(Yin等人,2025年)。 这些是截然不同的快捷键:删除正确的前缀不会删除重复的内容,而持有参与者并不一定会持有文本.

blocks.en: Figure 13: Reading EEG-to-text comparisons distinguish supplied prefixes from autonomous generation. (a) Teacher-forced reports: EEG-to-Text ( Wang and Ji, 2022 ) , DeWave ( Duan et al., 2023 ) , C-SCL ( Feng et al., 2023 ) , participant-dependent BART ( Amrani et al., 2026 ) , CET-MAE ( Wang et al., 2024c ) and EEG2Text ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Training pools differ; the dagger marks C-SCL’s removal of consecutive repeated output words. (b) EEG-to-Text, GLIM ( Liu et al., 2025b ) and SemKey ( Wang et al., 2026d ) use SemKey’s unique-text autoregressive benchmark. Identification compares generated text with its target and 23 distractors; chance is 4.17%. (c) Guiding LLMs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and Brain-CLIPLM ( Yang et al., 2026a ) extend EEG-to-Text under the latter paper’s semantic-anchor comparison, which quotes earlier values. (d) COFETT’s autoregressive reruns ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) compare BrainBART/EEG-to-Text, BELT ( Zhou et al., 2024b ) , DeWave, EEGNet ( Lawhern et al., 2018 ) , EEGConformer ( Song et al., 2023 ) and EEGPT ( Wang et al., 2024b ) . All scores use a 0–100 scale; panels are separate evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 图13:读取EEG对文本的比较,区分所提供的前缀和自主生成. (a) 教师强迫报告:EEG-to-Text(王和智,2022年),DeWave(Duan等人,2023年),C-SCL(Feng等人,2023年),依赖参与者的BART(Amrani等人,2026年),CET-MAE(王和智,2024年c)和EEG2Text(Liu等人,2024年). 训练池不同;匕首标志着C-SCL删除了连续重复输出的单词。 (b) EEG-to-Text,GLIM(刘等人,2025年b)和SemKey(王等人,2026年d)使用SemKey独有的文本自递基准. 识别将生成的文本与其目标及23个分散注意力者进行比较;概率为4.17%. (c) 指导LLMs(郑等人,2026年)和Brain-CLIPLM(杨等人,2026a年)在后一论文的语义和定理比较下将EEG扩展为Text,其中引用了早先的数值。 (d) COFETT的自动回转(Zhang等人,2026f)比较BrainBART/EEG-to-Text,BELT(周等人,2024b),DeWave,EEGNet(Lawhern等人,2018年),EEGConform (Song等人,2023年)和EEGPT (Wang等人,2024b). 所有得分都使用0-100比例;面板是单独的评价设置.

blocks.en: GLIM combines language modeling with contrastive alignment and multiple textual variants to learn representations that support autoregressive generation ( Liu et al., 2025b ) . SemKey adds explicit semantic attributes and evaluates this progression against EEG-to-Text under a unique-text split ( Wang et al., 2026d ) . In that common comparison, original-reference BLEU-1 is 11.90, 7.84 and 8.98 for EEG-to-Text, GLIM and SemKey, respectively; generated-text 24-way identification is 4.17%, 10.74% and 16.24% ( Figure 13 b). The strongest n-gram baseline is therefore at chance on the semantic identification task. Higher overlap with a reference and better discrimination of its meaning are distinct forms of progress, and both are needed to interpret these methods.
blocks.zh: GLIM将语言模型与对比对齐和多种文字变体相结合,学习支持自递生成的表示(Liu等人,2025b). SemKey 添加了明确的语义属性,并在独有的文本分割(Wang et al., 2026d ) 下对照 EEG 到文本来评价这一进展. 在该共同比较中,最初参考的BLEU-1对EEG至Text、GLIM和SemKey分别为11.90、7.84和8.98;生成的文本24路识别为4.17%、10.74%和16.24%(图13b)。 因此,最强的n克基线在语义识别任务上是偶然的. 与其含义的参照和更好的区别重叠是不同的进步形式,两者都需要解释这些方法。

blocks.en: A complementary line explicitly recovers semantic anchors before reconstructing a sentence. Guiding LLMs aligns EEG and language representations; Brain-CLIPLM then uses ordered keyword anchors, language-model reasoning and a task-specific sentence corpus ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) . Brain-CLIPLM’s published comparison reports BLEU-1 of 17.0, 21.3 and 22.4 for EEG-to-Text, Guiding LLMs and Brain-CLIPLM, alongside ROUGE-1 F of 17.8, 20.3 and 22.9 ( Figure 13 c). The progression motivates intermediate semantic targets, while the corpus-assisted reconstruction condition remains central to interpreting what the neural signal supplies.
blocks.zh: 补充线在重建句子前明确恢复语义锚. Guideing LLMS 将 EEG 和语言表达相协调; Brain-CLIPLM 之后使用命令关键词主播,语言模型推理和任务特定句式(郑等人,2026年;杨等人,2026年a ). Brain-CLIPLM出版的BLEU-1比较报告为17.0、21.3和22.4,其中EEG对文本、Guideing LLM和Brain-CLIPLM与ROUGE-1 F为17.8、20.3和22.9(图13c)。 进展刺激了中间语义目标,而实体辅助重建条件仍然是解释神经信号供应的核心。

blocks.en: COFETT additionally re-evaluates reading decoders without correct test prefixes. On its ZuCo 1+2 comparison, BrainBART, BELT and DeWave produce BLEU-1 values of 13.75, 15.55 and 14.36, with WER above 108% in all three cases; EEGNet, EEGConformer and EEGPT adaptations extend the same comparison to distinct neural encoders ( Figure 13 d) ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) . Discrete diffusion offers another output model: DELTA raises BLEU-1 from 13.69 for its autoregressive BART baseline to 21.93 under the same residual-vector-quantisation interface, while WER remains 110.03% ( Jeon and Kim, 2025 ) . Improvements in local overlap have thus outpaced reliable sentence reconstruction in these autonomous tests.
blocks.zh: COFETT额外重新评价读取解码器时没有正确的测试前缀. 在ZuCo 1+2的比较中,BrainBART、BELT和DeWave的BLEU-1值为13.75、15.55和14.36,在所有三种情况下,WER高于108%;EEGNet、EEGConformer和EEGPT的适应性将同样的比较扩大到了独特的神经编码器(图13d)(Zhang等人,2026f )。 分散扩散提供了另一种输出模式:DELTA将BLEU-1从其自动BART基线的13.69提高到21.93,而WER仍为10.03%(Jeon和Kim,2025年). 因此,地方重叠的改善超过了这些自主测试中可靠的句子重建的速度。

blocks.en: A related but different task is COFETT’s cued recall after reading: its central comparison measures Pearson correlation between EEG-derived and text embeddings across sessions with repeated sentences and noise controls ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) . This tests cross-session representation alignment on repeated content; it does not establish autonomous generation of novel sentences. The distinction connects reading benchmarks to internal recall without treating them as the same behavioural task.
blocks.zh: 一个相关但不同的任务就是COFETT在读完后提示的回忆:其中心比较测量了EEG衍生物与包含重复句子和噪声控制的会话中嵌入文本之间的皮尔逊关联(Zhang等人,2026f). 这考验了重复内容的跨会场代表配对;没有建立自主生成新句子. 这种区分将阅读基准与内部召回联系起来,而不把它们视为相同的行为任务。

blocks.en: Table 11: Reading EEG-to-text methods, grouped by the interface between neural representations and language. Results retain the stated input and inference conditions; shared benchmark comparisons appear in Figure 13 . BLEU, ROUGE and BERTScore values are on a 0–100 scale. TF denotes test-time teacher forcing (correct previous tokens). Classification, EEG-embedding retrieval and semantic identification of generated text are distinct evaluation tasks.
blocks.zh: 表11 阅读 EEG-对文本方法,按神经表达和语言的界面分类. 结果保留了说明的投入和推论条件;共享基准比较见图13。 TF 表示测试时间老师强制( 更正以前的令牌) 。 对生成的文本进行分类、EEG-嵌入检索和语义识别是不同的评价任务。

blocks.en: A useful comparison holds the generator, segmentation information and inference protocol fixed, then tests whether neural inputs improve decoding of held-out text over matched uninformative inputs. Participant or session holdout tests whether that advantage survives recording changes. Together with controls for visual, ocular and other task-related signals, these comparisons provide stronger evidence that the representation carries transferable linguistic information.
blocks.zh: 一个有用的比较使生成器、分解信息和推论协议固定下来,然后测试神经输入是否比匹配的非信息输入改进了被搁置文本的解码。 参与者或会议暂停测试这一优势是否在记录变化后继续存在。 这些比较与对视觉、视觉和其他与任务有关的信号的控制一起,提供了更强有力的证据,证明这种表示方式载有可转移的语言信息。

blocks.en: 5.5.2 Semantic targets and generated text
blocks.zh: 5.5.2 语义目标和生成的文本

blocks.en: Cue-conditioned generation combines a neural representation with content supplied by the experiment. An EEG masked-autoencoder/BERT system reported masked-token accuracy of 48.9% in training and 27.3% in validation ( Rastogi et al., 2025 ) , illustrating the gap between learning a token representation and predicting held-out content. MindSpeech uses HD-fNIRS from word-cloud-cued internal sentence production to prompt-tune Llama-2 for text-prefix-conditioned continuation, reporting BLEU-1 and BERT-precision improvements in three of four participants ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . Cue words and the language prior already constrain plausible sentences. Prompt-only and matched shuffled-signal comparisons are therefore needed to measure the additional content supplied by the neural recording.
blocks.zh: 有条件的生成结合了神经表达和实验提供的内容. 一个EEG蒙面自动编码器/BERT系统报告,在培训中蒙面自动编码的准确度为48.9%,在验证中为27.3%(Rastogi等人,2025年),这说明在学习象征性表述和预测搁置内容之间的差距。 MindSpeech使用HD-fNIRS从字云化的内部句子制作到快速调Llama-2用于文本前置条件的续作,报告BLEU-1和BERT精度改进的4位参与者中有3位(Zhang等人,2024年b). 语句和前面的语句已经限制可信句子 。 因此,需要快速和匹配的洗牌信号比较,以衡量神经记录提供的额外内容。

blocks.en: fMRI-based language decoding with a language-model prior reconstructed the gist of continuous heard stories in three participants and transferred to internally narrated stories and silent videos ( Tang et al., 2023 ) ; the target is semantic content rather than verbatim wording. In the imagined-speech experiment, the decoder generated text for five one-minute stories; evaluation compared these sequences with separately recorded retellings using semantic similarity and five-story identification. This demonstrates generative transfer under that protocol, while leaving unrestricted self-generated communication unestablished. Autoregressive generation reconstructed ten minutes of language stimulus ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , and language-free movies have been used for cross-participant alignment ( Tang and Huth, 2025 ) . These extensions test whether a shared semantic representation can support transfer when the source and target stimuli differ.
blocks.zh: fMRI基于语言的解码与语言模型之前重建了三个参与者中连续听到故事的要点,并转移到内部叙述故事和无声视频(Tang等人,2023年);目标为语义内容而不是逐字记录. 在虚构的语音实验中,解码器为5个1分钟的故事生成文字;评价将这些序列与使用语义相似性和五层识别法单独录制的重构进行对比. 这表明根据该协议进行基因转移,同时使不受限制的自我生成的通信不成立。 自动回转的生成重建了十分钟的语言刺激(Ye et al.,2025),无语言电影也被用于跨参与对齐(Tang and Huth,2025). 这些扩展测试当源和目标刺激不同时,共享语义表示是否能够支持转移.

blocks.en: Semantic reconstruction describes the target relationship between input and output, rather than a medium alongside text and audio. An embedding-retrieval model and a text generator can both recover semantic information but produce different outputs. Prompt-conditioned HD-fNIRS generation similarly requires separating neural evidence from cue and language-model constraints ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh: 语义重建描述了输入和输出之间的目标关系,而不是一个与文本和音频并列的介质. 嵌入式检索模型和文本生成器既可以回收语义信息,也可以产生不同的输出. 快速有条件的HD-fNIRS生成同样要求将神经证据与提示和语言模型约束区分开来(Zhang等人,2024b ).

blocks.en: Semantic models also differ in how brain-derived information conditions language generation. PredFT introduces a predictive representation from selected brain regions alongside a primary fMRI language-decoding network ( Yin et al., 2026 ) . Multimodal alignment models instead route among text-, image- and audio-related semantic features ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . These alternatives extend semantic conditioning beyond a single fixed embedding. Their evaluation still depends on the task and dataset; use of a shared architecture across modalities is not itself transfer of a fitted decoder between them.
blocks.zh: 语义模型在脑源信息如何给语言生成带来条件方面也有所不同. PredFT在初级fMRI语言解码网络(Yin等人,2026年)的同时,引入了来自某些大脑区域的预测性表示. 与文字、图像和音频有关的语义特征之间的多式对齐模式(Ye等人,2026年)。 这些替代品将语义修饰扩展到单一固定嵌入之外. 它们的评价仍然取决于任务和数据集;使用跨模式的共享架构本身并不是在它们之间转让一个安装的解码器。

blocks.en: The Narratives benchmark connects these representational choices to reconstruction over longer context windows. CogReader compares UniCoRN, an fMRI-adapted EEG-to-Text model, BP-GPT, PredFT and its own incremental-and-wrap-up architecture on story-disjoint data ( Lu et al., 2025b ) . Across 20, 40 and 60 repetition-time (TR) windows, CogReader’s BLEU-1 rises from 25.4 to 31.2 and 36.2, whereas PredFT rises from 24.3 to 25.9 and 26.4; UniCoRN decreases from 22.9 to 18.0. The 60-TR comparison appears in Figure 14 a. CogReader’s BERTScore F1 also increases, from 46.3 to 53.5 on the source’s 0–100 scale. These contrasting window-length trends are consistent with differences in context use, although the comparison does not isolate which architectural component causes them. A second comparison on Huth recordings tests Tang’s decoder, BrainLLM and multimodal routing without a supplied text prompt: BLEU-1 is 9.67, 13.56 and 14.72, respectively, while WER decreases from 97.00% to 95.41% and 95.03% ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . The multimodal route scores higher on these text metrics, although exact word recovery remains much weaker than the fluency of generated sentences might suggest ( Figure 14 b). Narratives and Huth form separate benchmark lineages; their absolute scores depend on different recordings and decoding windows.
blocks.zh: 叙述基准将这些代表性选择与较长的上下文窗口的重建联系起来。 CogReader比较了UniCoRN,一种fMRI适应的EEG-Text模型,BP-GPT,PredFT及其自己在故事-脱节数据上的递增和包式架构(Lu等人,2025b). 在20、40和60个重复时间窗口中,CogReader的BLEU-1从25.4升至31.2和36.2,而PredFT则从24.3升至25.9和26.4;UniCoRN从22.9降至18.0。 60-TR的比较见图14a。 CogReader的BERTScore F1也从来源的0-100比例从46.3增加到53.5。 这些对比的窗口长度趋势与上下文使用的差异是一致的,尽管比较并不孤立哪些建筑部分引起它们. Huth录音的第二次比较测试了唐的解码器,BrainLLM和多式联运的路由,但没有提供文本提示:BLEU-1分别为9.67,13.56和14.72,而WER从97.00%下降到95.41%和95.03%(Ye等人,2026年). 在这些文字衡量标准上,多式联运路线的得分较高,尽管准确的词的恢复仍然远远低于生成句子的流畅度(图14b)。 叙述和Huth分别形成基准线;其绝对分数取决于不同的录音和解码窗口.

blocks.en: Figure 14: fMRI language decoding has complementary Narratives and Huth benchmarks. (a) CogReader’s 60-TR comparison ( Lu et al., 2025b ) includes UniCoRN ( Xi et al., 2023 ) , an fMRI-adapted EEG-Text encoder ( Wang and Ji, 2022 ) , BP-GPT ( Chen et al., 2025c ) , PREDFT ( Yin et al., 2026 ) and CogReader ( Lu et al., 2025b ) ; train, validation and test stories differ. (b) Multimodal routing ( Ye et al., 2026 ) is compared with Tang’s decoder ( Tang et al., 2023 ) and BrainLLM ( Ye et al., 2025 ) without a supplied text prompt. The two datasets and decoding protocols remain separate. All metrics use a 0–100 scale; 20/40-TR and text-prompt conditions appear in Tables 20 and 21 .
blocks.zh: 图14:fMRI语言解码有互补的叙述和Huth基准. (a) CogReader的60-TR比较(Lu等人,2025年b)包括UnicoRN(Xi等人,2023年b),一个fMRI适应的EEG-Text编码器(Wang and Ji,2022年),BP-GPT(Chen等人,2025年c),PREDFT(Yin等人,2026年b)和CogReader(Lu等人,2025年b);火车,验证和测试故事不同. (b) 将多式联运路线(Ye等人,2026年)与唐的解码器(Tang等人,2023年)和BrainLLM(Ye等人,2025年)进行比较,但没有及时提供文本。 这两套数据集和解码协议仍然分开. 所有衡量标准都采用0-100比例;20/40-TR和文本即时条件见表20和21。

blocks.en: 5.6 Speech synthesis
blocks.zh: 5.6 语音综合

blocks.en: Speech synthesis separates prediction from rendering: the neural model estimates a representation and a synthesiser turns it into sound. Unit selection can reuse the participant’s voice, as demonstrated from motor, premotor and inferior frontal ECoG ( Herff et al., 2019 ) . Articulatory-kinematic targets instead impose a production-related structure, enabling ECoG sentence synthesis and transfer to mouthed production in a five-participant study ( Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ) ; its listener tests used a limited candidate word pool. Interpretable speech parameters paired with a differentiable synthesiser were studied in a 48-participant ECoG cohort ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , although each condition need not contain all 48 participants. Direct reconstruction from sensorimotor ECoG during overt speech provides another production-based route, evaluated with complementary acoustic and perceptual measures ( Berezutskaya et al., 2023 ) . These alternatives change the supervision needed and the aspects of voice accessible to the decoder.
blocks.zh: 语音合成将预测与渲染区分开来:神经模型估计一种表示,合成器将其转化为声音. 单元选择可以重用参与者的声音,从运动,机动前和低等前置ECoG(Herff等人,2019年)证明. 造型-光谱目标反而强制实行与生产相关的结构,使得ECoG句子合成,在五参与研究(Anumanchipalli等人,2019年)中转移到口腔生产;其听者测试使用一个有限的候选词池. 在48个参与的ECoG组群(Chen等人,2024b)中研究了与不同合成器配对的可解释语音参数,尽管每个条件不需要包含全部48个参与者. 从感官ECoG在公开演说中直接重建,提供了另一种基于制作的路线,得到了补充声学和感官措施的评价(Berezutskaya等人,2023年)。 这些替代办法改变了所需的监督和解码器可获取的语音方面。

blocks.en: Heard-speech reconstruction has a measured acoustic reference: auditory-cortex ECoG recovered spectrotemporal structure of words and sentences with average correlation r = 0.28 r=0.28 in 15 participants ( Pasley et al., 2012 ) . Predicting vocoder parameters from iEEG supported 75% digit recognition in a five-participant, ten-alternative listening test ( Akbari et al., 2019 ) . The latter adds perceptual evidence to acoustic similarity, but still leaves open whether listeners can recover sentences without supplied alternatives. Evaluation must follow the information the output is intended to convey.
blocks.zh: heard-speech重建有一个测量的声学参考:听觉-cortex ECoG恢复了平均相关r=0.28 r=0.28的单词和句子的光谱结构(Pasley等人,2012年). 来自iEEG的预测vocoder参数支持了在五参与的十种备选监听测试中75%的位数识别(Akbari等人,2019年). 后者为声学相似性添加了知觉证据,但仍对听众能否在没有提供替代品的情况下恢复句子留有余地. 评价必须遵循产出打算传递的信息。

blocks.en: Interactive control is a further test, even within a small output space. A single-participant sEEG system controlled two synthesised vowels after Overt training, with 85% first-round success ( Tankus et al., 2025 ) . This tests whether a user can act through audible feedback; it does not resolve the larger representational problem of composing intelligible sentences. Output diversity and closed-loop controllability should therefore be varied and measured separately.
blocks.zh: 交互控制是一个进一步的测试,即使在一个小的输出空间内也是如此. 一个单参与的SEEG系统在Overt训练后控制了两个合成元音,首轮成功率达到85%(Tankus等人,2025年). 这种测试一个用户是否能够通过可听取的反馈来行动;它不能解决构成可听懂的句子这个更大的代表问题. 因此,产出多样性和闭路可控性应当不同,并分别衡量。

blocks.en: The voice route of Figure 8 is also applied to Inner conditions. Real-time synthesis transferred from overt training to whispered and Inner speech in one sEEG participant, but the authors state the audio is not yet intelligible, and the r = 0.62 r=0.62 often quoted is overt cross-validation ( Angrick et al., 2021 ) . NeuroTalk reported inner-speech character error rate (CER) of 68.3% with a mean opinion score (MOS) of 2.78 on twelve words and CER 83.1% on the single held-out word ( Lee et al., 2023 ) . An EEG synthesis study ( Xiong et al., 2025 ) reports 91.2% listener accuracy for “intelligible utterances” from EEG, but the test is a four-alternative choice among known Mandarin disyllables with overt bridging and dynamic-time-warping (DTW) reference alignment, and the train/test independence is not fully documented.
blocks.zh: 图8的语音路由也应用于内部条件. 实时合成从公开训练转移到一名SEEG参与者的低语和内语,但作者表示音频尚不通晓,经常引用的r = 0.62 r = 0.62是公开交叉验证(Angrick等人,2021年). NeuroTalk报告说,内语字符错误率(CER)为68.3%,12个单词的平均值分数(MOS)为2.78,单词的CER为83.1%(Lee等人,2023年). 一项EEG综合研究(Xiong等人,2025年)报告,EEG的“能懂的言论”的听众精度为91.2%,但测试是已知的普通话调音符中的一种四种选择,具有公开的桥接和动态定时拨号(DTW)参照比对,火车/测试的独立性没有得到充分记录。

blocks.en: The synthesis route predicts acoustic features or articulatory parameters and renders audio. Overt training offers paired signals, whereas Mouthed and Inner transfer must cope with missing or altered acoustic supervision. Some ten-participant ECoG conditions yielded recognisable online Overt or Mouthed synthesis without intelligible Inner synthesis ( Meng et al., 2023 ) . Clinical streaming systems extend the objective to timely audible feedback ( Littlejohn et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2026 ) . Generated audio, perceptual intelligibility and an interactive speaking experience therefore require separate evidence.
blocks.zh: 合成路线预测声学特征或动脉参数,并制作音频. 公开培训提供配对信号,而口腔和内移则必须应付缺失或改变的声学监督. 一些十人参与的ECoG条件产生了可识别的在线Overt或Mouthed合成,而不易懂的内合成(Meng等人,2023年)。 临床流动系统将目标扩大到及时的反馈(Littlejohn等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2026年)。 因此,生成的音频、感知性知识以及互动的演讲经验需要单独的证据。

blocks.en: Non-invasive overt results are smaller in scale and must be checked for orofacial EMG, head motion, eye movement and acoustic cross-talk.
