Early EEG-to-acoustics regression with recurrent networks in four participants predicted acoustic features, evaluated by mel-cepstral distortion and cepstral reconstruction error ( Krishna et al., 2020 ) . These acoustic errors do not measure whether a listener can recover the words. MEG-to-mel synthesis with a Squeezeformer and BigVGAN vocoder reported a spectral correlation of r = 0.954 ± 0.014 r=0.954\pm 0.014 for five repeated phrases in four participants ( Kwon et al., 2024 ) ; this is a within-participant, closed-phrase correlation, not word accuracy.
blocks.zh: 非入侵性公开结果在规模上较小,必须检查是否为或非侵入性EMG、头部运动、眼动和声学交叉交谈。 早期的EEG对声学回归,在四个参与者的反复网络中预测声学特征,由mel-cepstral扭曲和cepstral重建错误(Krishna等人,2020年)评价. 这些声学错误并不能衡量一个听众是否能够恢复这些单词. 使用Squeezeformer和BigVGAN vocoder的MEG-to-mel合成报告,4个参与者(Kwon等人,2024年)的5个重复短语的光谱相关性为r = 0.954± 0.014 r= 0.954\pm 0.014;这是一个参与者内部的,闭语的关联,而不是字数准确性.

blocks.en: Listening supplies a measured acoustic target for non-invasive synthesis. FESDE connects EEG and speech latent modules to generate the listened waveform directly, providing an alternative to a separately predicted spectrogram ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . Together with the production-based systems above, this illustrates how waveform rendering can be learned through different intermediate representations.
blocks.zh: 听觉为非侵入性合成提供了测量的声学目标. FESDE将EEG和语音潜伏模块连接起来,直接生成听觉波形,为单独预测的谱系提供了替代(Lee等人,2024年). 与上面的以生产为基础的系统一起,这说明如何通过不同的中间表示来学习波形渲染.

blocks.en:
Brain2Speech-Net compares text-mediated synthesis, direct speech units and a phoneme-bottleneck generator on a common attempted-speech corpus ( Chandra et al., 2026 ) . On 880 unseen utterances, the LLM-rescored text cascade attains ASR WER of 20.6%, compared with 105.4% for direct speech units and 47.2% for Brain2Speech-Net ( Figure 15 ). Their reported real-time factors are 1.962, 0.060 and 0.532, respectively. Text mediation preserves lexical content most accurately in this comparison, while direct units render fastest; Brain2Speech-Net occupies an intermediate position. These are implementations with a shared neural content encoder, evaluated against synthetic reference speech, rather than the original systems’ clinical outcomes. ASR WER measures machine recognition of the rendered output, and real-time factor measures rendering cost relative to audio duration; listener intelligibility and interactive onset latency remain separate outcomes.
For non-invasive recordings, NeuroSonic compares EEG-conditioned adaptations of mean-flow, GAN and diffusion generators on held-out participants in CineBrain and EAV ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . Its EAV result reduces Fréchet audio distance from 15.87 for the diffusion baseline to 11.64 and increases predicted overall audio quality from 2.29 to 2.59; on CineBrain, the corresponding values change from 72.56 to 39.06 and from 1.07 to 1.44. CineBrain includes environmental sound, whereas EAV contains conversation. These comparisons extend acoustic generation beyond clinical speech corpora, but neither audio-distribution similarity nor a predicted quality score measures how accurately a listener can recover linguistic content.
blocks.zh:
Brain2Speech-Net比较了一种常见的试听器上的文字介质合成、直接语音单元和一个电话bottleneck生成器(Chandra等人,2026年)。 在880个未见的言语中,LLM-记分的文本级联达到20.6%的ASR WER,而直接语音单元为105.4%,Brain2Speech-Net为47.2%。 它们报告的实时系数分别为1.962、0.060和0.532。 文本调解在这一比较中最准确地保留了词汇内容,而直接单位的功率最快; Brain2Speech-Net占据中间位置. 这些是具有共享神经内容编码器的执行,对照合成参考语来评价,而不是原始系统的临床结果. ASR WER测量了机器对输出的识别,以及实时因子测量了相对于音频持续时间的成本;听众的知觉和交互式的启动时空仍然是单独的结果.
对于非侵入性录音,神经声学比较了CineBrain和EAV(Gao等人,2026年)中被扣留的参与者对平均流量、GAN和扩散发电机的EEG条件改造。 它的EAV结果将Fréchet的音频距离从15.87的传播基线缩短到11.64,并将预测的整体音频质量从2.29提高到2.59;在CineBrain上,相应的值从72.56变化到39.06,从1.07变化到1.44. CineBrain包括环境声音,而EAV包含对话. 这些比较将声学生成扩展到了临床语音corpora之外,但无论是音频-分布相似性还是预测的质量分数都无法衡量听众能够如何准确恢复语言内容.

blocks.en: Figure 15: Synthesis benchmarks compare lexical fidelity, acoustic quality and computation. (a) Brain2Speech-Net ( Chandra et al., 2026 ) reimplements an LLM-rescored text cascade ( Willett et al., 2024 ) and direct speech units ( Metzger et al., 2023 ) with a common neural encoder on 880 unseen attempted-speech utterances. ASR WER and phoneme error rate (PER) score generated audio; mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) uses synthetic VITS references. RTF is computation time divided by audio duration. (b,c) NeuroSonic’s held-out-participant comparisons ( Gao et al., 2026 ) adapt MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2025 ) , HiFi-GAN ( Kong et al., 2020 ) and Moûsai diffusion ( Schneider et al., 2023 ) to EEG. CineBrain includes environmental sound; EAV contains conversation. FAD is Fréchet audio distance, LSD log-spectral distance and SC spectral convergence. DNSMOS predicts overall audio quality; it is not a listener intelligibility score. Seconds report the source’s inference time, not clinical feedback latency. Values are source means; each dataset forms its own comparison.
blocks.zh: 图15:综合基准比较词汇忠诚度,声学质量和计算. (a) Brain2Speech-Net(Chandra等人,2026年)重新实施LLM-计分文本级联(Willett等人,2024年)和直接语音单元(Metzger等人,2023年),在880个不为人知的未遂语音上使用通用神经编码器。 ASR WER和电话me错误率(PER)分数生成音频;mel-cepstral扭曲(MCD)使用合成VITS参考. RTF是计算时间除以音频持续时间. (b,c) 神经声学被扣留的参与者比较 (Gao等人,2026年)适应MeanFlow(Geng等人,2025年),HiFi-GAN (Kong等人,2020年)和Moûsai扩散(Schneider等人,2023年)改为EEG. CineBrain)包括环境声音;EAV包含对话. FAD是Fréchet音频距离,LSD日志光谱距离和SC光谱趋同. DNSMOS预测了整体音频质量;它不是一个听众的无识分数. 数秒报告来源的推断时间,而不是临床反馈延迟。 值是源手段;每个数据集构成自己的比较.

blocks.en: 5.7 Facial and body animation
blocks.zh: 5.7 面部和身体动画

blocks.en: Facial animation adds a visual channel to neural communication. An ECoG neuroprosthesis combines decoded text, personalised speech and an avatar ( Metzger et al., 2023 ) . Its real-time avatar is driven by decoded audio, while direct neural prediction of facial motion was evaluated offline. These two designs place visual rendering at different points in the pipeline: one inherits speech timing from the synthesiser, and the other estimates movement from neural features. Visual evaluation includes sentence identification and lip/jaw trajectories, complementing the text and acoustic outcomes.
blocks.zh: 面部动画在神经通信中增加了视觉通道. 一种ECoG神经假肢结合了解码文本,个性化的语音和avatar(Metzger等人,2023年). 其实时的异形由解码音频驱动,同时对面部运动的直接神经预测被评估为离线. 这两种设计将视觉渲染置于管道的不同点:一种是继承合成器的语音定时,另一种是从神经特征上估计运动. 视觉评价包括句子识别和唇/爪轨迹,补充文字和声学结果.

blocks.en: Parallel speech and gesture decoding extends expressive control beyond the face. Each of two participants used a 253-channel ECoG array for concurrent phrase-to-text and gesture decoding, within a three-participant movement-mapping study ( Brosler et al., 2026 ) . In Bravo-6, who attempted speech with vocalisation and imagined the gestures, 200 simultaneous real-time copy trials yielded phrase accuracy of 70% and gesture accuracy of 66%, using ten phrases and ten gestures plus rest. Decoded gestures triggered preset full-body avatar animations. Training on both isolated and simultaneous attempts improved performance across contexts, showing that combining output channels also requires learning their concurrent neural activity. The contribution is coordinated verbal and nonverbal control within this repertoire, with phrase selection and gesture classification measured separately.
blocks.zh: 平行的语音和手势解码将表达式控制延伸至面部之外. 两位与会者各自在一个由三人组成的运动图谱研究中,使用253个通道的ECoG阵列进行同时的短语对文字和手势解码(Brosler等人,2026年)。 在Bravo-6中,他试图用声调说话,并想象到手势,200个同时进行的实时拷贝试验得出短语精度为70%,手势精度为66%,使用10个短语和10个手势加休息. 解码手势触发了预设的全体阿凡达动画. 关于孤立和同时进行的尝试的培训提高了不同背景的绩效,表明结合产出渠道还需要学习它们同时进行的神经活动。 贡献是在本系列中协调的口头和非口头控制,词组选择和手势分类分别衡量.

blocks.en: 5.8 Pretraining, transfer and personal calibration
blocks.zh: 5.8 预训、转让和个人校准

blocks.en: Pretraining can supply a neural encoder, an acoustic or linguistic alignment target, or an output generator. These roles address different shortages in paired neural-language data ( Mai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) . Contrastive EEG pretraining in BENDR and masked intracranial representation learning in BrainBERT illustrate reusable encoders ( Kostas et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . Speech-specific work applies self-supervised learning to overt ECoG, heterogeneous MEG data and long-context word retrieval ( Yuan and Makin, 2024 ; Jayalath et al., 2025b ; Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026 ) . Speech and language models provide the other two roles: a structured target to which neural features can align, and a prior for rendering those features as an output.
blocks.zh: Pretrain可提供神经编码器,声学或语言对齐目标,或输出生成器. 这些角色解决了配对神经语言数据的不同短缺(Mai等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年c). BENDR中的矛盾性EEG预训和BrainBERT中的遮掩的颅内表达学习说明了可重复使用的编码器(Kostas等人,2021年;Wang等人,2023年)。 语言特异性工作将自我监督的学习应用于公开的ECoG,多样性的MEG数据和长文本单词检索(袁和马金,2024年;贾亚拉斯等人,2025年b;贾亚拉斯和帕克·琼斯,2026年). 语音和语言模型提供了另外两个作用:神经特征能够与之一致的结构化目标,以及将这些特征作为输出的先导.

blocks.en: Figure 16: Pretraining contributes at three different interfaces. (a) Neural self-supervision learns reusable recording structure, as in BENDR and BrainBERT ( Kostas et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) . (b) A pretrained speech or text model provides targets for aligning a neural encoder ( Défossez et al., 2023 ) . The paired stimulus supplies training supervision. (c) An output model provides structure for constructing text or speech from neural evidence, as in language-guided semantic reconstruction ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . These roles can be combined without requiring the same training data or transfer setting. Feature patterns and messages are illustrative; the right column summarises the contribution being reused.
blocks.zh: 图 16:Pretrain在三个不同的界面上贡献. (a) 神经自闭系统学习可重复使用的录制结构,如BENDR和BrainBERT(Kostas等人,2021年;Wang等人,2023年). (b) 预先训练的语音或文本模型为调整神经编码器提供了目标(Défossez等人,2023年)。 配对的刺激提供训练监督. (c) 产出模型提供了从神经证据中构建文字或语音的结构,如语言指导语义重建(Tang等人,2023年)。 这些角色可以合并,而不需要相同的培训数据或转让设置。 特征模式和信息是说明性的;右栏概述了被重复使用的贡献。

blocks.en: Imagined-speech classification supplies a language-related downstream test for general EEG models. REVE’s BCIC2020-3 comparison brings together eleven methods, from task-trained EEGNet and Conformer models to BIOT, LaBraM and CBraMod ( El Ouahidi et al., 2025 ) . Five-class balanced accuracy increases from 44.13% for EEGNet to 49.20% for BIOT, 50.60% for LaBraM, 53.73% for CBraMod and 56.35% for REVE ( Figure 17 a). Earlier scores are quoted from prior reports under the trial split, and each complete downstream procedure includes its own model and tuning choices. CodeBrain extends this trial-split comparison to 61.01% balanced accuracy, a Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.513 and weighted F1 of 0.610; its BENDR and EEGPT baselines remain near 25% accuracy under the same reported split ( Ma et al., 2026a ) . The spread across encoders is therefore larger than the incremental gains among recent leaders. Model architecture, source data and the downstream tuning recipe jointly determine the quality of adaptation.
blocks.zh: 想象中的语义分类为一般EEG模型提供了语言相关下游测试. REVE的BCIC2020-3比较汇集了11种方法,从任务训练的EEGNet和Conformer模型到BIOT、LaBrAM和CBraMod(El Ouahidi等人,2025年)。 五级平衡精度从EEGNet的44.13%提高到BIOT的49.20%,LaBraM的50.60%,CBraMod的53.73%和REVE的56.35%(图17a)。 较早的分数取自审判分期进行的前几次报告,每个完整的下游程序包括自己的模型和调制选择. CodeBrain将这种试射分解的比对延伸至61.01%的平衡精度,Cohen的off\kappa为0.513,加权F1为0.610;其BENDR和EEGPT基线在相同报告的分解(Ma等人,2026a)下仍然接近25%的精度. 因此,编码器的分布大于最近领导人的增量收益。 模型架构,源数据和下游调制配方共同决定适应的质量.

blocks.en: Transfer to new participants changes this picture. OmniEEG-Bench evaluates ten foundation models on the separate five-class BCI-Speech dataset using a subject-disjoint split and common adaptation procedures ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Frozen linear probes and full fine-tuning produce different rankings ( Figure 17 b): CBraMod scores 28.9% and 26.2%, BIOT 20.4% and 26.7%, and REVE 22.3% and 20.8%, respectively, against 20% chance. Fine-tuning helps some representations but does not consistently improve all models on unseen participants. A separate BCIC2020-T3 comparison also finds lower scores when a participant is excluded from training: its five methods span 25.7–30.2% within participant and 18.9–20.2% in leave-one-participant-out evaluation ( Khanday et al., 2026 ) . That study evaluates official validation trials, so its absolute values should be kept separate from REVE’s test split. Trial-split performance and cross-participant transfer answer complementary questions: how well an encoder can fit a target task, and how much of its learned structure survives a change of user.
blocks.zh: 转移给新参与者改变了这一局面。 OmniEEG-Bench在单独的五级BCI-Speech数据集上,使用一个主题分离和通用的适应程序(Lu等人,2026年)评价十种基础模型. 冷冻线性探测器和全微调产生不同的排名(图17b):CBra Mod分数分别为28.9%和26.2%,BIOT分数分别为20.4%和26.7%,REVE分数分别为22.3%和20.8%,而机会为20%。 微调有助于一些表述,但并不能始终如一地改进所有未见参与者的模型。 一项单独的BCIC2020-T3比较还发现,在将参与者排除在培训之外时,分数较低:在参与者中,其五种方法的分数为25.7-30.2%,在 " 一个参与者 " 休假评价中为18.9-20.2%(Khanday等人,2026年)。 该研究评价了官方验证试验,因此其绝对值应该与REVE的测试分拆分开. 试卷分解的性能和跨参与的传输解答了互补的问题:一个编码器能在多大程度上适合一个目标任务,以及它所学的结构有多少能存活到用户的变化.

(a) Official BCIC2020-3 trial-split results combine REVE’s comparison ( El Ouahidi et al., 2025 ) with BENDR, EEGPT and CodeBrain values from Ma et al. blocks.en: Transfer can bridge tasks, participants or recording sessions; these are different learning problems. Overt-trained synthesis transferred to Mouthed production in ECoG ( Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ) . Overt or Perceived–Auditory training also improved Inner word classification in a ten-participant low-density ECoG study; four participants exceeded chance on Inner only after such transfer ( de Borman et al., 2026 ) . Silent-reading reconstruction using Overt reference alignment remains a different Perceived–Visual test ( Martin et al., 2014 ) . Transfer is useful to the extent that the target task retains the learned representation without requiring an unavailable reference.
blocks.zh: 转移可以连接任务,参与者或录制课程;这些都是不同的学习问题. 在ECoG(Anumanchipalli等人,2019年)中,露天训练的合成转移到了Mouthed生产. Overt或Perceived-Auditory trainment也改进了十人低密度ECoG研究中的内词分类;4名参与者在这种转移之后才超过内词的机会(de Borman等人,2026年)。 使用静音读取重建 公开的参照一致仍然是一种不同的观念-视觉测试(Martin等人,2014年)。 转让是有用的,因为目标任务保留了学到的表述,而不需要任何参考。

blocks.en: Transfer outcomes depend on the source and target task. Articulated EEG did not improve speaker-independent imagined-vowel classification in one study ( Bras et al., 2024 ) , whereas other multi-condition EEG work investigates how overt, whispered and imagined modes can be combined ( Alonso-Vázquez et al., 2025 ) . Such comparisons identify when shared production structure is useful and when the change in task outweighs it. They also motivate reporting learning curves over target-task labels, rather than only the final accuracy of a pretrained model.
blocks.zh: 转让结果取决于来源和目标任务。 一项研究(Bras等人, 2024年)中, 这种比较确定何时共享生产结构有用,何时任务的变化超过它。 它们也激发了在目标任务标签上报告学习曲线,而不仅仅是预先训练过的模型的最终准确性.

blocks.en: Intracortical Inner decoding used attempted-speech pretraining and up to an hour of Inner data. Cued online decoding reached a 50-word vocabulary in three participants and 125,000 words in two, with large-vocabulary WERs of 26% and 54%; the full study enrolled four participants ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) . Articulatory and Auditory instructions, prompted sentences and the partial free-recall or counting results remain distinct conditions. The large-vocabulary result thus concerns instructed linguistic production; spontaneous content and unrestricted message choice pose additional tests.
blocks.zh: 内部内部解码使用试听预训和最多一小时内数据. 熟制在线解码在3名参与者中达到了50个字的词汇,在2名参与者中达到了12.5万个字,其中大省WERs占26%,占54%;完整的研究招收了4名参与者(Kunz等人,2025年). 文法和审计指令、提示句和部分免费召回或计票结果仍然是独特的条件。 因此,大省结果涉及指示语言制作;自发内容和无限制的信息选择构成额外的测试。

blocks.en: Across participants, shared latent dynamics and position-aware models address differences in the populations sampled by micro-ECoG, surface and depth electrodes ( Spalding et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Calibrated multi-user intracortical models reuse phoneme structure while fitting a new user’s projection ( Fogg et al., 2026 ) . Across sessions, ALIGN uses semi-supervised adversarial alignment to reduce session-specific variation while retaining phoneme information ( Zhang et al., 2026e ) . Source-task transfer, new-user fitting and longitudinal adaptation thus solve different forms of mismatch; the relevant comparison keeps the target-data budget and output task explicit.
blocks.zh: 在整个参与者中,共同的潜在动态和位置认识模型解决了由微型ECoG、地表和深度电极取样的人群的差异(Spalding等人,2026年;Singh等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年a) 。 校准多用户内部模型再利用电话结构,同时适应新用户的预测(Fogg等人,2026年)。 在整个会话中,ALIGN使用半监督对抗式对调以减少会话特定变异,同时保留电话信息(Zhang等人,2026e ). 源任务转移、新用户配置和纵向调整从而解决了不同形式的不匹配;相关的比较使目标数据预算和产出任务明确。

blocks.en: Additional indexed directions are documented in Section E.1 ; the main comparisons here retain their task and source boundaries.
blocks.zh: E.1节记录了其他指数化方向;这里的主要比较保留了它们的任务和源边界。

blocks.en: These studies share a design question: which learned structure can be reused, and which mapping must be adapted to the target recordings? The reusable component may be neural temporal structure, acoustic or linguistic targets, or decoder dynamics. Adaptation may use labelled target-task examples, a fitted user projection or session-domain alignment, depending on the method ( de Borman et al., 2026 ; Kunz et al., 2025 ; Fogg et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) . Their value is measured by performance at an explicit target-data budget.
blocks.zh: 这些研究共同提出一个设计问题:哪些学习到的结构可以重复使用,哪些绘图必须适应目标录音? 可重复使用的成分可以是神经时间结构,声学或语言目标,或解码器动力学. 适应可使用贴有标签的目标任务实例、用户投影或会话域调整,视方法而定(de Borman等人,2026年;Kunz等人,2025年;Fogg等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年e) 。 其价值以明确的目标数据预算业绩来衡量。

blocks.en: Evaluation connects these design choices to their outcomes: which learned representation or prior improves performance, which intended distinctions are preserved, and under what conditions the gain remains useful.
blocks.zh: 评价将这些设计选择与结果联系起来:哪些人学到了代表性或事先改善了业绩,哪些人打算加以区分,以及在什么条件下收益仍然有用。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6. 评价

blocks.en: Evaluation has expanded with the outputs that neural decoders can produce. Early classification and retrieval studies measured whether a recording distinguished specified alternatives. Sentence decoders adopted transcription and language-generation metrics; speech synthesis added listener judgements; online neuroprostheses added speed, feedback and sustained operation. Established BCI frameworks had already separated decoder performance, interface performance and the benefit to the user ( Thompson et al., 2013 ; Thompson et al., 2014 ) . That distinction remains useful as language outputs become less constrained.
blocks.zh: 评价随着神经解码器能够产生的结果而扩大。 早期的分类和检索研究衡量记录是否区分了指定的替代品。 句子解码器采用了语录和语言生成度量衡;语音合成增加了听者判断;在线神经假肢增加了速度,反馈和持续操作. 既定的BCI框架已经将解码器性能、接口性能和对用户的好处分开(Thompson等人,2013年;Thompson等人,2014年)。 随着语文产出受到的限制减少,这种区分仍然有用。

blocks.en: Shared benchmarks now make some algorithmic comparisons possible. Brain-to-Text ’24 fixed a private attempted-speech test set, allowing different decoding pipelines to be compared by word error rate ( Willett et al., 2024 ) . The PNPL series introduced standardised listening-MEG tasks and data conditions, progressing from speech detection and phoneme classification to word classification and adaptation with limited target-user data ( Landau et al., 2025 ; Mantegna et al., 2026a ) . In parallel, independent evaluations of EEG-to-text have examined how inference settings and language priors affect the interpretation of text scores ( Jo et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026f ) . The development is therefore both quantitative and methodological: better outputs are being accompanied by clearer definitions of what was predicted and what information was available.
blocks.zh: 共享基准现在可以进行一些算法比较。 Brain-to-Text ' 24固定了一套私人的试听测试,允许用词误差率比较不同的解码管道(Willett等人,2024年)。 PNPL系列引入了标准化的监听-MEG任务和数据条件,从语音检测和电话分类发展到以有限的目标用户数据进行字词分类和调整(Landau等人,2025年;Mantegna等人,2026年a). 同时,对EEG到文本的独立评价也研究了推论设置和语言前传如何影响文本分数的解释(Jo等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年f月). 因此,这种发展既包括数量方面,也包括方法方面:在取得更好的产出的同时,还更明确地界定了所预测的情况和可获得的信息。

blocks.en: Four dimensions organise the following synthesis: Quality , Robustness , Efficiency and Credibility ( Figure 18 ). They summarise related measurement traditions rather than a settled universal standard. Published results can be compared where their task, data and scoring conditions match; broader clinical progress can be described across studies while retaining differences in participants and use settings. Method-specific benchmark results accompany their decoding routes in Section 5 ; the following discussion traces the measurement standards and their interpretation. Reported timing examples retain their original definitions and use settings.
blocks.zh: 四维组织如下综合: 质量、活力、效率和可信度(图18)。 它们总结了相关的计量传统,而不是既定的普遍标准。 所公布的结果可以在其任务,数据和评分条件相匹配的地方进行比较;在保留参与者和使用环境差异的同时,可以在各种研究中描述更广泛的临床进展. 方法特定基准结果与它们在第5节中的解码路线相伴随;以下讨论跟踪测量标准及其解释。 报告的时间示例保留其原始定义和使用设置.

blocks.en: Figure 18: Evaluation practices have broadened from decoding scores to transfer, communication costs and source attribution. Each panel connects a measurement question to methods used in the literature and an active point of discussion ( Thompson et al., 2014 ; Post, 2018 ; Willett et al., 2024 ; Jo et al., 2026 ; Mantegna et al., 2026a ) . The four dimensions organise the review; they do not define a new composite score or a universal evaluation protocol. WER and CER denote word and character error rates.
blocks.zh: 图 18:评价做法已经从解码分数扩大到转移、通信费用和来源归属。 每个面板将一个测量问题与文献中所使用的方法和一个活跃的讨论点联系起来(Thompson等人,2014年;Post,2018年;Willett等人,2024年;Jo等人,2026年;Mantegna等人,2026年a). 这四个方面组织审查;它们没有定义新的综合分数或普遍评价协议。 WER和CER表示文字和字符错误率.

blocks.en: 6.1 Quality
blocks.zh: 6.1 质量

blocks.en: Classification and retrieval remain useful when the scientific question concerns a specific linguistic distinction or an interface offers a defined set of alternatives. Accuracy, classwise scores and confusion matrices describe recoverable contrasts; top- k k accuracy or rank describes retrieval among supplied candidates. Candidate size and class frequency matter because a system that favours common words can achieve high aggregate accuracy while rarely recovering less frequent content. Balanced measures and explicit vocabularies make that behaviour visible. Finite-sample significance additionally depends on the number and dependence of observations, not only the nominal chance probability ( Combrisson and Jerbi, 2015 ) . The PNPL 2026 design retains explicit word vocabularies and discusses vocabulary coverage alongside performance, reflecting the difficulty of comparing retrieval tasks whose candidate sets differ ( Mantegna et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 当科学问题涉及具体的语言区别或界面提供一套界定的替代办法时,分类和检索仍然有用。 准确性,类分和混淆矩阵描述可恢复的对比;顶-k精度或等级描述所提供候选人的检索. 候选人的大小和类频重要,因为倾向于常用词的系统可以实现高度的集合精度,而很少恢复较少的内容. 平衡的措施和明确的词汇使这种行为明显可见。 有限-样本意义还取决于观测的数量和依赖性,而不仅仅是名义上的机会概率(Combrisson and Jerbi, 2015). PNPL 2026设计保留了明确的词组,并结合性能来讨论词汇覆盖,反映了比较其候选套位不同的检索任务的困难(Mantegna等人,2026a). 。 。 。

blocks.en: Sequence outputs require accounting for insertions and deletions as well as wrong choices. Phoneme, character and word error rates measure edit operations against a reference; WER is ( S + D + I ) / N (S+D+I)/N , where S S , D D and I I count substitutions, deletions and insertions, and N N is the number of reference words. Clinical text studies and shared attempted-speech benchmarks use WER to compare decoded messages with prompted transcripts ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ; Willett et al., 2024 ) . This supports interpretable within-protocol comparison while retaining an important distinction between the neural-unit decoder and the language-assisted final transcript.
blocks.zh: 序列产出要求说明插入和删除以及错误的选择。 Phoneme,字符和单词错误率根据一个引用来衡量编辑操作;WER是(S+D+I)/N(S+D+I)/N,其中SS,DD和I计算替换,删除和插入,NN是引用单词的数量. 临床文本研究和共享的尝试语素基准使用WER将解码信息与提示语录进行比较(Willett等人,2023年;Metzger等人,2023年;Willett等人,2024年)。 这支持可解释的校内比较,同时保留神经单元解码器和语言辅助最终记录的重要区别.

blocks.en: BLEU and ROUGE entered neural text generation through machine translation and summarisation, while contextual similarity measures such as BERTScore allow agreement beyond exact lexical overlap ( Papineni et al., 2002 ; Zhang et al., 2020 ) . These metrics answer different questions: BLEU-1 measures unigram overlap, not word accuracy, and semantic similarity may reward a paraphrase despite changes in a name, relation or negation. Tokenisation and implementation also change the resulting score ( Post, 2018 ) . For semantic reconstruction, information understood by a recipient supplies a complementary endpoint. Independent readers answered questions about a heard story after reading its fMRI-decoded reconstruction ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . This links generation to comprehension while leaving verbatim transcription as a separate objective.
blocks.zh: BLEU和ROUGE通过机器翻译和汇总进入神经文本生成,而BERTScore等背景相似度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 这些度量衡回答了不同的问题:BLEU-1测量单格重叠,而不是词精度,语义相似,尽管名称,关系或否定有变化,但仍可能奖励一个参数. 切入和执行也改变结果得分(Post, 2018). 对于语义重建来说,被接受者理解的信息提供了一个互补的终点. 独立读者在阅读了fMRI的解码重建(Tang et al., 2023)后,回答了关于一个听到的故事的问题. 这把生成与理解联系起来,同时把逐字记录作为一个单独的目标。

blocks.en: The current debate concerns both the metric and the evidence that produced it. Jo and colleagues compared EEG-to-text models under the same decoding settings with real and noise inputs, showing that overlap scores can remain similar in the tested configurations ( Jo et al., 2026 ) . COFETT instead emphasises sentence-level embedding alignment across repeated reading/recall conditions and recording sessions ( Zhang et al., 2026f ) . These studies broaden the available tests, but embedding alignment, repeated-content recognition and autonomous generation of new sentences remain different endpoints. For text intended as exact communication, edit errors and meaning-sensitive assessment therefore provide complementary information; for a semantic target, recipient understanding directly addresses the purpose of the representation.
blocks.zh: 当前的辩论既涉及衡量标准,也涉及产生标准的证据。 乔和同事将同一解码设置下的EEG对文本模型与真实和噪声输入进行对比,显示重叠分数在测试配置中可能保持相似(Jo等人,2026年). 反之,COFETT强调句子层面嵌入调和反复读/召的条件和录制会话(Zhang等人,2026f.)。 这些研究拓宽了现有的测试,但嵌入式对齐,重复内容识别和自主生成新句子仍然是不同的终点. 因此,对于作为准确沟通内容的案文,编辑错误和对含义敏感的评估提供了补充信息;对于语义目标,接受方的理解直接涉及表述的目的。

blocks.en: Speech synthesis has moved from correlation with recorded acoustic features towards testing what listeners can understand and how they perceive the voice. Objective measures such as STOI were developed for particular distortions of audible speech ( Taal et al., 2011 ) ; subjective assessment separately measures intelligibility and perceived quality ( International Telecommunication Union, 1994 ) . Neural speech studies use both constrained identification and less constrained transcription. Ten-alternative digit recognition and four-alternative disyllable identification establish recoverable distinctions within those inventories ( Akbari et al., 2019 ; Xiong et al., 2025 ) ; open transcription asks whether a listener can recover an utterance without being offered the answer set. Naturalness, prosody and voice identity describe further gains that a transcription score alone would miss. Avatar neuroprostheses add sentence identification and facial-trajectory measurements for visual expression ( Metzger et al., 2023 ) . Consequently, a useful assessment pairs content recovery with the expressive property that the system aims to preserve.
blocks.zh: 语音合成从与录制的声学特征的关联性转移到测试听觉者能理解什么以及他们如何看待声音. 制定诸如STOI等客观措施是为了特别歪曲可听的言论(Taal等人,2011年);主观评估分别衡量不易知性和感知质量(国际电信联盟,1994年)。 神经语音研究既使用受约束的识别,也使用较少的受约束的语录. 十位数字识别和四位数字分解识别在这些清单中确立了可收回的区别(Akbari等人,2019年;Xiong等人,2025年);公开的抄录质问听众是否可以收回一个不提供答案的语句。 自然性,音质和语音特征描述的是,单凭抄录得分就会错过的进一步收益. Avatar神经假肢为视觉表达添加了句子识别和面部外观测量(Metzger等人,2023年). 因此,有益的评估将内容回收与该系统旨在保存的明示财产挂钩。

blocks.en: A shared test set supports a method comparison when the target, scoring implementation and permitted inference information are fixed. Training-data budgets, external language resources and candidate vocabularies remain part of that comparison. The route-specific results in Figures 10 , 9 , 13 and 11 illustrate these choices in Methods. Across routes, the reusable standard is the declared evaluation contract: what is held out, what information is supplied and which output property is scored. It does not require pooling different tasks into one ranking.
blocks.zh: 当目标,评分执行和允许的推论信息固定时,共享的测试集支持方法比较. 培训数据预算、外部语文资源和候选词汇仍然是这一比较的一部分。 图10、图9、图13和图11中具体路线的结果说明了这些方法的选择。 跨路线,可重复使用的标准是申报的评价合同:持有什么,提供的信息是什么,哪些产出财产被打分. 它不需要将不同的任务集中到一个排名中。

blocks.en: 6.2 Robustness
blocks.zh: 6.2 强性

blocks.en: Repeated-item recordings made within-person decoding and held-out repetitions early practical evaluation settings. Larger natural-language corpora subsequently enabled tests of new sentences or stories, while pooled recordings enabled session and participant transfer. These splits change different parts of the prediction problem: new content challenges linguistic generalisation, a new day changes the recording, and a new participant changes anatomy, coverage and the learned neural mapping. Cross-validation methodology formalises the corresponding separation between training, model selection and testing ( Varoquaux et al., 2017 ) . The settings are complementary, rather than successive grades on one robustness scale.
blocks.zh: 重复在人内进行解码和被搁置的录音重复了早期的实用评价设置. 较大的自然语言公司随后允许测试新的句子或故事,而集合录音则允许会话和参与者的转移。 这些分裂会改变预测问题的不同部分:新内容挑战语言泛化,新一天改变录音,新参与者改变解剖学,覆盖和学习神经映射. 交叉验证方法将培训、模型选择和测试之间的相应分离形式化(Varoquaux等人,2017年)。 这些设置是互补的,而不是在一个稳健尺度上连续的成绩。

blocks.en: This distinction explains several apparently conflicting results. A decoder can recover another recording of a familiar sentence yet perform poorly on unfamiliar text. Repeated-sentence ECoG results, reading split analyses and repeated-cue EEG studies show why the unit held out matters ( Makin et al., 2020 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . In listening-MEG generation, story holdout changes the task from recovering familiar material to composing text for new linguistic content ( Section 5 ). Common data and fixed holdouts make these differences explicit and allow subsequent studies to improve the same prediction setting.
blocks.zh: 这一区别解释了几个显然相互冲突的结果。 一个解码器可以恢复另一段对熟悉的句子的录音,但对不熟悉的文字却表现不佳. 反复判决的ECoG结果,读到分裂分析以及重复的EEG研究表明,为什么该单位坚持事端(Makin等人,2020年;Yin等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2026年)。 在监听-MEG生成中,故事搁置将任务从回收熟悉的材料转变为为新的语言内容编译文本(第5节)。 共同的数据和固定的阻力使这些差异变得明确,并允许随后的研究改善同样的预测环境.

blocks.en: Figure 19: A held-out unit defines the generalisation question. Illustrative train/test pairs vary content, participant or session while keeping the other attributes familiar. Session indices are local to each participant; holding out person B does not establish future-session transfer. Jointly new participants and text require both forms of separation. Reading split analyses show why participant separation alone can retain familiar sentences ( Yin et al., 2025 ) ; cross-validation must preserve the independent unit relevant to the intended use ( Varoquaux et al., 2017 ) . These are different prediction settings rather than stages on a single robustness scale.
blocks.zh: 图19:一个被搁置的单位定义了泛化问题. 说明式列车/测试对在保持其他属性熟悉的同时,内容,参与者或会话各不相同. 每个参加者的会话指数是本地的;持有人B并不确定未来会话的转移。 联合新参与者和文本要求两种形式的分离。 阅读分裂分析显示,为什么仅参与者分离就可以保留熟悉的句子(Yin等人,2025年);交叉验证必须保留与预期用途相关的独立单位(Varoquaux等人,2017年). 这些是不同的预测设置,而不是单强尺度的阶段。

blocks.en: Shared representations across distributed intracranial recordings demonstrate that data from other people can improve a target decoder ( Singh et al., 2025 ) . Multi-user models, shared MEG encoders and session-domain alignment extend this approach through different reusable components ( Fogg et al., 2026 ; Jayalath and Parker Jones, 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) . The important comparison is performance at a stated amount of target data: zero-shot prediction asks what transfers without fitting, whereas calibrated prediction asks how efficiently prior learning supports a new recording. High accuracy after extensive personal fitting answers a different question from effective adaptation with a few minutes of data.
blocks.zh: 分布式内部录音的共用表述表明,其他人提供的数据可以改进目标解码器(Singh等人,2025年)。 多用户模型,共享MEG编码器和会话域对齐通过不同的可重复使用组件扩展了这种方法(Fogg等人,2026年;Jayalath和Parker Jones,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年e). 重要的比较是在规定数量的目标数据上的性能:零射线预测询问什么是不合适的转移,而校准的预测则询问事先学习如何有效地支持新的记录。 在经过广泛的个人适应后,高精度用几分钟的数据回答了与有效适应不同的问题。

blocks.en: Benchmark design is beginning to make this cost explicit. The PNPL 2025 tasks separated standard and extended data conditions; PNPL 2026 introduced deep within-person learning and a broad cross-person track with progressively reduced target-user training budgets ( Landau et al., 2025 ; Mantegna et al., 2026a ) . At the review date, the latter describes an ongoing competition, not a completed leaderboard. Its design illustrates a methodological shift from reporting a single transfer score to comparing performance across available calibration data.
blocks.zh: 基准设计已开始明确这一费用。 PNPL 2025任务分离了标准与扩展数据条件;PNPL 2026引入了深度人际学习和宽跨人际轨道,目标用户培训预算逐渐减少(Landau等人,2025年;Mantegna等人,2026a年). 在审查日,后者描述了正在进行的竞争,而不是完成的领导板. 其设计表明从报告单一转移分数到比较现有校准数据的业绩的方法转变。

blocks.en: Longitudinal operation adds changes that static data partitions only approximate. Initial calibration, updates with newly confirmed messages and recovery after a recording change affect the mapping over time ( Card et al., 2024 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . User learning adds another source of change: a controlled, repeated-day feedback study found improved binary syllable-imagery control with practice and substantial individual variation ( Bhadra et al., 2025 ) . Thus stability may be maintained by a fixed decoder, algorithmic adaptation, user adaptation or their combination. The emerging practical question is how much ongoing supervision and interruption each approach requires; Section 7 explains the corresponding support mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 纵向操作增加了静态数据分区仅近似的变化. 初始校准,更新后带新确认的信息,并在录音变更后恢复会随着时间的推移影响绘图(Card等人,2024年;Card等人,2026年). 用户学习增加了另一个变化来源:一项有控制的、重复一天的反馈研究发现,通过实践和巨大的个体差异,二进制音节-图像控制得到了改进(Bhadra等人,2025年)。 因此,稳定可以通过固定的解码器、算法适应、用户适应或其组合来维持。 新出现的实际问题是,每一办法需要多少持续监督和中断;第7节解释了相应的支助机制。

blocks.en: 6.3 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 6.3 效率

blocks.en: Efficiency concerns four related costs: producing a message, receiving feedback, learning the user’s neural mapping and maintaining the running system. Classical BCI work formalised the distinction between the rate of neural selections and the communication enabled by an interface ( Thompson et al., 2013 ; Thompson et al., 2014 ) . Selection-based information-transfer rates assume a defined alternative set and error model; they do not transfer unchanged to variable-length language generation. Speech neuroprostheses therefore commonly report words per minute alongside decoding errors, while calibration and processing measurements describe different demands on the user and equipment.
blocks.zh: 效率涉及四个相关成本:制作信息、接收反馈、学习用户神经映射和维护运行系统。 Classical BCI的工作将神经选择率与一个界面所允许的通信的区分形式化(Thompson等人,2013年;Thompson等人,2014年)。 基于选择的信息传输率假设一个定义的替代集和错误模型;它们不会不变地转移到可变长度的语言生成. 因此,语音神经假肢通常每分钟报告单词,加上解码错误,而校准和处理测量则描述了对用户和设备的不同要求.

blocks.en: Early online sentence decoding combined a 50-word vocabulary with a median rate of 15.2 words per minute and median WER of 25.6%; the same study separately reported correctly decoded throughput of 12.5 words per minute ( Moses et al., 2021 ) . Later work expanded vocabulary and pace, including a study-wide mean of 62 words per minute in attempted-speech text decoding ( Willett et al., 2023 ) and a median of 78.3 words per minute with median WER of 25.5% in a 1,024-word ECoG condition ( Metzger et al., 2023 ) . Card and colleagues paired a mean of 31.6 words per minute with aggregate WER of 2.5% over their final five copy-task sessions using a 125,000-word vocabulary ( Card et al., 2024 ) . These results show complementary gains in vocabulary, speed and fidelity across different participants and protocols. Reporting rate together with errors makes this progress interpretable: rapid output can still impose substantial correction time, whereas lower error can make a slower stream more useful.
blocks.zh: 早期的在线句子解码结合了一个50个词的词汇,中位值率为每分钟15.2个词,中位值为25.6%;同一份研究报告分别正确解码了每分钟12.5个词的吞吐量(摩西等人,2021年). 后来的工作扩展了词汇和速度,包括一个全研究范围在尝试语音文本解码中的平均值为每分钟62个字(Willett等人,2023年)和一个中值为每分钟78.3个字,在1,024个字的ECoG条件下中值为25.5%(Metzger等人,2023年). 卡和同事用12.5万字词汇将平均值为每分钟31.6个字的WER与最后5个拷贝任务会议的总WER比为2.5%(Card等人,2024年)。 这些结果表明,不同参与者和协议在词汇、速度和忠诚方面都取得了互补的成果。 报告率加上错误使得这一进展可以解释:快速产出仍然可以带来大量更正时间,而较低的错误可以使流更慢。

blocks.en: Calibration reporting has moved beyond total training-corpus size towards the time needed to begin and continue using a decoder. In the 2023 intracortical study, daily training-data collection averaged 41 minutes, while preparation including breaks and model training averaged 140 minutes ( Willett et al., 2023 ) . A later participant achieved 0.44% WER on a 50-word copy task after 30 minutes of first-day copy-task data, then 9.8% WER with a 125,000-word vocabulary after an additional 1.4 hours on day two ( Card et al., 2024 ) . The increase in error accompanied a much larger vocabulary, illustrating why calibration time must be reported with the capability it enables. The 2026 home-use follow-up combined background updating with optional daily prompted sentences ( Card et al., 2026 ) . Together with transfer benchmarks that vary target-data budgets, these studies make adaptation cost an outcome in its own right rather than an unreported preliminary step.
blocks.zh: 校准报告已经超越了总的训练单位规模,进入了开始和继续使用解码器所需的时间。 在2023年的内部研究中,每天收集的培训数据平均为41分钟,而准备时间包括休息和模式培训平均为140分钟(Willett等人,2023年)。 一名后来的参与者在首日复制任务数据30分钟后完成了0.44%的WER在50字复制任务,然后在第二日额外1.4小时后获得了9.8%的WER在12.5万字词汇(Card等人,2024年). 在错误增加的同时,词汇要大得多,说明为什么必须以能够达到的能力报告校准时间。 2026年家用后续更新将背景更新与可选的每日提示句结合起来(Card等人,2026年). 这些研究与改变目标数据预算的转移基准一起,使适应成本本身成为结果,而不是未报告的初步步骤。

blocks.en: Recent work extends information-based evaluation from accuracy within a decoder’s vocabulary to the fraction of a user’s language that vocabulary can express. Open-vocabulary mutual information (OVMI) weights information conveyed among supported words by their coverage of an explicit reference language distribution ( Jayalath et al., 2026 ) . It therefore distinguishes a highly accurate small-vocabulary interface from a broader but less accurate decoder, and makes the intended communication domain part of the evaluation. The proposal complements shared benchmarks: a common reference distribution supports a common lexical-information scale, whereas a benchmark controls the neural task and test data. OVMI estimates from scalar accuracy or WER still depend on assumptions about errors and the reference distribution; they do not make attempted-speech and listening experiments clinically equivalent. This direction broadens the discussion from correctly decoded words to the range of messages a system could support.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将基于信息的评价从解码器词汇中的准确性延伸到词汇可以表达的用户语言的一小部分. 公开-vocabulary 相互信息(OVMI)通过覆盖明确的参考语言分布,在支持词中加权传递的信息(Jayalath等人,2026年). 因此,它将高度精确的小型省道接口与范围较广但不太准确的解码器区分开来,使预期的通信域成为评价的一部分. 该提案是对共同基准的补充:一个共同的参考分布支持一个共同的词汇信息尺度,而一个基准控制神经任务和测试数据. 来自scalar精度或WER的OVMI估计仍然依赖于对误差和参考分布的假设;它们并不使试听实验在临床上等效. 这一方向将讨论范围从正确解码的单词扩大到一个系统可以支持的信息范围。

blocks.en: Streaming synthesis reduces the amount of output that must be accumulated before feedback. Littlejohn and colleagues generated audio in 80 ms increments; Wairagkar and colleagues generated 10 ms frames ( Littlejohn et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ) . The latter also measured acquisition through speech-sample synthesis at less than 10 ms using an RTX A6000, with audio-driver playback measured separately. Frame duration specifies how often output advances, while acquisition-to-synthesis time measures the processing that produces it. A GO-cue-to-audio measurement additionally includes the participant’s response timing. These distinct endpoints explain how feedback becomes more continuous without equating the output step with the total time from intention to audible speech.
blocks.zh: 流化合成减少了反馈前必须累积的产出量. Littlejohn和同事以80ms增量生成音频;Wairagkar和同事生成10ms帧(Littlejohn等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2025年)。 后者还使用RTX A6000在不到10ms的条件下通过语音-样本合成测量获取,并分别测量音频驱动器回放. 框架期限具体规定了产出推进的频率,而采购至合成时间则衡量产生该产出的处理。 GO-cue-to-Audio的测量还包括参与者的反应时间。 这些截然不同的终点解释了如何在不将产出步骤等同于从意图到声调发言的总时间的情况下,反馈变得更加连续。

blocks.en: Text systems can display a provisional sequence before completing a more expensive sentence-level pass. The long-term home system estimates incremental feedback at 160–240 ms and reports median finalisation processing of 2,657 ms for its RNN route and 1,791 ms for its Transformer route ( Card et al., 2026 ) . These medians concern the reported utterances rather than a matched-length test of decoder speed. The measurements locate two opportunities for improvement: quick feedback supports ongoing interaction, while faster finalisation shortens the wait for a revised final sentence. Neither includes every action required to repair an incorrect message, so communication utility remains broader than either component delay.
blocks.zh: 文本系统可以在完成更昂贵的句子级别通过之前显示一个临时序列. 长期家庭系统估计递增反馈为160-240 ms,报告其RNN路线的中位最终化处理为2 657 ms,变形器路线为1 791 ms(Card等人,2026年)。 这些中位数涉及所报告的语句,而不是对解码速度的匹配长度测试。 测量确定两个改进机会:快速反馈支持正在进行的互动,而更快的定稿缩短了对修订最后一句的等待。 也没有包括修复不正确信息所需的一切行动,因此,通信效用仍然比任一组件延迟都要广泛。

blocks.en: Some recent papers report hardware-specific component times. An offline causal voice model evaluated on earlier T15 recordings reports mean neural-model inference times of 1.47 ms and 2.11 ms for continuous and tokenised output heads on an RTX 5090, with an additional reported 1.2 ms for vocoding ( Wairagkar et al., 2026 ) . These source measurements describe computational feasibility, not a new online clinical trial. Comparable end-to-end energy, memory and maintenance measurements are still too sparse among the selected reports for a common cost ranking. The emerging pattern is more specific: as text accuracy and raw output rate improve, feedback, finalisation, correction and calibration become increasingly consequential parts of the remaining communication time. For other tasks, especially transfer to new users, collecting enough target data remains a major cost.
blocks.zh: 最近的一些论文报告了硬件特定组件的时间。 在先前的T15录音报告上评价的离线因果语音模型,是指在RTX 5090上连续和象征性输出头的神经模型推导时间为1.47 ms和2.11 ms,另外还报告有1.2 ms用于vocoding(Wairagkar等人,2026年)。 这些来源测量描述的是计算可行性,而不是新的在线临床试验. 可供比较的端到端能源、内存和维护计量在选定的报告中仍然太少,无法进行共同费用排名。 新出现的模式更为具体:随着文本准确度和原始产出率的提高,反馈、定稿、校正和校准成为剩余通信时间中越来越难得的部分。 对于其他任务,特别是向新用户转移,收集足够的目标数据仍然是一项重大费用。

blocks.en: 6.4 Credibility
blocks.zh: 6.4 可信度

blocks.en: Credibility concerns the inference supported by an experiment. Prediction conditions determine what information the model could use; controls distinguish possible sources of its performance; statistical analysis describes variation and uncertainty. Reproducible protocols and independent replication connect these questions across studies.
blocks.zh: 可信度涉及一项试验所支持的推论。 预测条件决定模型可以使用何种信息;控制区分其可能的业绩来源;统计分析描述差异和不确定性. 可复制的协议和独立复制将这些问题贯穿各研究。

blocks.en: 6.4.1 Information available during testing
blocks.zh: 6.4.1 测试期间可获得的信息

blocks.en: Offline, pseudo-online and live closed-loop evaluation expose a system to different information and interaction conditions ( Ko et al., 2025 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . Published protocols differ in their use of correct prefixes, reference-dependent alignment, known candidates, stimulus boundaries, future samples and repeated observations. These inputs change what the prediction measures. Test-time teacher forcing is one case of privileged information, particularly relevant to autoregressive text; it is not a universal evaluation criterion for classifiers or synthesis systems ( Jo et al., 2026 ) . Known boundaries or reference-dependent alignment can simplify decoding even without teacher forcing ( Table 25 ).
blocks.zh: 离线、伪在线和现场闭路评价使一个系统暴露于不同的信息和互动条件(Ko等人,2025年;Card等人,2026年)。 已公布的协议在使用正确的前缀,依赖参考的对齐,已知的候选者,刺激边界,未来样本和重复观测方面有所不同. 这些投入改变了预测措施。 测试时间教师强迫是特权信息的一个案例,特别与自动递归文本有关;它不是分类或合成系统的通用评价标准(Jo等人,2026年). 已知的边界或依赖参考的对齐即使没有老师的强迫,也能简化解码(表25 ).

blocks.en: Figure 20: The source of the preceding tokens changes what a text-generation test measures. Both conditions receive neural context. (a) Reference-prefix testing supplies correct preceding tokens even after a prediction error. (b) Autonomous generation uses its own generated history. In the illustrative example, the first prediction, “We”, enters the next prefix only in (b); subsequent outputs may consequently differ. Teacher forcing may be used during training in either case. The distinction is explicit in the ZuCo noise comparison and the split audit’s with/without-teacher-forcing results ( Jo et al., 2026 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . It concerns autoregressive generation, not every classifier or speech synthesiser.
blocks.zh: 图20:上述标志的来源改变了文本生成测试措施。 这两个条件都得到神经上下文. (a) 参考前缀测试用品,即使在预测错误后也纠正了先前的标志。 (b) 自主发电使用自己创造的历史。 在说明性例子中,第一个预测“我们”仅在(b)中输入下一个前缀;因此,随后的产出可能有所不同。 在这两种情况下,均可在培训期间使用强迫教师的做法。 在ZuCo噪声比较和分立审计与/无教师强制结果之间有明显的区别(Jo等人,2026年;Yin等人,2025年)。 它涉及自递性生成,而不是每个分类器或语音合成器.

blocks.en: 6.4.2 Neural contribution and controls
blocks.zh: 6.4.2 神经促进和控制

blocks.en: The first control concerns what the participant actually did. Mouthing retains articulatory activity, and preparation windows remain contiguous with forthcoming speech ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Anumanchipalli et al., 2019 ; Dash et al., 2020 ; Dash et al., 2024 ) . Reading versus Inner task contrasts and comparisons involving loss of residual articulation show why removing sound does not hold the behavioural source constant ( Csaky et al., 2025 ; Jude et al., 2026 ) . In an around-ear EEG–EMG system, peripheral activity can be a useful communication input while limiting a neural-only interpretation ( Inoue et al., 2026 ) . The appropriate question is not whether all movement should be excluded from a useful device, but whether the reported contribution matches the claimed source. Channel-specific comparisons separate the benefit of fused inputs, while peripheral recordings address residual movement in internally produced speech.
blocks.zh: 第一项控制涉及参与者的实际行为。 口腔保留动脉活性,制备窗口与即将发表的演讲保持毗连(Willett等人,2023年;Anumanchipalli等人,2019年;Dash等人,2020年;Dash等人,2024年). 阅读与 内部任务对比和涉及剩余表达损失的比较表明,为什么去除声音不能保持行为源常数(Csaky等人,2025年;Jude等人,2026年)。 在环耳的EEG-EMG系统中,外围活动可以是一种有用的通信输入,同时限制一种只用神经元解释(Inoue等人,2026年)。 适当的问题不是是否应将所有移动排除在有用装置之外,而是所报告的捐助是否与声称的来源相符。 针对频道的比较将引信输入的好处区分开来,而外围录音则处理内部制作的语音中剩余移动。

blocks.en: A prior can improve communication while the neural input remains necessary. Attempted-speech systems report phoneme error separately from the WER obtained after language-model decoding ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ) . In fMRI semantic reconstruction, replacing brain-based likelihoods with random scores caused decoding to fall to chance, whereas resetting linguistic context produced a transient loss followed by recovery ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . That ablation demonstrates ongoing neural constraint in a system that also uses a strong language prior. Prompt-conditioned generation adds cue information that needs its own comparison ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) . Conversely, the ZuCo audit compared BART, Pegasus and T5 using real and noise inputs, with and without test-time teacher forcing ( Jo et al., 2026 ) . Comparable EEG/noise results limit the neural-decoding interpretation of those Perceived–Visual pipelines; they do not establish a universal impossibility result for Inner, Auditory or later untested generators. The useful question is which information the tested decoder actually requires.
blocks.zh: 在神经输入仍有必要时,先行者可以改善沟通。 尝试的语音系统从语言模型解码后获得的WER中单独报告电话错误(Willett等人,2023年;Metzger等人,2023年)。 在fMRI语义重建中,将基于脑的概率替换为随机分数导致解码落空,而重置语言背景则产生瞬间损失,然后是恢复(Tang等人,2023年). 这种膨胀现象表明,在一个同样使用强力语言的系统中,神经功能一直受到制约。 快速有条件的生成增加了需要自己比较的提示信息(Zhang等人,2024b ). 反之,ZuCo审计将BART、Pegasus和T5使用真实的和噪音的输入进行对比,无论有没有测试时间教师强迫(Jo等人,2026年)。 可比较的EEG/噪声结果限制了这些透视管道的神经解码解释;它们没有为内部、审计或后来未经测试的发电机确定普遍不可能的结果。 有用的问题是测试解码器实际需要哪些信息.

blocks.en: A control is informative only when its preserved and removed information match the alternative explanation. Prior-only or cue-only decoding asks how much can be predicted without a neural measurement. Shuffling the association between recordings and targets tests trial-specific information only if nuisance structure and the permitted timing information are preserved. Replacing inputs with noise tests dependence on the measured values, but an arbitrary replacement can also create an unfamiliar input distribution; failure on that control alone is weak evidence of neural specificity. Conversely, success with signal-blind input exposes an available shortcut, as in the MEG retrieval audit ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Peripheral-channel comparisons then ask a different question: which measured source supplies the usable information. No single control resolves all of these explanations, and artifact cleaning cannot replace this analysis.
blocks.zh: 只有在保存和删除的信息与替代解释相符时,控制才具有信息性。 先前的或cue的解码则询问,没有神经测量,可以预测多少. 只有在骚扰结构和允许的时间安排信息得到保留的情况下,才能将录音与目标之间的关联消除,测试具体审判信息。 用依赖测量值的噪声测试来取代输入,但任意替换也可以产生不熟悉的输入分布;单靠这种控制的失败是神经特异性的薄弱证据. 反之,信号盲输入的成功暴露了一条可用的捷径,如MEG检索审计(Zhang等人,2026c). 。 。 。 周边-通道比较然后提出另一个问题:哪一个测量源提供可用信息. 没有任何单一的控制可以解决所有这些解释,而文物清洁不能取代这种分析.

blocks.en: 6.4.3 Statistical support and replication
blocks.zh: 6.4.3 统计支助和推广

blocks.en: Theoretical chance is a null expectation, not a finite-sample threshold for reliable decoding ( Combrisson and Jerbi, 2015 ) . Permutation tests and uncertainty estimates address sampling variation, with the inferential unit determined by repeated items, sessions and participants. At the group level, the fraction of individually significant participants differs from an estimate of population prevalence; the latter requires its own inferential framework ( Allefeld et al., 2016 ) . This distinction matters when many trials are available from only a few people.
blocks.zh: 理论机会是一个无效的期望,而不是可靠解码的有限样本门槛(Combrisson and Jerbi, 2015). 持久性测试和不确定性估计涉及取样变化,由重复的项目、会议和与会者确定推断单位。 在群体一级,个别重要参与者的比例不同于对人口流行率的估计;后者需要自己的推断框架(Allefeld等人,2016年)。 如果只有少数人可以进行许多审判,这种区别就很重要。

blocks.en: Peak performance can conceal a large difference in who benefits. Eight-class cued Inner decoding reached 79% and 23% in two participants ( Wandelt et al., 2024 ) ; pairwise inner-word ECoG decoding averaged 58% across five participants despite a best result of 88% ( Martin et al., 2016 ) . These distributions are more informative about reproducibility than either peak alone. Repeated clinical reports also require participant links, because additional follow-up does not add independent recruitment ( Table 10 ).
blocks.zh: 峰性能可以掩盖谁受益的巨大差异. 8级提示内编码达到79%和23%的2名参与者(Wandelt等人,2024年);对称内字ECoG解码在5名参与者中平均为58%,尽管最佳结果为88%(Martin等人,2016年)。 这些分布比两个峰值都更能说明可复制性。 重复的临床报告还需要参与者的链接,因为额外的后续不添加独立的招聘(表10).

blocks.en: A replication audit ( Tates et al., 2026 ) re-implemented published inner-speech pipelines on multiple public and in-house EEG datasets and found a mean fraction of 36.1% statistically significant participants across the tested speech-imagery datasets, below the corresponding motor-imagery fraction, with replicated accuracies below the original reports. This is an average of dataset-level fractions, rather than a pooled participant proportion. This does not bound every Inner method. It does show why the distribution of reliable decoding across the tested participants is a different outcome from the best observed accuracy. Paired cross-mode and paradigm-design datasets can help distinguish failure to transfer a model from changes in task execution or engagement ( He et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Aguilera-Rodríguez et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 一项复制审计(Tates et al., 2026)在多个公共和内部的EEG数据集上重新执行已公布的内语管,发现在测试的语音图像数据集中,平均有36.1%的统计意义参与者,低于相应的电动图像分数,复制率低于原始报告. 这是数据集层次分数的平均值,而不是集合参与者比例. 这并不能约束每一种内在方法。 它确实表明,为什么在受测试的参与者中分发可靠的解码是不同于观察到的准确性的结果。 Paired跨模式和范式设计数据集可以帮助区分未能传输一个模型与任务执行或参与的变化(He等人,2025年b;Ma等人,2026年b;Aguilera-Rodríguez等人,2025年).

blocks.en: These studies expose two levels of reproducibility. Reusing ZuCo or a clinical benchmark tests whether an algorithmic result can be obtained on the same recordings; recruiting additional participants tests whether it extends to another population sample. Repeated reports from T15 or BRAVO3 add longitudinal or functional evidence without adding independent recruitment ( Table 10 ). Participant-level analysis and correction for multiple comparisons also affect conclusions in auditory EEG benchmarking ( Li and Tao, 2026 ) . The field therefore has established tools for assessing individual decoding and increasingly explicit protocols for algorithm comparison, while population-level reliability remains less well characterised.
blocks.zh: 这些研究揭示了可复制性的两级. 重复使用ZuCo或临床基准测试是否在同一录音中可以获得算法结果;招募更多参与者测试它是否延伸至另一个种群样本. T15或BRAVO3的重复报告增加了纵向或功能性证据,而没有增加独立的征聘(表10)。 参与者一级的分析和多次比较的校正也影响到听觉EEG基准中的结论(Li和Tao,2026年)。 因此,这个领域已经建立了评估个别解码的工具,并且为算法比较制定了越来越明确的协议,而人口层面的可靠性仍然不够明确。

blocks.en: Output metrics, shared benchmarks, source controls and longitudinal tests answer complementary questions. Their combined development makes some method comparisons increasingly reproducible while exposing remaining differences in task and use conditions. Table 26 collects the details needed to interpret a result. The next section follows the corresponding system mechanisms: initiation, feedback, correction, adaptation and continued access.
blocks.zh: 产出衡量标准、共同基准、源控和纵向测试回答了补充问题。 它们的综合发展使得一些方法比较越来越容易复制,同时暴露出任务和使用条件方面仍然存在的差异。 表26收集解释结果所需的细节。 下一节遵循相应的系统机制:启动,反馈,校正,调整和持续访问.

blocks.en: 7 Practical Use
blocks.zh: 7 实际用途

blocks.en: A practical language interface lets a person initiate, express and complete a communication goal. Decoding contributes the content; feedback, correction and adaptation help turn that content into an exchange. User-centred BCI studies consequently assess effectiveness, workload and satisfaction together, while prospective-user research establishes communication priorities before engineering choices are fixed ( Kübler et al., 2014 ; Huggins et al., 2011 ; Branco et al., 2021 ) . These priorities connect three parts of the interface: Interaction governs expression and user control, Support supplies context and decoder updates, and Deployment sustains recording access and assistance. Figure 21 shows how they contribute to the same communication loop.
blocks.zh: 一个实用的语言界面让一个人发起,表达和完成一个通信目标. 解码有助于内容;反馈、更正和调整有助于将内容转化为交流。 因此,以用户为中心的BCI研究将成效、工作量和满意度放在一起评估,而预期用户研究则确定在工程选择确定之前的通信优先事项(Kübler等人,2014年;Huggins等人,2011年;Branco等人,2021年)。 这些优先事项连接了界面的三个部分:互动管理表达和用户控制,支持用品背景和解码器更新,部署维持记录访问和援助。 图21显示了它们如何为同一通信循环作出贡献。

blocks.en: Figure 21: Communication combines message production, feedback, release and repair under user control. (a) The solid forward path illustrates confirmation before release; the dashed branch illustrates provisional streaming to the recipient during decoding. Feedback and revision provide return paths, while initiation errors, content errors, delay and repair effort locate different sources of communication cost. (b) Interaction design, calibration and assistance, and sustained recording access support the loop. The people and messages are illustrative. Interfaces may combine these functions differently, including their release policy and available stopping or fallback controls.
blocks.zh: 图21 通信结合了用户控制下的信息制作,反馈,发布和修复. (a) 固态前进路径显示在释放前的确认;破碎分支显示在解码期间暂时向接收者流出。 反馈和修订提供了返回路径,而启动错误、内容错误、延误和维修工作则找到不同的通信费用来源。 (b) 互动设计、校准和援助以及持续记录准入支持循环。 人民和信息是说明性的。 接口可能以不同方式结合这些功能,包括其释放政策和可用的停止或倒置控制。

blocks.en: 7.1 Interaction
blocks.zh: 7.1 相互作用

blocks.en: Interaction determines when decoded content becomes a message and how the user responds to an error. The distinction between executory control over releasing speech and guidance control over its expression helps separate initiation or cancellation from linguistic correction ( van Stuijvenberg et al., 2024a ) . Different interfaces distribute these decisions between automatic detection, explicit user actions and continuous feedback. A confirmation step can prevent an unwanted utterance, but it also consumes time and can interrupt a conversational turn.
blocks.zh: 交互决定了解码内容何时成为消息,以及用户如何回应错误. 对释放言论的可执行控制和对言论的可引导控制之间的区别有助于将语言矫正与启动或取消分开(van Stuijvenberg等人,2024a)。 。 。 。 不同的界面在自动检测,明确的用户动作和连续反馈之间分配这些决定. 一个确认步骤可以防止不想要的言语,但也会消耗时间,并且可以打断对话的转折.

blocks.en: 7.1.1 Speech onset, stopping and unintended activation
blocks.zh: 7.1.1 国家 发声、停止和意外激活

blocks.en: Speech-state classification, onset detection and idle-state modelling allow a decoder to operate between utterances as well as during them ( de Borman et al., 2025 ; Ko et al., 2025 ; Padfield et al., 2025 ) . In Card’s clinical text system, conversation mode detects speech automatically and finalises an utterance after six seconds without detected speech or an eye-tracker button action ( Card et al., 2024 ) . Automatic segmentation reduces the need to issue a separate command for every turn; the button provides a direct way to finish early. A later Inner-speech system demonstrates real-time keyword gating in one participant, adding a deliberate internally produced action before message output ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 语音状态分类、发端探测和闲置状态建模使解码器能够在语音之间以及在语音期间运行(de Borman等人,2025年;Ko等人,2025年;Padfield等人,2025年)。 在卡德的临床文本系统中,对话模式会自动检测语音,并在6秒后完成一个没有检测到的语音或眼跟踪按钮动作的语句(卡德等人,2024年). 自动分割减少了每个回合发布单独命令的需要;按钮提供了提前完成的直接方式. 稍后的内语系统在一名参与者中展示了实时关键词的标注,在信息输出之前增加了一个内部精心制作的行动(Kunz等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: These mechanisms address different use conditions. Automatic detection supports natural turn-taking, whereas a deliberate gate can help separate communication from other verbal activity. Long-term home use also exposes states uncommon in cued testing: occasional false detections produced nonsensical output when the participant was nominally asleep ( Card et al., 2026 ) . The available activation action, sensitivity to idle behaviour and means of stopping output therefore jointly shape dependable access, especially when fatigue or another control channel changes.
blocks.zh: 这些机制处理不同的使用条件。 自动检测支持自然转动,而故意的闸门可以帮助将通信与其他口头活动分开. 长期家庭使用也暴露了暗示测试中不常见的状态:偶尔在参与者名义上正在睡觉时出现虚假检测结果(Card等人,2026年)。 因此,可用的激活动作、对闲置行为的敏感性以及停止输出的手段共同塑造可靠的访问,特别是在疲劳或另一个控制通道发生变化时。

blocks.en: 7.1.2 Feedback, confirmation and error correction
blocks.zh: 7.1.2 反馈、确认和错误更正

blocks.en: Feedback has developed from audible formant control to multimodal and streaming speech interfaces ( Guenther et al., 2009 ; Brumberg et al., 2018 ; Littlejohn et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ) . Streaming synthesis lets the user hear output while an utterance is being produced. Sentence-level text interfaces instead provide a point at which a complete message can be reviewed before further use. These policies distribute delay and repair differently: early audio supports ongoing adjustment, while an already spoken error may require a clarification to the recipient.
blocks.zh: 反馈已经从可听的成型控制到多式联运和流式语音界面(Guenther等人,2009年;Brumber等人,2018年;Littlejohn等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2025年)。 流化合成让用户听到输出时正在产生一个语音. 句子级别的文本界面则提供了一个点,在进一步使用之前可以审查完整的消息. 这些政策以不同方式分配延迟和修复:早期音频支持正在进行的调整,而已经讲到的错误可能需要向接收者澄清.

blocks.en: Auxiliary controls can make repair part of routine use. Eye-tracker confirmation in Card’s 2024 system identifies correctly decoded sentences for online fine-tuning; the later home system supports correction through gaze or a neural cursor ( Card et al., 2024 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . A correction channel thus serves two roles, improving the current message and supplying information for later adaptation. Feedback can also change the user’s control strategy: in a five-day binary syllable-imagery study, continuous feedback supported learning, with substantial individual differences and a discontinuous-feedback comparison ( Bhadra et al., 2025 ) . This constrained task provides evidence for user learning alongside decoder learning, without equating that gain with conversational proficiency.
blocks.zh: 辅助控制可以使修复成为日常使用的一部分. 卡德2024系统中的眼追踪器确认正确解码的句子用于在线微调;后世的家庭系统通过凝视或神经光标支持校正(卡德等人,2024年;卡德等人,2026年). 因此,纠正渠道发挥两种作用,即改进当前的信息和为以后的调整提供信息。 反馈也可以改变用户的控制策略:在为期五天的二元音节-图像研究中,持续的反馈支持学习,其中存在实质性的个体差异和不连续的反馈比较(Bhadra等人,2025年)。 这一受限的任务为用户学习与解码器学习同时进行提供了证据,而不将获得的与对话熟练程度等同起来。

blocks.en: 7.1.3 Communication benefit and user experience
blocks.zh: 7.1.3 通信效益和用户经验

blocks.en: Useful communication includes choice of language, voice and expression. Bilingual decoding extends language choice, while personalised speech, facial animation and expressive voice restore additional aspects of identity and delivery ( Silva et al., 2024b ; Metzger et al., 2023 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ) . Loudness or mode control and parallel gestures add further dimensions ( Srinivasan et al., 2026 ; Brosler et al., 2026 ) . Their benefit depends on the person’s goals and the effort required to control them; attention, fatigue and engagement consequently matter alongside output quality ( Aguilera-Rodríguez et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 有用的沟通包括选择语言,语音和表达. 双语解码扩展了语言选择,而个性化的语音,面部动画和表达语音则恢复了身份和交付的其他方面(Silva等人,2024b;Metzger等人,2023;Wairagkar等人,2025年). 声调或模式控制和平行姿态会增加更多的尺寸(Srinivasan等人,2026年;Brosler等人,2026年)。 他们的利益取决于个人的目标和控制目标所需的努力;因此,注意力、疲劳和参与与产出质量同时重要(Aguilela-Rodríguez等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Long-term conversational reports capture both decoding and the user’s contribution to a successful message. In the home-use system, sentence ratings include immediately correct, user-corrected and mostly correct output, whereas cued-copy testing provides a known reference transcript ( Card et al., 2026 ) . The former describes achieved communication with the interface; the latter more directly isolates word recovery. Effectiveness, workload and satisfaction complement these outcomes ( Kübler et al., 2014 ) . The Communicative Participation Item Bank supplies a patient-reported construct for speaking situations, whose applicability to a particular neural communication aid still requires appropriate validation ( Baylor et al., 2013 ) . Together, these measures connect the quality and timing endpoints in Section 6 to the experience of completing an exchange.
blocks.zh: 长期对话报告既记录了解码,也记录了用户对成功信息的贡献。 在家用系统中,句子评分包括立即正确,用户校正且大多正确的输出,而提示拷贝测试则提供了已知的参考记录(Card等人,2026年). 前者描述了与界面实现的通信;后者更直接地隔离词恢复. 成效、工作量和满意度补充了这些成果(Kübler等人,2014年)。 交流参与项目银行提供一种患者报告用于演讲的构件,该构件适用于特定神经通信援助仍需适当验证(Baylor等人,2013年)。 这些措施共同将第6节的质量和时间终点与完成交流的经验联系起来。

blocks.en: Table 12: Demonstrated features and operating conditions of selected communication interfaces. The rows describe different tasks and stages of use, rather than a common performance test. The two Card reports follow the same participant.
blocks.zh: 表12:选定通信接口的演示特征和操作条件. 各行描述不同的任务和使用阶段,而不是一个常见的性能测试. 两份卡片报告都跟随同一参与者.

blocks.en: 7.2 Support
blocks.zh: 7.2 支助

blocks.en: Support mechanisms work at different points in learning and use. Context helps interpret the current neural evidence; personal calibration fits a new recording; continued adaptation maintains the mapping as signals and user behaviour change. Their practical effects differ accordingly, from fewer corrections within a sentence to fewer interruptions between sessions.
blocks.zh: 支助机制在学习和使用方面在不同阶段发挥作用。 上下文有助于解释当前的神经证据;个人校准符合新的记录;持续改编维持绘图作为信号和用户行为变化. 因此,它们的实际影响不同,从句子内的更正较少,到闭会期间的中断次数较少。

blocks.en: 7.2.1 Inference-time assistance
blocks.zh: 7.2.1 推断时间援助

blocks.en: Language models help convert uncertain phoneme evidence into words, while a preceding question narrows the likely answer ( Willett et al., 2023 ; Moses et al., 2019 ) . Semantic beam search uses contextual representations to guide sentence generation, and the home-use text system rescores candidate sequences at finalisation ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . These mechanisms place linguistic constraints around the neural prediction. They extend an established principle in BCI spelling, where probabilistic language context improves the conversion of noisy selections into text ( Speier et al., 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型帮助将不确定的电话证据转换为单词,而前面的问题缩小了可能的答案(Willett等人,2023年;Moses等人,2019年). 语义束搜索使用上下文表示来指导句子生成,家用文本系统在最终化时对候选序列进行复数(Tang等人,2023年;Card等人,2026年). 这些机制将语言约束置于神经预测周围. 他们扩展了BCI拼写中的既定原则,其中概率语言背景改进了将吵闹的选择转换为文本(Speier等人,2015年).

blocks.en: The resulting fluency is useful when contextual expectations agree with the intended message. Names, negation and unusual expressions create a different demand: the interface needs to retain a low-probability choice that matters to the user. Direct editing and confirmation offer ways to resolve that conflict. The relevant practical gain is the reduction in total correction effort while preserving intended distinctions; the matched model and control comparisons in Section 6 address how much of the improvement comes from neural evidence and inference support.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的流利性在背景预期与预期信息一致时是有用的。 名称,否定和不寻常的表达产生不同的需求:界面需要保留一个对用户很重要的低概率选择. 直接编辑和确认为解决这一冲突提供了途径。 相关的实际好处是减少了总的校正努力,同时保留了预期的区别;第6节中匹配的模式和控制比较涉及在多大程度上改进来自神经证据和推论支持。

blocks.en: 7.2.2 Long-term stability and recalibration
blocks.zh: 7.2.2 长期稳定和重新调整

blocks.en: Initial fitting and continued adaptation have already changed the cost of using clinical speech interfaces. Card’s 2024 report began with 30 minutes of calibration for a 50-word task, added 1.4 hours on the second day before large-vocabulary testing, and improved further with accumulated data ( Card et al., 2024 ) . These stages explain how an interface can become useful early while continuing to learn. Later home operation employed background recalibration to maintain performance during extended use ( Card et al., 2026 ) . The cued Inner study followed another route, combining attempted-speech pretraining with Inner data and participant-specific online updates ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 初步适应和持续适应已经改变了使用临床语音接口的成本。 卡德的2024年报告开始为50字任务进行30分钟的校准,在大省测试的第二天增加了1.4小时,并随着累积数据(卡德等人,2024年)的进一步改善. 这些阶段解释了一个接口如何在继续学习的同时及早发挥作用。 后来的家用作业采用了背景再校准,以维持延长使用期间的性能(Card等人,2026年)。 提示性内部研究遵循了另一条路线,将尝试语前训练与内部数据和针对参与者的在线更新相结合(Kunz等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: The source of update labels distinguishes these mechanisms. Prompted sentences supply known targets; T16’s large-vocabulary Inner protocol incorporates each cued sentence after decoding it. User-confirmed conversational output can supply accepted targets during communication ( Kunz et al., 2025 ; Card et al., 2024 ) . The former offers direct supervision, while the latter can reduce separate calibration but depends on reliable confirmation. Recalibration consequently has costs in time, labels and assistance even when it preserves accuracy ( Swanson et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 更新标签的来源区分了这些机制. 提示句提供已知目标; T16 的大省内协议在解码后包含每个提示句. 用户确认的对话输出可以在通信过程中提供被接受的目标(Kunz等人,2025年;Card等人,2024年). 前者提供直接监督,而后者可以减少单独的校准,但取决于可靠的确认. 因此,即使调整保持准确性,也会在时间、标签和援助方面产生成本(Swanson等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Related control BCIs illustrate two further approaches. Aligning low-dimensional neural activity recovered cursor control after recording changes in nonhuman primates; sustained user–decoder adaptation enabled stable human ECoG control ( Degenhart et al., 2020 ; Silversmith et al., 2021 ) . These are algorithmic stabilisation and coadaptation precedents, respectively. Their relevance to language is the prospect of maintaining a useful representation with fewer interruptions, while preserving the linguistic distinctions and temporal structure that communication requires.
blocks.zh: 相关的控制BCIs说明了另外两种方法。 在记录非人类灵长类动物的变化后,调整低维神经活动恢复光标控制;持续的用户-解码器适应使人类ECoG控制稳定(Degenhart等人,2020年;Silversmith等人,2021年)。 这些分别是算法稳定化和协和化的先例. 它们与语言的关联性是,在保持沟通所需的语言区别和时间结构的同时,保持有用的表述,减少中断。

blocks.en: 7.3 Deployment
blocks.zh: 7.3 部署

blocks.en: Deployment joins the decoder to the equipment and people that keep it available. Recording access, preparation, maintenance and recovery determine when a successful laboratory capability becomes a dependable communication option.
blocks.zh: 部署将解码器与能提供设备的设备和人员结合起来。 记录进入、准备、维护和恢复决定实验室能力何时成为可靠的通信选择。

blocks.en: 7.3.1 Setup, portability and maintenance
blocks.zh: 7.3.1 国家 设置、可移植性和维修

blocks.en: The prolonged home-use report makes this operating arrangement concrete. One participant used a wired, multi-computer system for more than 3,800 hours, including idle time, with about 20 minutes of daily caregiver setup ( Card et al., 2026 ) . Once set up, speech, cursor control and correction supported self-directed use without a researcher present. Assistance at the start of a day and independent message production during the day therefore describe complementary parts of the same achievement.
blocks.zh: 长期的家庭使用报告使这一运作安排变得具体。 一位与会者使用有线多计算机系统超过3,800小时,包括闲暇时间,每天约有20分钟的护理员设置(Card等人,2026年)。 设置后,语音,光标控制和校正支持在没有研究人员在场的情况下自行定向使用. 因此,一天开始时的援助和白天的独立信息制作都描述了同一成就的补充部分。

blocks.en: Longitudinal selection/control studies add experience with service availability. A multisite EEG communication study tracked home use, unavailable days, attrition and user–caregiver benefit and burden ( Wolpaw et al., 2018 ) ; an implanted communication interface was followed for seven years in one person with ALS ( Vansteensel et al., 2024 ) . These systems differ from direct language-content decoding, but they show how access evolves with health, support and recording conditions. Caregiver contributions include preparation, maintenance and troubleshooting ( Wohns et al., 2024 ) . Smaller sensors and automatic calibration can reduce particular tasks within this arrangement; their contribution to autonomy depends on which remaining tasks the user or caregiver still performs.
blocks.zh: 纵向选择/控制研究增加了提供服务的经验。 一项多地点的EEG通信研究跟踪了家用、没有可用的天数、自然减员和用户-护理者的福利和负担(Wolpaw等人,2018年);一个与ALS(Vansteensel等人,2024年)一起被植入的通信接口跟踪了7年。 这些系统与直接语言内容解码不同,但它们显示了获取方式如何随着健康,支持和记录条件而演变. 照料者的贡献包括准备、维护和排除故障(Wohns等人,2024年)。 较小的传感器和自动校准可以减少这种安排内的特定任务;它们对自主性的贡献取决于用户或照料者仍然执行哪些剩余任务。

blocks.en: 7.3.2 Privacy and user control
blocks.zh: 7.3.2 隐私和用户控制

blocks.en: Privacy controls operate at several stages of an interface. Cooperation affected successful semantic reconstruction in the fMRI study; keyword gating in the Inner study supplied a deliberate activation action; a privacy mode in the home-use system disabled data logging ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Kunz et al., 2025 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . Activation, message release and data retention are therefore separate design decisions with different technical mechanisms. Disabling storage, for example, changes the retained record rather than the decoder’s output policy.
blocks.zh: 隐私控制在一个接口的几个阶段运作。 合作影响了fMRI研究中成功的语义重建;内部研究中的关键词ging提供了有意激活动作;家庭使用系统中的隐私模式禁用数据记录(Tang等人,2023年;Kunz等人,2025年;Card等人,2026年)。 因此,激活、信息发布和数据保留是具有不同技术机制的单独设计决定。 例如,失效存储会改变保留的记录,而不是解码器的产出政策。

blocks.en: Access to the input also matters. Stimulus-based EEG probing demonstrated information leakage under a defined adversary and observation protocol ( Martinovic et al., 2012 ) , while developer interviews identify responsibilities around autonomy and maintenance ( van Stuijvenberg et al., 2024b ) . These findings connect control of recordings to control of inferred content and released messages. A usable language interface combines such controls with feedback and repair, so that the user can express a message and manage its consequences throughout an exchange.
blocks.zh: 获得投入也很重要。 基于刺激的EEG探测显示,根据确定的对敌方和观察协议,信息泄漏(Martinovic等人,2012年),而开发商访谈则确定自主和维护的责任(van Stuijvenberg等人,2024b)。 这些调查结果将录音控制与所推断内容和所发布消息的控制联系起来。 一个可用的语言界面将这种控制与反馈和修复结合起来,这样用户就可以在整个交换过程中表达信息并管理其后果.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Brain-to-language decoding has progressed through complementary advances: richer representations, more reusable training data, efficient personal fitting and interfaces that operate during conversation. The remaining limitations arise where these advances meet. A representation learned from externally supplied language may change during self-generated expression; a shared model still encounters new recording geometry; a fast decoder can leave substantial correction or setup work. Four connected questions organise these challenges ( Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 大脑对语言的解码通过互补的进步而取得进展:更丰富的表述,更可重复使用的培训数据,高效的个人装配和在对话中运行的接口. 其余的限制因素出现在这些预付款到位时。 从外部提供的语言中学习到的表示在自我生成的表达中可能会改变;共享的模型仍然遇到新的录制几何;快速解码器可以留下大量的校正或设置工作. 四个相关问题组织这些挑战(表13)。

blocks.en: Table 13: Remaining limitations and the approaches that provide a basis for addressing them. Each direction concerns a capability needed across learning, decoding and use.
blocks.zh: 表13:剩余的限制和为解决这些问题提供依据的办法。 每个方向都涉及学习、解码和使用所需的能力。

blocks.en: 8.1 Task coverage and self-generated expression
blocks.zh: 第8.1条 任务覆盖和自生成表达式

blocks.en: Perceived-language tasks offer reusable recordings and precise targets, while clinical attempted-speech systems demonstrate voluntary communication under a different acquisition and supervision setting ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . Inner research connects these settings through constrained classification, feedback-driven learning and overt-bridged synthesis ( Bhadra et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2023 ) . Intracortical work further combines attempted-speech pretraining with instructed Inner decoding ( Kunz et al., 2025 ) . The open question is which parts of these learned representations remain useful when a person chooses new content without an external stimulus or audible reference.
blocks.zh: 认知语言任务提供可重复使用的录音和精确的目标,而临床尝试语音系统则显示在不同的获取和监督环境下的自愿交流(Tang等人,2023年;Card等人,2026年)。 内部研究通过受限制的分类、反馈驱动的学习和公开的桥梁合成来连接这些环境(Bhadra等人,2025年;Lee等人,2023年)。 内部工作进一步将尝试语前训练与指示语内解码结合起来(Kunz等人,2025年)。 尚未解决的问题是,当一个人在没有外部刺激或可听闻的参考的情况下选择新的内容时,这些学到的陈述的哪些部分仍然有用。

blocks.en: The neural state matters as much as the word label. Motor attempt, internal articulation and auditory imagery can share content-related structure while differing in intention and execution. Results from users without residual articulation, together with paired-task and peripheral-monitoring studies, make these differences accessible to investigation ( Jude et al., 2026 ; Nieto et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Inoue et al., 2026 ) . Their value is to identify transferable linguistic structure while separating it from cue processing and correlated movement. Linking controlled tasks to user-chosen messages also changes the reference: a known prompt provides exact labels, whereas confirmation and independent accounts of intended meaning become central to judging self-generated expression. Better learning from these complementary forms of supervision is a route towards less constrained communication.
blocks.zh: 神经状态和标签一样重要 汽车尝试、内部表达和听觉图像可以分享与内容有关的结构,同时在意图和执行上有所不同。 用户没有剩余表述的结果,加上配对任务和外围监测研究,使得这些差异可供调查(Jude等人,2026年;Nieto等人,2022年;Ma等人,2026年b;Inoue等人,2026年)。 其价值是确定可转移语言结构,同时将其与线索处理和关联移动区分开来。 将受控任务与用户选择的信息链接也会改变引用:已知的提示提供了准确的标签,而关于意向的确认和独立描述则成为判断自生成表达式的核心. 更好地学习这些互补形式的监督是减少沟通限制的途径。

blocks.en: 8.2 Signal access and supervision
blocks.zh: 8.2 信号进入和监督

blocks.en: Large pooled perception corpora and long within-person recordings have made representation learning possible at a scale that is difficult to reproduce for clinical attempted or Inner speech ( Défossez et al., 2023 ; d’Ascoli et al., 2025 ; Özdogan et al., 2025 ) . General EEG and intracranial pretraining provide reusable encoders, while speech-specific latent alignment and multi-user models bring source information closer to a target decoder ( Kostas et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Singh et al., 2025 ; Fogg et al., 2026 ) . The limitation is the mismatch between available supervision and intended use. More source data help when they preserve distinctions the target task needs; differences in task, sensor coverage or labels can reduce that benefit. Target-data learning curves consequently offer a more informative account of reuse than source hours alone.
blocks.zh: 大型集合感官公司和长时间的个人内部录音使得在临床尝试或内语中难以复制的规模上的代表学习成为可能(Défossez等人,2023年;d ' Ascoli等人,2025年;Özdogan等人,2025年)。 常规 EEG和cranial pretraining提供可重复使用的编码器,而针对语音的潜在对接和多用户模式则使源信息更接近目标解码器(Kostas等人,2021年;Wang等人,2023年;Singh等人,2025年;Fogg等人,2026年). 限制在于现有监督与预期用途不匹配。 更多的源数据在保留目标任务需要的区别时会有所帮助;任务、传感器覆盖或标签的差异会减少这种好处。 因此,目标数据学习曲线比仅来源时间更能说明再利用情况。

blocks.en: Recording advances can change this balance by improving access to relevant populations or making acquisition easier. Around-ear EEG–EMG resources, distributed intracranial recordings and emerging magnetic or optical configurations broaden the available design choices ( Inoue et al., 2026 ; Spalding et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Tripathy et al., 2025 ) . Their demonstrated targets currently differ: OPM-MEG includes overt-vowel classification, HD-DOT includes language mapping and audiovisual-segment retrieval, and human fUSI language work primarily provides task maps ( Section 4 ). These achievements establish different starting points. Extending a new configuration towards communication depends on obtaining sufficient content-specific information under the target behaviour, together with a practicable supply of training labels.
blocks.zh: 记录进展可通过改善与相关人群的接触或使获取更容易来改变这种平衡。 环耳EG-EMG资源,分布的颅内录音和新出现的磁或光学配置拓宽了现有的设计选择(Inoue等人,2026年;Spalding等人,2026年;徐等人,2026年;Trithery等人,2025年)。 它们展示的目标目前不同:OPM-MEG包括公开的省分分类,HD-DOT包括语言映射和视听单元检索,人类fUSI语言工作主要提供任务地图(第4节). 这些成就确立了不同的起点。 将新的配置扩大到通信,取决于在目标行为下获得足够的具体内容信息,以及实际提供培训标签。

blocks.en: 8.3 Transfer across content, people and time
blocks.zh: 8.3 跨内容、人员和时间的转让

blocks.en: Shared representations and session alignment have begun to reduce the dependence on a separately trained decoder for every recording ( Singh et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026e ) . Their benefits address different changes: new content challenges linguistic composition, a new participant changes anatomy and sampled populations, and a later session changes the recording within a person. Calibrated multi-user models and continued adaptation provide evidence that reuse and personal fitting can work together ( Fogg et al., 2026 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . The unresolved issue is how reliably the gains persist across users and how much target supervision each change requires.
blocks.zh: 共同陈述和会议调整已开始减少对每次录制都使用经过单独培训的编解码器的依赖(Singh等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年e)。 他们的好处涉及不同的变化:新内容挑战语言构成,新参与者改变解剖学和抽样人口,后一会改变一个人内部的记录. 校准的多用户模型和持续改造提供了证据,证明再利用和个人装配可以一起工作(Fogg等人,2026年;Card等人,2026年)。 尚未解决的问题是,用户如何可靠地维持收益,以及每次改革需要多少目标监督。

blocks.en: Common datasets support repeated method comparisons, while longitudinal and independent-cohort studies extend the range of conditions represented. Split analyses and controlled replications have shown that familiar stimuli and output priors can account for part of apparent transfer in the tested configurations ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Jo et al., 2026 ; Tates et al., 2026 ; Li and Tao, 2026 ) . These findings identify specific obstacles to learning robust neural-to-language mappings. Assessing performance across content novelty, recording shift and calibration budgets can reveal whether a model reuses linguistic structure or remains tied to its original setting. Variation between participants, including unsuccessful users, remains consequential for estimating how broadly a reported capability applies ( Allefeld et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 常用数据集支持重复的方法比较,而纵向和独立协同研究则扩展了代表的条件范围. 分解分析和可控复制表明,熟悉的刺激和输出前传可说明测试配置中明显转移的部分内容(Yin等人,2025年;Jo等人,2026年;Tates等人,2026年;Li和Tao,2026年)。 这些调查结果确定了学习强健神经元对语言绘图的具体障碍. 评估跨内容新颖性、记录变化和校准预算的绩效,可以揭示一个模型是否再利用语言结构,或者是否仍然与其原始设定挂钩。 参与者之间,包括未成功用户之间的差异,仍然是估计所报告能力适用程度的原因(Allefeld等人,2016年)。

blocks.en: 8.4 Sustained communication and operating burden
blocks.zh: 8.4 持续的通信和业务负担

blocks.en: Streaming synthesis, expressive control, facial animation and prolonged home use have moved neural language interfaces closer to everyday exchange ( Littlejohn et al., 2025 ; Wairagkar et al., 2025 ; Metzger et al., 2023 ; Card et al., 2026 ) . These developments improve different parts of communication: immediate feedback supports ongoing production, additional output dimensions carry expression, and background adaptation maintains access. Each also changes the work required of the user or support network. A richer output may need additional control, and continued learning depends on labels and recovery when the mapping changes.
blocks.zh: 流化合成,表达控制,面部动画和延长家庭使用时间,使得神经语言界面更接近日常交流(Littlejohn等人,2025年;Wairagkar等人,2025年;Metzger等人,2023年;Card等人,2026年). 这些发展改善了通信的不同部分:即时反馈支持正在进行的生产,额外的输出维度带表达,背景适应维持访问. 每一个也都会改变用户或支持网络所需的工作. 更丰富的产出可能需要额外的控制,持续的学习取决于标签和在绘图改变时的恢复.

blocks.en: User-centred and longitudinal BCI studies already connect effectiveness to workload, availability and assistance ( Kübler et al., 2014 ; Wolpaw et al., 2018 ; Vansteensel et al., 2024 ) . For direct speech interfaces, the remaining challenge is to sustain gains over complete exchanges and changing needs, including correction and unavailable time. Comparisons with a person’s existing communication aid can identify whether an advance reduces effort, improves participation or transfers work to setup and maintenance.
